jobs.excerpt: Project OverviewWe are sourcing independent Audio Evaluation Specialists for an AI benchmark evaluation project assessing advanced agentic audio models.
jobs.description:
Project Overview

We are sourcing independent Audio Evaluation Specialists for an AI benchmark evaluation project assessing advanced agentic audio models. As AI models increasingly handle complex workflows in this domain—specifically real-world customer support scenarios like flight bookings, financial services, and telecommunications—their accuracy relies entirely on robust, expert-crafted training data. The objective of this project is to autonomously produce high-quality evaluation tasks through simulated interactions, audit conversational AI outputs, and generate clean, reliable datasets to optimize model performance.

Project Deliverables & Scope

Operate autonomously to design complex evaluation frameworks and provide structured training data. Expected deliverables include:

  • Role-Play Scenario Execution: Creating and executing complex, role-play-based evaluation scenarios that simulate realistic customer service interactions across travel, finance, and technical support domains.
  • Model Performance Auditing: Evaluating AI model performance across standardized qualitative and quantitative metrics, focusing strictly on task completion accuracy, conversational naturalness, and audio comprehension.
  • Technical Metric Evaluation: Assessing the model's basic computer programming literacy, including its understanding of JSON structures, functions, methods, and ability to reason about structured data within a support context.
  • Representative Dataset Generation: Contributing to the development of diverse, high-quality audio datasets that accurately reflect real customer expectations for clarity, efficiency, and natural conversational flow.

Required Expertise

To successfully fulfill the deliverables of this project, Contractors must possess deep industry knowledge to craft realistic professional scenarios. Core skillset includes:

  • Demonstrable professional expertise in complex customer support, technical troubleshooting, or conversational AI evaluation.
  • Native or bilingual proficiency in the target language, including fluency across all language skills (reading, listening, writing, and speaking), alongside strong analytical and verbal communication skills to confidently conduct simulated customer support role-plays.
  • Basic computer programming literacy, specifically a comfortable understanding of JSON structures, functions, methods, and simple logic.
  • A meticulous, detail-oriented approach to working with structured prompts, complex evaluation rubrics, and technical guidelines.
  • Required Equipment: Access to a high-quality microphone to ensure clean, reliable audio input during voice evaluations.

We offer a pay range of $6-to-$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high‑speed internet; company‑sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

Engagement Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor

Workplace Type: Remote

Seniority Level: Mid-Senior Level

jobs.excerpt: 👋 Welcome to dexter health!  At dexter health, we build AI-powered software for care teams.
jobs.description:
👋 Welcome to dexter health!

At dexter health, we build AI-powered software for care teams. Our mission is to reduce administrative workload in healthcare so caregivers can spend more time with patients.

We are looking for a high-agency AI Engineer to help us build new AI features faster and improve the quality, reliability, and speed of existing AI workflows.

This is a hands-on engineering role. Not research. Not prompt-only. You will turn ambiguous product ideas into working, production-ready AI features.

The role is mostly focused on shipping AI product features, with some AI systems and infrastructure work where needed.

You will work closely with product and engineering, but we expect you to take real ownership. You should be comfortable moving fast, making technical decisions under ambiguity, and using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar every day.

Tasks

As our AI Engineer, you will:

  • Build new AI-powered product features from idea to production
  • Improve existing AI workflows for quality, reliability, latency, and user value
  • Design and implement LLM-based workflows, structured outputs, validation logic, and fallback behavior
  • Build evaluation loops, tests, and quality checks for AI-generated outputs
  • Integrate AI capabilities into existing product and backend systems
  • Work with commercial and open-source LLMs without being tied to one specific provider
  • Support self-hosted model workflows where they make sense for quality, speed, cost, or control
  • Debug AI feature failures across inputs, outputs, data, backend logic, and user flows
  • Use AI development tools as a core part of your daily workflow
  • Ship quickly while keeping production quality high

Requirements

We care less about formal seniority and more about speed, intelligence, ownership, and product impact. We like people who operate with founder-like urgency: they figure things out, make progress under ambiguity, and care about outcomes more than titles.

Must-have

  • Strong software engineering skills, especially in Python or a comparable backend language
  • Experience building AI-powered product features or LLM-based workflows
  • Ability to turn ambiguous product ideas into working software quickly
  • Strong understanding of how to design, test, validate, and improve AI outputs
  • Experience integrating AI workflows into production systems
  • Strong debugging instincts across application logic, data, model outputs, and user-facing behavior
  • Experience with evaluation, testing, validation, or quality checks for AI-generated outputs
  • Serious experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar as part of your daily workflow
  • High intelligence, fast learning speed, bias to action, and ownership mindset
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, fast decisions, and a high-trust startup environment
  • Clear written and spoken English

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with frontend or fullstack product development
  • Experience with self-hosted LLMs, model serving, inference optimization, or similar systems
  • Experience with open-source LLMs and related deployment workflows
  • Experience improving latency, cost, quality, or reliability of AI systems
  • Experience with healthcare software, healthcare data, or regulated environments
  • Experience working with structured data extraction, documentation automation, voice workflows, or workflow automation
  • German language skills
  • Knowledge of nursing homes or elderly care workflows

This role is probably not for you if

  • You are mainly looking for an ML research role
  • You are a prompt engineer without strong coding skills
  • You need detailed specifications before making progress
  • You prefer slow, highly structured corporate environments
  • You are mainly looking for management, not hands-on building
  • You want to use AI tools only occasionally instead of as part of your daily workflow
  • You optimize for perfect process over fast, reliable execution

Benefits

  • Remote work
  • Fair compensation based on skills, experience, and location
  • Ownership of important backend systems
  • Work on software used in real healthcare workflows
  • Modern AI-native development workflow
  • Room to grow with the company

Why?

Caregivers spend too much time on documentation, coordination, and administrative work. We build technology that reduces this burden.

AI is core to our product. But useful AI features do not come from demos alone. They need strong engineering, fast iteration, evaluation, production thinking, and deep ownership of the user outcome.

If you want to build AI product features that ship, improve real workflows, use AI tools every day, and take ownership in a fast-moving team, we would like to hear from you.

This is a hands-on engineering role. Not research. Not prompt-only. You will turn ambiguous product ideas into working, production-ready AI features.

The role is mostly focused on shipping AI product features, with some AI systems and infrastructure work where needed.

You will work closely with product and engineering, but we expect you to take real ownership. You should be comfortable moving fast, making technical decisions under ambiguity, and using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar every day.

Tasks

As our AI Engineer, you will:

  • Build new AI-powered product features from idea to production
  • Improve existing AI workflows for quality, reliability, latency, and user value
  • Design and implement LLM-based workflows, structured outputs, validation logic, and fallback behavior
  • Build evaluation loops, tests, and quality checks for AI-generated outputs
  • Integrate AI capabilities into existing product and backend systems
  • Work with commercial and open-source LLMs without being tied to one specific provider
  • Support self-hosted model workflows where they make sense for quality, speed, cost, or control
  • Debug AI feature failures across inputs, outputs, data, backend logic, and user flows
  • Use AI development tools as a core part of your daily workflow
  • Ship quickly while keeping production quality high

Requirements

We care less about formal seniority and more about speed, intelligence, ownership, and product impact. We like people who operate with founder-like urgency: they figure things out, make progress under ambiguity, and care about outcomes more than titles.

Must-have

  • Strong software engineering skills, especially in Python or a comparable backend language
  • Experience building AI-powered product features or LLM-based workflows
  • Ability to turn ambiguous product ideas into working software quickly
  • Strong understanding of how to design, test, validate, and improve AI outputs
  • Experience integrating AI workflows into production systems
  • Strong debugging instincts across application logic, data, model outputs, and user-facing behavior
  • Experience with evaluation, testing, validation, or quality checks for AI-generated outputs
  • Serious experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar as part of your daily workflow
  • High intelligence, fast learning speed, bias to action, and ownership mindset
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, fast decisions, and a high-trust startup environment
  • Clear written and spoken English

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with frontend or fullstack product development
  • Experience with self-hosted LLMs, model serving, inference optimization, or similar systems
  • Experience with open-source LLMs and related deployment workflows
  • Experience improving latency, cost, quality, or reliability of AI systems
  • Experience with healthcare software, healthcare data, or regulated environments
  • Experience working with structured data extraction, documentation automation, voice workflows, or workflow automation
  • German language skills
  • Knowledge of nursing homes or elderly care workflows

This role is probably not for you if

  • You are mainly looking for an ML research role
  • You are a prompt engineer without strong coding skills
  • You need detailed specifications before making progress
  • You prefer slow, highly structured corporate environments
  • You are mainly looking for management, not hands-on building
  • You want to use AI tools only occasionally instead of as part of your daily workflow
  • You optimize for perfect process over fast, reliable execution

Benefits

  • Remote work
  • Fair compensation based on skills, experience, and location
  • Ownership of important backend systems
  • Work on software used in real healthcare workflows
  • Modern AI-native development workflow
  • Room to grow with the company

Why?

Caregivers spend too much time on documentation, coordination, and administrative work. We build technology that reduces this burden.

AI is core to our product. But useful AI features do not come from demos alone. They need strong engineering, fast iteration, evaluation, production thinking, and deep ownership of the user outcome.

If you want to build AI product features that ship, improve real workflows, use AI tools every day, and take ownership in a fast-moving team, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.description:
About Phaidra

Phaidra is building the future of industrial automation.

The world today is filled with static, monolithic infrastructure. Factories, power plants, buildings, etc. operate the same they've operated for decades — because the controls programming is hard-coded. Thousands of lines of rules and heuristics that define how the machines interact with each other. The result of all this hard-coding is that facilities are frozen in time, unable to adapt to their environment while their performance slowly degrades.

Phaidra creates AI-powered control systems for the industrial sector, enabling industrial facilities to automatically learn and improve over time. Specifically:

  • We use reinforcement learning algorithms to provide this intelligence, converting raw sensor data into high-value actions and decisions.
  • We focus on industrial applications, which tend to be well-sensorized with measurable KPIs — perfect for reinforcement learning.
  • We enable domain experts (our users) to configure the AI control systems (i.e. agents) without writing code. They define what they want their AI agents to do, and we do it for them.

Our team has a track record of applying AI to some of the toughest problems. From achieving superhuman performance with DeepMind's AlphaGo, to reducing the energy required to cool Google's Data Centers by 40%, we deeply understand AI and how to apply it in production for massive impact.

Phaidra’s ability to achieve its mission is determined by our ability to work together — as defined by our core values: Agency,Velocity, Craft, and Truth. Who You Are

As an AI Controls Solutions Engineer, you'll play a critical role in operationalizing and scaling Phaidra's solutions for enterprise data center customers.

We are seeking a team member located in the following area: USA or Canada.

Responsibilities

You will work closely with the Technical Program Managers (TPMs) and Data Scientists (DSs), as the technical experts for Phaidra's customers. Your role is to use Phaidra's platform and tools to put AI into production.

This role can be broken down into two concrete areas of responsibility:

  • As the subject matter expert, (SME), you will use Phaidra’s products and your knowledge of the customers' needs to create a model of the facility for ingestion by our product lineup.   • You will work with the product team to identify and define product requirements based upon each customer’s specification and needs. You will work closely with other AI Controls Solutions Engineers and the Product team to ensure our automated tools enable Phaidra to scale across thousands of customers.

*This role can include 25% travel

Key Qualifications

  • Understanding the applications and control strategies of air side chilled water and direct expansion cooling systems.
  • Ability to troubleshoot, triage, and analyze issues with control systems and equipment.
  • Strong proficiency in working with data center operations teams and contributing to solving field operations related problems and challenges.
  • Experience programming control systems with PLC, ladder logic, text, or block programming languages.
  • Ability to analyze the performance and viability of your engineered solutions.
  • Passion for problem solving and using scalable solutions to solve repeat problems.
  • Ability to translate a combination of customer-stated and customer-implied needs into coherent needs documentation for use by the software development team.
  • Good educational background in one or more related disciplines pertinent to your area of expertise. Example disciplines include Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Control Theory, Applied Mathematics and other various engineering and applied science fields.
  • Ability to read and write Python scripts (in collaboration with the software engineering team) to implement Insights and scrappy tooling.
  • Ability to work independently to resolve onboarding or support tickets by coordinating with the right people or providing direct solutions. You will possesses deep knowledge of Phaidra’s pipelines and effectively identify and addresses issues and manage risks actively.
  • Exhibits excellent communication skills and has the ability to explain complex domain specific concepts to non-domain experts and also explain complex AI and ML specific concepts to non-AI/ML specific customers.
  • Ability to own and manage large sections of documentation, fostering a culture of high standards in documentation and communication.
  • Ability to understand customers well and drive a culture of pragmatic urgency and customer satisfaction.
  • Ability to lead the deployment and support of multiple Solutions, perhaps in parallel.
  • Ability to own project delivery within team, work as an independent contributor, and rally other individuals on the team to accomplish substantial tasks that cannot be completed independently.
  • Ability to mentor peers, delegate within team, handle project stakeholders, build relationships with other departments within Phaidra, and collaborate with their manager on the roadmap, backlog, and work planning.

Preferred Skills & Experience

Onboarding

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.excerpt: Termgrid is rewriting the rules of private capital markets.
jobs.description:
Termgrid is rewriting the rules of private capital markets. We built the category-defining operating system for deal professionals — the platform where the world's most sophisticated private equity sponsors, lenders, and advisors manage every stage of their financing workflows.
Founded in 2019 by Dipish Rai (Harvard MBA, IIT, Columbia; ex-Providence Equity) and Vishal Singh (Columbia MS CS; ex-CTO Link3D, acquired by Nasdaq: MTLS), Termgrid has achieved what few fintech companies dream of: 4 of the top 5 global private equity firms trust us as their core technology partner. 1600+ institutions. 30,000+ professionals.
The Role

We are adding intelligent recommendations to the platform: quietly surfacing the most relevant connections, counterparties, and opportunities to users at the right moment, drawn from social signals (who is connected to whom, network activity) and transaction signals (who transacts with whom). The bar is subtle and genuinely useful discovery, not a salesy push.

You will be the first data scientist building this, from the ground up, on data most companies would love to have. It is a build-and-own role for someone who ships.

Responsibilities

  • Build and own the first recommendation features, surfacing relevant connections, counterparties, and opportunities inside the product.
  • Apply classical recommendation techniques well: collaborative filtering, clustering, nearest neighbors, and standard ML models, on social and transaction data.
  • Start simple, then layer in embeddings, similarity search, and ranking where they earn their place.
  • Handle sparse data and cold-start for new users and entities.
  • Keep recommendations subtle, relevant, and trustworthy: helpful discovery in a finance product, not a sales pitch. This is a product and UX judgment call as much as a modeling one.
  • Own evaluation: offline metrics plus online experiments tied to real engagement and adoption, not vanity numbers.
  • Partner with backend engineering on serving, and set light, useful ML practices as the first data scientist in this area.

Requirements

  • Solid, hands-on experience building recommendation or personalization systems in production.
  • Strong grasp of classical recommendation methods: collaborative filtering, clustering, nearest neighbors, and standard ML models.
  • Recommendation foundations: embeddings and similarity or vector search, ranking, feature engineering, and rigorous evaluation.
  • Strong Python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn) and strong SQL.

The Team Lead - Acute Billing Operations is responsible for day‑to‑day operational performance and execution for assigned clients, serving as the primary operations liaison between client facilities and internal delivery teams. This role focuses on tactical revenue cycle outcomes, ensuring accurate reporting, effective communication, and consistent execution across full-cycle claims processing. (billing, follow‑up, collections, denials, and claim resolution workflows)


This position is accountable for operational monitoring and client relationship management. The Team Lead translates client needs into clear operational priorities, monitors key performance indicators, identifies risks and trends, and supports timely issue resolution to protect cash, A/R performance, and client satisfaction.


The role also provides operational mentorship to staff by reinforcing daily best practices, supporting training and performance efforts, and helping remove execution barriers. Success is measured by client retention, escalation volume, and core revenue cycle performance indicators.


These Goals and objectives are not to be construed as a complete statement of all duties performed; employees will be required to perform other job-related duties as required. Goals and objectives are subject to change.


All activities must be in compliance with Equal Employment Opportunity laws, HIPAA, ERISA and other regulations, as appropriate.


Essential Functions: In addition to meeting performance expectations, this role includes the following specific responsibilities:


Discrete Responsibilities (Primary Accountability)

  • Operational Performance Monitoring: Monitor daily operational performance, battle cards, action plans, and key KPIs for assigned clients, including A/R days, cash performance, denial trends, and accuracy measures.
  • Primary Operations Liaison: Act as the primary operational point of contact between clients and internal delivery teams, ensuring timely, accurate, and consistent communication.
  • Operational Translation: Translate client needs, issues, and requests into actionable operational priorities and execution plans.
  • Risk & Trend Identification: Identify operational risks, analyze performance trends, and support issue resolution to prevent revenue leakage and service disruption.
  • Reporting & Communication: Ensure accurate reporting, clear status updates, and effective issue communication to internal stakeholders and, as appropriate, client contacts.
  • Client Scope: Lead operational work for domestic‑only clients as needed.

Reporting, Trend Monitoring & Continuous Improvement

  • Trend Monitoring & Corrective Action: Review statistical reports and dashboards to identify operational trends, risks, and deficiencies; develop and implement corrective action plans to improve timeliness, quality, and outcomes.
  • Operational Efficiency: Lead tactical efforts to maximize operational efficiency and optimize reimbursement through standardized workflows, issue triage, and collaboration with cross-functional partners.

Client & Stakeholder Relationship Management (Tactical)

  • Liaison & Communication: Act as the primary operational point of contact between facility management and internal teams, ensuring smooth, timely communication and resolution of day-to-day issues.
  • Service Responsiveness & Escalation: Ensure client inquiries are addressed promptly (including providing timelines to resolution), and proactively escalate risks such as unbilled accounts, claim issues, and operational blockers to leadership.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Partner with internal teams (e.g., operations, finance, payer relations, technology, and strategic client management/sales counterparts) to drive resolution and maintain a consistent client experience.
  • Contract Awareness & Compliance: Understand contract terms and ensure operational billing, invoicing, and service delivery remain within negotiated requirements.

Compliance & Professional Standards

  • Regulatory Knowledge: Maintain current knowledge of hospital billing systems, government payer programs, third-party reimbursement policies, and applicable federal/state regulations.
  • Confidentiality: Maintain confidentiality of patient and client information without exception.
  • Continuous Learning & Industry Awareness: Attend required meetings and remain current on industry trends, legislative changes, and best practices.
  • Customer Invoicing & Accuracy: Ensure accuracy of customer invoices and support monthly invoicing processes as required; validate supporting detail and address discrepancies.
  • Management Expectations / Additional Duties: Perform all functions in alignment with management expectations and complete other duties as assigned.

Key Measures of Success

  • Client Retention and Stability
  • Reduction in Client Escalations
  • Cash Performance vs. Goal
  • A/R Days and Denial Trends

Staff Management

Responsible for ensuring area of responsibility has the talent and resources to meet short- and long-term organizational goals as well as ensuring maximum productivity and performance. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Proactively recruit, screen, and select candidates for current and future resource requirements.

  • Utilize the company’s performance management program as designed to align individual performance to overall performance objectives. Meet all completion requirements at a high quality level. Provide ongoing performance feedback. Identify and take appropriate action for non-performance.

jobs.excerpt: We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact.
jobs.description:
We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning. We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large.

About the Role:

Wiley Research is executing a three-year transformation, from a strong publishing foundation, through a connected intelligence layer, to an essential research infrastructure. AI runs through every stage. The value comes when more than 1,500 Research colleagues use it well in their daily work, and when teams are ready to adopt the agents and workflows Wiley builds.


The Senior Manager, AI Training & Enablement leads AI adoption across Research. The role has two focus areas: (1) moving colleagues toward everyday use of Copilot and Claude, and (2) deepening adoption of agents and AI-enabled workflows in the teams ready for them. With a population this size, focus is central to the job. The role chooses where to invest, builds simple and repeatable plans, and extends its reach through managers and peer champions.


The role works closely with the AI Center of Excellence, which owns governance, controls, and the building of agents, and with the BM&SP crew team, which experiments with operational solutions enabled by AI. It does not set AI policy, approve tools, or build agents. It makes sure colleagues know what is available and permitted, how to use it in their own work, and what is changing in how their team operates.

The role is hands-on: it designs and produces the learning materials and leads live sessions directly, concentrating that effort on priority segments. Materials are deliberately light: one-page role-based starter guides, short live and recorded sessions, example prompts and workflows, and manager talking points. Full curricula are not expected.

This role will evolve as Research evolves. Wiley is in the middle of a transformation, so the scope and priorities described here will be further defined with the VP once the person starts, and will keep changing as the organization does. The right person is flexible and comfortable adjusting course.


Key Responsibilities

The responsibilities below describe what this role may take on. They are possibilities rather than a fixed list. We will confirm scope and sequencing with the person in the role, and refine them as we go, as the organization and the transformation evolve.

1. Adoption Strategy & Prioritization

  • Build and maintain a Research adoption plan: role-family segments, target use cases, sequencing of waves, and success measures. Review it with the VP each quarter.
  • Apply clear prioritization criteria, such as volume of repeatable work, leader sponsorship, team readiness, and availability of proven use cases. State plainly what is deferred and why.
  • Establish baseline usage with data from the AI Center of Excellence and tool reporting, and define a short set of adoption measures.
  • Keep the plan aligned with Research strategic priorities and with the operating rhythm run by BM&SP.

2. Learning Design & Content Development

  • Define learning objectives and key learning points for each priority audience with Research leaders and subject-matter experts, so every asset targets a specific use case and behavior.
  • Develop short, practical materials in plain language that make AI tools and workflows simple: one-page guides, example prompts and workflows, recorded demos and short videos, and micro-learning modules where useful. Use Wiley templates and standards.
  • Extract core information from AI Center of Excellence guidance, existing procedures, subject-matter experts, and crew team pilots, and turn it into role-ready material.
  • Pilot materials with a small group and obtain the needed approvals, including AI Center of Excellence review of policy content, before release.
  • Design for accessibility and varied learning styles, including assistive technologies.
  • Research learner and business needs for each audience, and refine materials from feedback. Keep content current as tools, features, and guardrails change, and retire what is out of date.

3. Everyday Adoption of Copilot and Claude

  • Build role-based starter plans for each priority role family: top use cases, example prompts, short sessions, and office hours.
  • Schedule, coordinate, and deliver short live and virtual sessions and office hours, timed to tool rollouts and key points in the Research calendar.
  • Track training requests, attendance, and completion, and use the data to decide what to build, adjust, or retire next.
  • Build and support a network of peer champions across Research teams, with a light toolkit and regular check-ins. Coach champions and any colleagues supporting this work on content and delivery standards.
  • Equip people managers with talking points and small team activities so adoption continues after launch.
  • Translate guardrails from the AI Center of Excellence into plain-language guidance colleagues can follow in their daily work.
  • Collect questions and barriers from colleagues. Resolve what content can fix and escalate the rest to the AI Center of Excellence.

4. Advanced Adoption of Agents and AI-Enabled Workflows

  • Identify teams ready to move from individual use to shared agents and redesigned workflows, and sequence that work with the AI Center of Excellence and the crew team.
  • Prepare receiving teams for new agents and workflows with quick-start materials and hands-on walkthroughs: what changes, who does what, how to escalate issues, and how success will be measured.
  • Turn proven crew team pilots into short, repeatable guides covering what the solution does, who it is for, and how to start.
  • Gather user feedback and return it to the AI Center of Excellence and the crew team to improve agent and workflow design.
  • Support the clean transition of successful pilots into their permanent organizational home, with documented handoff.

5. Change Management & Communications

  • Apply a change approach proportionate to the size of each change: impact assessment, sponsor engagement, attention to concerns, and reinforcement after launch.
  • Work with HR and Research leaders when AI adoption affects roles, responsibilities, or ways of working. HR owns workforce decisions.
  • Coordinate with BM&SP communications and Research leadership so AI updates arrive as a coherent story, not a stream of separate announcements.
  • Maintain a single, easy-to-find home for Research AI guidance, examples, and upcoming sessions, for example a SharePoint site.

6. Measurement & Reporting

  • Track adoption breadth (who is using), depth (how often and for which use cases), and workflow adoption. Add short pulse surveys and colleague stories.
  • Assess whether the materials and sessions work: completion, feedback, and change in use. Use the findings to improve the next wave.
  • Report monthly to the VP and quarterly to the Research Leadership Team, with recommendations on where to invest, adjust, or stop.
  • Retire or revise approaches that are not driving adoption.

7. Partnerships

  • AI Center of Excellence: agree a working model for how adoption needs, agent releases, and policy updates flow between teams.
  • BM&SP crew team: stay close to active experiments so adoption planning starts before solutions are ready.
  • HR, Research communications, Technology & Operations, and Legal: engage as needed, and reuse existing training and change resources before building new ones.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in technology adoption, change management, internal training, learning design, or enablement in a large, matrixed organization.
  • Demonstrated change management experience: a track record of shifting behavior and ways of working across large, varied groups.
  • Hands-on experience designing and developing learning content in multiple formats (written guides, recorded video, e-learning), including defining learning objectives, piloting, and improving from feedback.
  • Hands-on fluency with Copilot, Claude, or similar generative AI tools, and the ability to show practical use credibly to non-technical colleagues.
  • Skill at designing simple, role-based adoption plans and materials that colleagues use, rather than full curricula.
  • Experience delivering engaging live and virtual training to varied audiences.
  • Strong prioritization judgment: able to focus limited capacity on the segments and use cases with the most impact.
  • Ability to influence and align leaders, managers, and technical partners without direct authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in plain, direct language, with the ability to make complex or technical subjects simple.
  • Comfort working with usage data and simple adoption and training measures, such as attendance, completion, and feedback.
  • Flexibility and adaptability: comfort in a role that will evolve as the organization and the transformation evolve, and the judgment to adjust priorities as they change.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A qualification in training, teaching, or learning design, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience with a learning management system and with building SharePoint pages or similar guidance sites.
  • Experience designing accessible learning content for varied learning styles.
  • Experience in research publishing, scholarly communication, or information services.
  • Experience supporting adoption of AI agents, workflow automation, or similar process change.
  • Experience building and running champion or peer-network programs.

jobs.description:
Job Description— Senior Accountant

Reports to:Corporate Controller

Pay Range DOE: 80,000 - 100,000 CAD

About Arc Beverage

Arc Beverage provides beverage co-manufacturing, packaging, and related operational services for brand owners. Our finance team partners with operations to maintain accurate financial records, support business decisions, and improve accounting processes.

Location and working hours

This position is based in Canada. Candidates must reside in Canada and be legally authorized to work in Canada. Regular working hours must align with Pacific Time (PT), including Pacific Standard Time (PST) and Pacific Daylight Time (PDT), as applicable. Additional availability may be needed during month-end and year-end close.

About the role

The Senior Accountant / Assistant Controller is a hands-on finance professional responsible for leading the accounting close, maintaining reliable financial reporting, and overseeing cost and inventory accounting. This role supports the Controller, reviews transactional accounting work, and partners with operations to explain financial results and strengthen controls.

Key responsibilities

  • Support the Controller in managing the day-to-day accounting and financial reporting functions.
  • Own and coordinate key components of the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes.
  • Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, prepayments, amortization, reclassifications, and other accounting adjustments.
  • Prepare, review, and maintain detailed balance sheet reconciliations and supporting schedules.
  • Investigate and resolve accounting discrepancies, unusual transactions, and reconciliation issues.
  • Prepare monthly financial statements and management reporting packages.
  • Analyze financial results and investigate significant variances against budget, forecast, and prior periods.
  • Perform and review bank, credit card, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and other account reconciliations.
  • Support oversight of the accounts payable and accounts receivable functions, including vendor and customer account issues.
  • Maintain and review fixed asset, prepaid expense, accrual, lease, and other balance sheet accounts.
  • Support inventory accounting, including inventory reconciliations, costing, COGS, adjustments, and investigation of variances.
  • Review capital expenditures and ensure appropriate capitalization and accounting treatment.
  • Assist with cash management, cash flow reporting, and working capital analysis.
  • Ensure accounting transactions are properly recorded, supported, and classified in accordance with applicable accounting standards and company policies.
  • Support technical accounting assessments for new or unusual transactions.
  • Assist with annual audits, tax filings, and other external reporting requirements.
  • Prepare audit schedules and respond to auditor requests.
  • Maintain and strengthen internal controls, accounting policies, and procedures.
  • Identify process inefficiencies and implement improvements to increase accuracy, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Support accounting system improvements, ERP enhancements, integrations, and automation initiatives.
  • Provide guidance, review, and mentorship to junior accounting team members.
  • Assist with establishing close timelines, assigning accounting activities, and ensuring deadlines are met.
  • Partner with Operations, Procurement, Sales, HR, and other departments to resolve accounting and financial issues.
  • Provide accounting and financial analysis to support management decision-making.
  • Support the Controller with budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and special projects as required.
  • Step into other accounting functions as required to ensure the team meets reporting deadlines.
  • Perform other accounting and finance-related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance, or equivalent relevant education and experience.
  • At least 4 years of progressive accounting experience; broader accounting oversight and review experience
  • Strong cost accounting and inventory analysis experience in manufacturing or co-packing is required.
  • Proven experience leading or coordinating close activities, preparing financial reports, and resolving complex reconciliations.
  • Knowledge of U.S. GAAP accounting practices and sales tax requirements; cross-border and multi-currency experience is an asset.
  • Canadian CPA designation or active progress toward designation is preferred
  • Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and financial models, and proficiency with ERP systems.
  • Ability to coach junior staff, manage deadlines, and explain financial information to operational leaders.

jobs.title: Wiz Customer Engineer

jobs.description:
As the Wiz Customer Engineer at Foresite, you own everything pre-sales Wiz. If a customer is interested in Wiz and hasn't bought a license yet, you are the person who gets them to a confident yes. You'll run proofs of value, workshops, and CTFs, show customers things about their cloud environment that they didn't know, leveraging the power of Foresite services, and carry those wins through to implementation and managed services. You'll work side by side with Foresite’s Business Development team, and you'll be the go-to Wiz expert on Foresite's Customer Engineering team. If you know the full Wiz platform inside and out, love putting it in front of customers, and want to be close to the deals you help win, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own Pre-Sales Wiz:Be the single owner of Foresite's pre-sales Wiz motion, including proofs of value (POVs), workshops, and capture-the-flag (CTF) events, from first conversation to readout.

  • Run POVs End to End:Scope, launch, and deliver Wiz POVs, configuring the platform, guiding customers through connectors and onboarding, and presenting findings that show clear, prioritized risk in the customer's own environment.

  • Demonstrate the Full Wiz Platform:Position and demo Wiz Cloud, Wiz Code, Wiz Defend, and Wiz One together, showing how code, cloud, and runtime context connect to reduce risk across the full lifecycle.

  • Deliver Fast Time to Value:Surface meaningful, customer-specific findings within the first days of an engagement, and turn them into the business case for purchase.

  • Partner With Google Cloud Security / Wiz:Work directly with Google / Wiz sellers and Google / Wiz sales engineers to qualify opportunities, plan POVs, and win deals together. Take part in Google / Wiz partner programs and POV enablement, including shadowed engagements early on and independent delivery afterward.

  • Work Alongside Foresite Sellers:Partner with Foresite account executives and the rest of Customer Engineering to identify and qualify opportunities, understand technical and compliance objections, and resolve blockers.

  • Move Fast:Launch POVs quickly under a streamlined SOW, so customers can start when they are ready.

  • Convert Wins to Production:Hand successful POVs to Foresite's delivery and managed services teams, and help scope the implementation, ongoing management, and expansion that follow.

  • Write and Price the Work:Author SOWs and support pricing and commercials for Wiz engagements.

  • Shape Managed Services:Share what you see in the field about where Wiz managed services fit best, and help Foresite refine its offerings with Wiz.

  • Grow Across the Portfolio:Build working knowledge of Google SecOps and Google Unified Security over time, so you can support broader opportunities as needed.

  • Be a Thought Leader:Keep up with Wiz releases and cloud security trends, and contribute to best practices and thought leadership within Foresite.

Who You Are

  • 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing cloud security role, such as sales engineer, solutions architect, security consultant, or professional services. Hands-on, production experience with the Wiz platform across multiple products, including Wiz Cloud, Wiz Code, Wiz Defend, and Wiz One. Cloud-only experience is not enough.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • Highly certified across the Wiz portfolio, with a commitment to keeping certifications current.

  • Experience running POVs, pilots, or customer evaluations of cloud security platforms, from kickoff through readout.

  • Experience in cloud security: CSPM, CWPP, CNAPP, cloud detection and response, and identity and access management, across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.

  • Strong understanding of security principles and technologies, including vulnerability management, container and Kubernetes security, infrastructure as code, and application security in the software lifecycle.

  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-moving environment, with a strong willingness to learn new technologies and work positively with internal teams, partners, and customers.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally with sellers, project managers, security engineers, delivery teams, and partners.

  • Expert proficiency in using AI systems to accelerate productivity.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, including the ability to lead technical workshops and demos.

  • Experience writing technical documentation, including SOWs.

  • Experience in pricing and commercials.

  • Impeccable attention to detail.

  • Ability to travel up to 30% of the time as required

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience at Wiz, whether in pre-sales, post-sales, or customer success, or deep experience at a Wiz partner or customer.

  • Experience running Wiz CTFs, workshops, or other customer enablement events.

  • Experience with Google Cloud Security products, especially Security Command Center (SCC), Google SecOps SIEM and SOAR, Google Threat Intelligence, and Google Unified Security.

  • Experience with managed security services, and the ability to connect a POV to a managed service offering.

  • Experience with AI security solutions (Model Armor, etc.) and AI workload security in the cloud.

  • Experience developing clear architecture diagrams that show system layout, data flow, and connectivity.

  • Experience in any of these market sectors: retail, healthcare, energy, or chemicals.

  • Knowledge of cybersecurity market trends (e.g., ransomware, attack frameworks, zero trust, cloud-native threats).

Why Join Foresite?

At Foresite, we aren’t just another security provider—we are a mission-driven partner helping organizations navigate an increasingly complex threat landscape. We’ve built a global leader in SecOps and MDR by leaning into three core pillars that set us apart from the crowd:

  • The "Google Bet" Has Paid Off: Four years ago, we took a contrarian path by going all-in on Google Cloud. Today, that strategy is validated. As a Google Cloud Security Partner of the Year, we operate at the absolute cutting edge of the industry, offering our team a front-row seat to the future of security operations.

  • Practitioner Credibility: We were founded by security practitioners, and more importantly, we are still governed by them. We speak the language of the SOC because we’ve lived it. This ensures our strategy is driven by technical reality, not just marketing trends.

  • Room to Run: We are at that "sweet spot" of growth—large enough to win global contracts, but early enough that every individual’s contribution directly shapes our trajectory.

Course descriptions:

Foundations of Applied AI (BAI1000):

This course introduces students from all disciplines to the rapidly expanding field of artificial intelligence (AI). It focuses on developing AI literacy through technical proficiency, practical application, and critical evaluation. At first, students develop a clear understanding of machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), large language models (LLMs), GenAI, and agentic AI techniques. Next, they actively learn about their unique practical applications in prompting and augmented workflows for individuals and organizations. Lastly, they assess and critique the validity, fairness, and ethical dimensions of the outputs of these AI systems. In this way, the students develop a personal AI portfolio of solutions to the problems in their fields of study by partnering with AI algorithms. No prior AI experience is required. This course is fully online and asynchronous. Applicants should be comfortable creating and recording video content for use within the course.

As the world’s largest organization dedicated to increasing volunteer service, Points of Light engages more than 3.8 million volunteers across 32 countries.

The organization extends President Bush’s vision that “any definition of a successful life must include serving others.” Today, Points of Light continues to transcend politics and borders to inspire millions of individuals worldwide to take action.

Salary Range:$70,000-$80,000 annually

Reports to:Director, Grant Management & Revenue Operations

Department:Office of the Chief Operating Officer

Location:Points of Light is a remote-first organization. Any U.S. location in the Eastern or Central time zone in a market with a major airport. Washington, DC or Atlanta preferred.

Position Summary:

The Senior Manager, Grant Management & Revenue Operations manages awarded philanthropic grants and signed fee-for-service (earned-income) agreements across Points of Light. Reporting to the Director, the role translates approved commitments into coordinated plans, clear ownership, reporting calendars and timely handoffs from award through closeout.

Working across Development, Corporate Programs, Finance, program and delivery teams, and relationship managers, the Senior Manager proactively connects contributors, monitors commitments and ensures timely donor and client communication through established relationship channels. The ideal candidate brings extensive grant management experience, strong project management and communication skills, and an adaptable approach to improving processes

Position Functions and Responsibilities Include:

Post-Award Planning and Enterprise Coordination

  • Lead kickoffs with Finance, delivery leads and relationship managers. Confirm agreement terms, approved budgets, planned funding assignments, owners, deliverables, reporting requirements, payment triggers and handoffs.
  • Maintain one implementation plan and reporting calendar per agreement, covering milestones, dependencies and deadlines. Apply the Supervisor’s distinct grant and earned-income workflows; coordinate required financial setup with Finance.
  • Establish routine touchpoints with all relevant enterprise contributors throughout each agreement’s lifecycle. Confirm responsibilities, share decisions and changes, anticipate dependencies and connect teams before handoffs break down.

Grant and Contract Monitoring

  • As needed, support preparation of revenue agreements, agreement letters and amendments using approved templates; coordinate required information, reviews, approvals and electronic signatures; and maintain executed documents in Salesforce under supervisor’s guidance.
  • Track deliverables, funder restrictions, reporting conditions and spending deadlines against approved plans. Identify emerging compliance and execution risks, follow up with responsible owners and flag concerns to the Director and Finance.
  • Prepare agreement-level monthly status reports comparing progress with approved proposals, plans and budgets and Finance’s official results and forecast. Highlight variances and decisions for the supervisor’s portfolio review.
  • Coordinate resolution with accountable owners and track their corrective actions. Escalate unresolved issues, conflicting information and material variances with actionable recommendations.
  • Route proposed changes to scope, timing, deliverables or financial terms through the supervisor for approval before revised commitments are made; update plans and records after authorization.

Finance Coordination and Documentation

  • Obtain time records, milestone confirmations and supporting documentation for timely invoicing, revenue recognition and restricted-fund accounting. Check completeness, submit by Finance’s deadlines and resolve missing or inconsistent information.
  • Support Finance-led reconciliation by investigating discrepancies among agreements, operational records, completed milestones and financial reports. Program and delivery leaders certify completed work and source accuracy; Finance retains accounting and revenue-recognition decisions and official financial records.

Donor and Client Reporting and Closeout

  • Coordinate accurate program content, supporting documentation and approvals for funder and client reports. Keep relationship managers informed of progress, changes and risks; ensure they have timely updates and materials to communicate with donors and clients through established channels.
  • Maintain complete files, including executed agreements in Salesforce, approved changes, schedules, supporting documentation and submission records. Complete administrative closeout after program and Finance confirmation, documenting final reports, approvals, outstanding requirements and lessons learned.

Process Improvement and Project Support

  • Proactively identify process gaps and recommend practical improvements to the supervisor using recurring issues, performance data and staff feedback. Help test and implement approved changes and assess results.
  • Maintain procedures, templates, job aids and training under the supervisor’s standards. Reinforce consistent use, address adoption gaps and adapt workflows as requirements evolve.
  • Partner with CRM enablement and Salesforce Administration on reporting needs, data gaps and system improvements; maintain assigned records in approved systems.
  • Provide operational support for donor data administration and fundraising events, as capacity permits and assigned by supervisor.
  • Support time-bound cross-functional project teams (Tiger Teams), as assigned by supervisor or COO, with a defined purpose, executive sponsor, scope, capacity plan and end date.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Core Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Strong grant administration, project management and organizational skills; ability to coordinate multiple agreements, contributors and deadlines.
  • Excellent attention to agreement requirements, financial documentation and reporting; ability to translate findings into clear action.
  • Proactive communication, facilitation and follow-through; ability to build accountability across teams without direct authority.
  • Adaptability, curiosity and initiative in suggesting and testing process improvements; sound judgment in resolving and escalating issues.
  • Commitment to integrity, discretion, Points of Light’s mission and a collaborative, respectful workplace.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 7+ years of relevant experience, including substantial hands-on responsibility for restricted grant management from award through reporting and closeout.
  • Demonstrated success coordinating complex cross-functional projects and partnering with Finance and delivery teams on budgets, documentation and reconciliation.
  • Grant accounting experience preferred, particularly using Blackbaud for grant setup, coding, restriction tracking or financial reporting.
  • Experience developing procedures, training colleagues and implementing process improvements.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or comparable CRM software, Excel and project management tools (Asana preferred); familiarity with Microsoft 365 collaboration tools.
  • Relevant certification or formal training in grants management, project management or process improvement (e.g., CGMS, PMP or Lean Six Sigma) preferred.
  • Ability to create a welcoming work environment for all.

Culture and Values: Points of Light has a 35-year plus history that it seeks to honor, while looking toward the future as an innovative thought leader in the social sector. We have a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Our organization values innovation, dedication, teamwork and respectfulness. We enjoy thinking big, but also working hard to deliver our best work. Our team is solution-oriented, looking for someone who is always ready to deliver on ways to solve challenges, internally and with external partners.

What We Offer:Competitive compensation and excellent benefits including a robust PTO program: 18 days of PTO (increases to 20 days after three years of service) and 10 holidays; plus, we are closed December 25-January 1. Medical, dental and vision benefits offered, free life insurance, along with long-term and short-term disability, a 403(b) program with employer match, parental leave and one day of volunteer time off per month.

The Job

As a Senior Salesforce Developer – Field Service at Omnidian, you will design, develop, and optimize Salesforce Field Service solutions that power our technician experience and field operations. You'll leverage the latest Salesforce AI capabilities to automate workflows, improve technician productivity, and enhance customer experiences while building scalable, secure, and maintainable platform solutions.

You are a hands-on Salesforce engineer with deep expertise in Field Service who embraces AI-assisted development and modern engineering practices. You'll partner closely with Product, Operations, Customer Experience, and Engineering teams to deliver intelligent solutions that improve scheduling, dispatching, work execution, and operational efficiency.

    Salesforce Field Service Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable Salesforce Field Service solutions using native platform capabilities and custom development.
  • Configure and customize Field Service functionality, including Work Orders, Service Appointments, Service Resources, Service Territories, Work Types, Scheduling Policies, Dispatcher Console, and Field Service Mobile.
  • Build modern Lightning Web Components (LWC), Apex services, Flows, and Platform Events that support technician and dispatcher experiences.
  • Develop mobile-first solutions that improve field technician productivity and customer service.

    • AI-Driven Engineering

  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate software delivery, improve code quality, and automate repetitive development tasks.
  • Design and implement AI-powered Salesforce solutions using capabilities such as Agentforce, Einstein AI, Prompt Builder, and Model Builder where appropriate.
  • Build intelligent automations that improve technician recommendations, work order routing, knowledge retrieval, and operational decision-making.
  • Evaluate emerging Salesforce AI capabilities and recommend practical use cases that improve business outcomes.
  • Partner with Product and Operations teams to identify opportunities where AI can reduce manual effort and improve field service efficiency.

    • Platform Engineering

  • Develop high-quality solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, Flow, Platform Events, and Custom Metadata.
  • Balance declarative configuration with custom development to build scalable, maintainable solutions.
  • Ensure applications meet Salesforce best practices for security, performance, scalability, and governor limits.
  • Perform code reviews, maintain automated testing, and contribute to engineering standards and platform quality.

    • Integrations & Automation

  • Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce Field Service and enterprise applications using REST APIs, event-driven architectures, and platform-native integration capabilities.
  • Design reliable automation that supports scheduling, dispatching, technician workflows, and customer communications.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve operational processes through intelligent automation and platform enhancements.

Who You Are

  • You're an experienced Salesforce developer with deep expertise in Salesforce Field Service and Service Cloud.
  • You have embraced AI-assisted software development and use modern AI tools to improve engineering productivity and solution quality.
  • You understand how AI can enhance business workflows and customer experiences - not just generate code.
  • You know when to configure Salesforce, when to build custom solutions, and when AI capabilities can deliver business value.
  • You enjoy solving complex technical challenges while keeping user experience and operational efficiency at the center of your decisions.
  • You collaborate effectively across engineering and business teams and communicate technical concepts clearly.
  • You mentor teammates, promote engineering best practices, and continuously improve how software is built and delivered.

Experience You’ll Need

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience with Service Cloud and Salesforce Field Service.
  • Strong experience customizing Field Service capabilities, including Work Orders, Service Appointments, Service Resources, Service Territories, Dispatcher Console, Scheduling Policies, and Field Service Mobile.

The organisation combines technical expertise with a strong understanding of commercial needs, helping customers improve productivity, security, resilience and long-term business performance. Its capabilities span managed IT services, cybersecurity, cloud solutions, AI readiness and governance, Microsoft productivity solutions, business intelligence, connectivity, and voice and communications services.

  • Translate technical services, expertise and customer outcomes into compelling market-facing value propositions.

  2. Frontier Data Labeling Service: Specialized data labeling through Alignerr, leveraging subject matter experts for next-generation AI models

Why Join Us

  • Technical Excellence: Work at the cutting edge of AI development, collaborating with industry leaders and shaping the future of artificial intelligence.

Proactive Risk Mitigation Monitor customer health signals and leverage AI-driven insights to identify at-risk accounts early. Develop and execute tailored mitigation plans to address risk and protect long-term retention.

Product Adoption & Utilization Drive deep feature adoption across your portfolio through targeted campaigns and high-impact interventions. Partner with product and clinical teams to ensure customers are maximizing the full value of the Elation platform.

Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner closely with Implementation, Professional Services, Sales, and Technical Support to deliver a seamless, world-class customer journey from onboarding through renewal and beyond.

Consultative Selling Act as a consultative partner — identifying evolving customer needs and effectively presenting the value of Elation Health's expanding suite of products and services.

What You Bring

Experience

  • 5+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a customer-facing growth role, with at least 2+ years focused on mid-market and enterprise accounts in healthcare SaaS, EHR, or RCM platforms
  • Demonstrated success managing complex, multi-stakeholder accounts and navigating large healthcare organizations
  • Prior experience owning expansion revenue, renewals, and upsell/cross-sell motions within an existing book of business
  • Familiarity with ambulatory, specialty, multi-site group practices, or enterprise health systems

Skills & Competencies

  • Executive presence and the ability to influence and build trust with C-suite and VP-level stakeholders
  • Strong full-cycle, consultative selling instincts — comfortable identifying needs, building business cases, and presenting solutions
  • Proficiency in data storytelling: translating platform usage, outcomes data, and ROI metrics into compelling customer narratives
  • Skilled in clinical use case framing to connect platform capabilities to physician and operational workflows
  • Experience with lifecycle automation tools, CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce), and customer health monitoring solutions

Mindset

  • Strategic thinker who balances long-term relationship building with near-term revenue accountability
  • Proactive, organized, and comfortable managing a complex book of business with competing priorities
  • Collaborative and cross-functional by nature — you thrive working with sales, product, and services teams

How We Measure Success

We believe our community-centric platform has created the opportunity for Reddit to build a highly differentiated ads business.

About the Ads Data Science Team:

The Ads Data Science team at Reddit leverages data to maximize advertiser value on Reddit through robust data foundations, metrics, and strategic insights generated through experimentation and cutting-edge DS methods.

We work on a wide range of challenging problems in the areas of ads and platform measurement, campaign and creative management, advertiser growth and retention, monetization, and the intersection of brand and community engagement. We are a highly collaborative team of passionate data scientists and engineers who are constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible with machine learning and statistical modeling.

About the Role:

We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Senior Data Scientist to join our growing Ads Data Science team. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will play a key role in developing as well as applying cutting-edge DS models/methods to improve the adoption and performance of our advertising platform through data-driven insights. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, and other data scientists to identify opportunities, define metrics, and build solutions that drive significant impact for Reddit.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and apply DS solutions to inform improvements in advertiser experience and Reddit's ad platform
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that can be used to improve the effectiveness of our advertising platform
  • Collaborate with product managers and engineers to define product requirements and translate them into data science solutions
  • Develop ML models & DS methods to improve anomaly detection, prediction, & pattern recognition
  • Communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders across the organization
  • Stay up-to-date on the latest advancements in machine learning and data science
  • Mentor and guide junior data scientists on the team

  • For M.S. holders: 5+ years of industry experience in applied science or data science roles
  • For Ph.D. holders: 4+ years of industry experience in applied science or data science roles
  • Platform experience and a deep understanding of the ads ecosystem
  • Strong understanding of statistical modeling, machine learning algorithms, causal inference and experimental design
  • Experience with large-scale data processing and analysis using tools such as Spark, Hadoop, or Hive; knowledge of BigQuery a plus
  • Proficiency in Python or R and experience with machine learning libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch
  • Experience with SQL and relational databases
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Passion for Reddit and the online advertising industry

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with online advertising and ad tech
  • Experience with causal inference and A/B testing
  • Contributions to open-source projects or publications in relevant conferences or journals

jobs.excerpt: About us: Creative Chaos is an AI orchestration company.
jobs.description:
About us:
Creative Chaos is an AI orchestration company. We help businesses re-engineer how work actually gets done by placing AI orchestrators inside their teams to redesign workflows, deploy agents, and rewire operations end-to-end.

Job Summary:
The Principal AI Process Orchestrator is a key role. This is the person who decides what work humans do and what work AI does, and then designs and ships the systems that make both happen.

You will front every engagement. You will earn trust with the client’s executive team in week one. You will lead the work from workflow audit to shipped automation. You will carry 3-4 concurrent clients and lead Associate Orchestrators through implementation.

This is a senior individual contributor role. We are not hiring a manager. We are hiring the sharpest business analyst you know, the one who also spends their weekends building AI agents and has strong opinions about which tool to use for which job.

Job Description:

  • Lead client engagements end-to-end: You are the face of the engagement. You sit across from the client’s COO or CEO in week one, not week six. You own the weekly update, the monthly business review, and the strategic direction of the work.
  • Map the business: In the first 30 days of any engagement, you learn how work flows through the client’s organization. You produce an opportunity map that identifies the 5-10 workflows where AI can materially change the economics of the business.
  • Design the future state: For the 2-3 workflows selected for transformation, you design the rewired version. What humans do. What agents do. Where the handoffs live. What the evals look like. How success is measured.
  • Ship the implementation: You scope the work, direct the Associate Orchestrators on the engagement, review their output, and ship the first automation to production within 60 days of engagement start.
  • Grow the engagement: You identify when a client needs a Build pod, a Rescue, or ongoing Support, and pull the right Creative Chaos resource in. Transformation is the front door. You open the rest of the house.
  • Own the outcome: You report on measurable client impact: hours saved, error rates reduced, throughput gained. Numbers, not narratives.

Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience as a business analyst, solutions engineer, or technical consultant in software delivery, product, or enterprise SaaS. You have sat between business stakeholders and technical teams. You have interviewed users, mapped workflows, written specs, and owned the result. You are on an individual contributor track and not looking to manage people.
  • Deeply AI-native: Not “uses ChatGPT daily.” You have built and deployed real agents. You use Claude Code as a daily tool, not a curiosity. You have opinions about Cursor vs. Windsurf, LangChain vs. LlamaIndex, and which MCP to use when, because you have actually tried all of them. You can name the right tool for the right job and defend the choice.
  • Portfolio over resume: You can show us a GitHub, side projects, deployed agents, and public writing on what you have built. We do not hire anyone who cannot show us what they have built with their own hands. A resume is not enough. A repo is.
  • Business-native English and executive poise: You have worked with or inside US or Western companies. You can run a stakeholder workshop with twelve people in the room without losing control of it. When you walk into a US CEO’s office, you command the meeting from minute one.
  • Curious and hungry: You learn a new tool every week on your own time. When you are given a well-understood problem, you dig into something adjacent that nobody asked you to look at. You built something last weekend because you wanted to see if you could.

How we hire

This is a portfolio hire, not a resume hire.

Portfolio review: We read everything before we talk to you. If the work is not there, there is no interview.

Technical conversation: 45 minutes. We walk through your agent, your design decisions, and the tools you reached for.

Live exercise: 48 hours. We share a real workflow from one of our portfolio companies. You design how you would rewire it, map the humans-vs-agents split, and sketch the 30/60/90 implementation plan.

Final conversation with the Leader: 60 minutes. Direct, a go or no-go decision within 48 hours.

What Creative Chaos offers

- Direct access to the managing partner and a small senior team

- A clean mandate: you own the engagement, we clear the path

- Best-in-class tooling: Claude, Claude Code, MCPs, and every agent framework worth trying

- The chance to define a new category of work before the market has a name for it

- Compensation open and based on capability and experience
