jobs.title: SOC Analyst (16:00–01:00 UTC)
jobs.excerpt: About the jobThe SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center.
jobs.description:
About the job

The SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center. This position reports to the SOC Lead. The role goes beyond acknowledging alerts: the focus is on understanding what each alert means, investigating suspicious activity end to end, responding to real threats, and handing over cleanly between regions so that nothing is lost across shifts. The ideal candidate has solid SOC experience, a strong investigative mindset, and thrives in a fast-paced, fully remote setting where accuracy, discipline, and security are essential. Hands-on engineering experience with core security platforms is a big plus.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor, triage, and analyze security alerts and events from the organization's security stack, including SIEM, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Service Edge (SSE), and Web Application Firewall (WAF) platforms.

  • Investigate security incidents end to end, from initial triage through analysis, containment, eradication, and post-incident documentation, coordinating with relevant teams throughout.

  • Determine the scope, severity, and impact of security events, separating true positives from false positives and escalating confirmed incidents according to defined procedures.

  • Execute response actions within the security platforms, such as isolating endpoints, blocking indicators, disabling compromised accounts, and enforcing access restrictions.

  • Ensure structured, high-quality shift handovers across regions in the follow-the-sun model, so that open investigations, ongoing incidents, and pending actions continue seamlessly around the clock.

  • Proactively threat hunt across endpoint, network, and log data to uncover suspicious activity that existing detections may have missed, mapping findings to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Provide feedback on detection quality and contribute to the tuning of SIEM correlation rules, EDR custom detections, and WAF rules to reduce noise and improve coverage.

  • Enrich investigations with threat intelligence, including indicators of compromise, attacker techniques, and emerging campaigns relevant to the organization.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and incident response playbooks.

  • Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, application, and security engineering teams to resolve incidents and support day-to-day operations.

  • Support vulnerability management and drive continuous improvement of the organization's overall security posture.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst, triaging alerts and investigating security incidents in a production environment.

  • Solid working knowledge of core security technologies such as EDR, SSE, SIEM, and WAF, and of how to use them to investigate and respond to threats.

  • Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and tuning these platforms, or writing and tuning detection content, is a big plus.

  • Experience with incident response and threat hunting, ideally with familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

  • Excellent understanding of network security, endpoint security, cloud security, and Zero Trust principles.

  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, BTL1, or vendor-specific credentials are a plus.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.

  • Ability to handle sensitive information responsibly and securely.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English, and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams and across time zones.

About You

You are a hands-on security analyst who wants to understand what is really happening behind an alert, rather than only closing tickets. You dig into the data, follow the evidence, and know when and how to escalate. If you have also stood up or tuned the tools you work with, or written your own detections, even better. You are structured, reliable, and comfortable working independently in a remote, follow-the-sun team, and you take pride in leaving a clear handover for the next shift. You are curious about new threats and technologies, and you enjoy working closely with both technical teams and end users to raise the security bar across the environment.

Product Management | PTC Modeler | Systems Engineering

PTC is seeking an experienced, customer-focused Sr. Principal Product Manager to lead PTC Modeler and help shape the next generation of systems engineering at PTC. PTC believes the future of systems engineering will require more connected, accessible, and intelligent experiences. We are exploring how AI and agentic experiences, connected engineering information, open standards, and deeper integration across the product lifecycle can create new ways for engineers to understand, design, analyze, communicate, and evolve complex systems. This Product Manager will bring the perspective of customers, practitioners, partners, and the market into that work.

The ideal candidate combines strong product management judgment with systems thinking technical curiosity, commercial awareness, and credibility with engineering customers. This is an opportunity to deliver meaningful value for Modeler customers today while helping PTC explore what comes next for model-based and systems engineering.


Responsibilities:

Lead PTC Modeler

  • Own and communicate the product strategy, roadmap, priorities, and measurable outcomes for PTC Modeler.
  • Balance near-term customer commitments, product quality, platform evolution, competitive differentiation, and longer-term strategic opportunities.

Understand Customers, Practitioners, and the Market

  • Collaborate across the broader PTC portfolio spanning Codebeamer, AI, Pure Variants, Modeler as well as PLM offerings to identify cross-product customer value and avoid treating MBSE as an isolated discipline.

Required Skills and Experience

Toolbx · Job description

Growth Marketing Manager

Reports to the Senior Director of Growth · Full-time, permanent · Remote

About Toolbx

Contractors count on independent building suppliers every day. Many are family-run businesses that compete with national chains by knowing their customers and helping them get the job done.

Toolbx brings their contractor accounts, ordering, quoting, online storefront and payments together. Contractors can order and pay from their phones, while supplier teams spend less time entering orders and chasing payments. Toolbx connects with the ERP systems suppliers already use.

Forge AI is the assistant in Toolbx that helps supplier teams get work done, so less of their day goes on manual tasks. With AI Order Entry, it turns emailed material lists, takeoffs and PDFs into quotes for the team to review and send to their ERP. We're building Forge to take on more of the work supplier teams do every day.

More than 200 building suppliers use Toolbx across 1,000+ locations. We work with buying groups including Do it Best, LBM Advantage and LMC, and we're expanding beyond lumber and building materials into new verticals.

The role

Toolbx is hiring a Growth Marketing Manager, reporting to our Senior Director of Growth. You will find the independent building suppliers most likely to become customers and turn them into pipelines with Sales. You will own the acquisition plan and channel decisions, manage the approved demand budget and deliver a quarterly sourced-pipeline target. Your primary channels are in-person events and named-account outreach, supported by paid media, search and the website. You will work with Product Marketing & Brand on positioning, content and the marketing plan. We're looking for someone analytical and fast-moving who wants to help independent suppliers use technology to grow and compete.

What you will own

  • Build the quarterly acquisition plan within the integrated marketing plan, and agree sourced-pipeline targets with Sales
  • Segment audiences, then set up, launch and manage acquisition campaigns
  • Run ABM programs to named accounts, agreeing account selection, offers and follow-up with Sales
  • Design outbound plays with Sales for named accounts, including targeting, offers and sequence content. Sales and SDRs run the outreach.
  • Run the trade show, conference and field event calendar, from selection and budget to outreach, lead capture and follow-up
  • Support buying-group and association partnerships with partner events and member outreach
  • Set up, promote and follow up on prospect webinars
  • Own prospect email and nurture programs, from build and send to optimization, using content from Product Marketing
  • Run paid media, search and social in support of events and ABM, and test referrals
  • Own website conversion performance and SEO, including campaign landing pages, forms, analytics and conversion tests
  • Build and maintain ICP target lists, scoring and campaign workflows in HubSpot, with agreed Sales handoff rules
  • Write and test ad, email and landing-page copy, and roll out what wins
  • Support launches, content and customer programs with targeting, distribution and lead capture
  • Work within Product Marketing’s positioning and messaging. Product Marketing owns page content, product content and webinar content; this role owns targeting, distribution and conversion.
  • Allocate the demand budget across channels based on results and sales feedback
  • Track campaign sources and results so channels can be compared
  • Review pipeline weekly with Sales and report monthly on spend, pipeline and conversion
  • Use and improve the team’s AI workflows for research, campaign production and reporting
  • Manage agencies and freelancers
  • Lead, coach and support the Marketing Coordinator

Your first 90 days

  • Audit current acquisition campaigns and channel performance, and present what to keep, cut, test and grow
  • Take over the acquisition campaigns and events in progress, including their committed budget
  • Agree the sourced-pipeline definition, quarterly target and reporting baseline with Sales
  • Launch an ABM pilot with Sales on a set of named accounts
  • Set up the weekly pipeline review and monthly channel report

How success will be measured

  • Sourced qualified pipeline ($) against quarterly target
  • Cost per qualified opportunity and CAC payback
  • Conversion from sourced opportunity to closed-won customer
  • MQL to SQL to opportunity conversion rates
  • Pipeline and ROI per event

You are a strong candidate if you

  • Have 5+ years in B2B marketing, ideally with a SaaS or platform product
  • Have marketed to a traditional, relationship-driven industry; construction, distribution, wholesale or similar is an asset
  • Have owned a sourced-pipeline target and can walk us through the numbers, including what missed and what you changed
  • Have run trade shows, field events and ABM, and know how to allocate budget across channels
  • Have marketed into a defined market of named accounts rather than high-volume lead gen
  • Are hands-on with HubSpot, Google and LinkedIn Ads, and GA4. Experience with ABM tools is a plus.
  • Have designed A/B tests, written the copy for them, and can explain what changed as a result
  • Are comfortable working directly with Sales and treat pipeline, not impressions, as the scoreboard
  • Have coached team members and coordinated agencies or freelancers
  • Use AI tools daily, with a clear process for checking their output
  • Spot upcoming challenges early and act on them
  • Make hard, fast decisions in a data-driven environment
  • Collaborate well with cross-functional teams

Why join us?

  • Competitive compensation with opportunity for growth and equity eligibility
  • Comprehensive benefits plan
  • Quarterly virtual team events
  • No formal dress code, and we'll give you Toolbx swag to rock
  • Experience with a fast-growing start-up
  • A chance to make a huge impact in the trillion-dollar construction industry
  • Outstanding company culture

Compensation, travel and terms

Salary range

Competitive

Travel

Occasional travel to industry events

Terms of employment

Full-time, permanent

Remote

jobs.excerpt: 1.  About the Solidarity for African Women’s Rights Coalition and Equality Now The Solidarity for African Women’s Rights (SOAWR) is a Coalition of over 70 civil society organisations based in 33 African countries.
jobs.description:
1. About the Solidarity for African Women’s Rights Coalition and Equality Now

The Solidarity for African Women’s Rights (SOAWR) is a Coalition of over 70 civil society organisations based in 33 African countries. Established in 2004, SOAWR ensures that the rights of girls and women, as articulated in the Protocol to the African Charter on Human and Peoples’ Rights on the Rights of Women in Africa (“the Maputo Protocol”), are prioritised by policymakers on the African continent.

Equality Now is a worldwide human rights organisation dedicated to securing the legal and systemic change needed to end discrimination against all women and girls, everywhere in the world. Since its inception in 1992, it has played a role in reforming 140 discriminatory laws globally, positively impacting the lives of hundreds of millions of women and girls, their communities and nations, both now and for generations to come. Working with partners at national, regional and global levels, Equality Now draws on deep legal expertise and a diverse range of social, political and cultural perspectives to continue to lead the way in steering, shaping and driving the change needed to achieve enduring gender equality, to the benefit of all. For more information about Equality Now, visit
.

2.About the Africa Gender Equality Moot Court Competition (AGEMCC)

Since 2021, Equality Now and the SOAWR Coalition have hosted the Africa Gender Equality Moot Court Competition (AGEMCC). It is the first moot court competition dedicated solely to the rights of women and girls in Africa. The Competition seeks to build interest among the next generation of African legal practitioners in the rights of women and girls, and in the role of continental and international human rights instruments in protecting, promoting and enforcing those rights. Competitors are encouraged to draw on the legal and social contexts of their own countries in crafting arguments, while learning from the contexts and experiences of other participants. The Competition challenges students to engage in comparative research on legal standards at regional, continental and international levels, and to develop written and oral arguments on cutting-edge questions at the intersection of the rights of women and girls in Africa and both continental and international law. It is conducted in English and French.

3. The 4th edition

The 4th edition is expected to follow a hybrid format: virtual preliminary and quarterfinal rounds, followed by in-person semifinals, finals and an award ceremony in partnership with the partner university. The Competition will be conducted in English and French (the Anglophone and Francophone components), with each team represented by two agents.

4. The Consultancy

4.1 Purpose

Equality Now and SOAWR are seeking a consultant (or consulting team) to lead the design and management of the 4th edition of the AGEMCC from start to finish.

4.2. Overall Objective

To engage a qualified consultant or team of consultants to lead the design, planning, coordination and delivery of the 4th edition of the AGEMCC, ensuring an effective, high-quality and bilingual Competition that will strengthen law students’ capacity to apply the Maputo Protocol and related regional and international human rights standards.

4.3 Specific objectives

  1. Develop a comprehensive Competition framework, including the theme, concept note, moot question (hypothetical case), rules of procedure, scoring criteria and supporting materials in English and French.
  2. Establish strategic partnerships and stakeholder engagement including a suitable partner university, academic institutions, judges, coaches, SOAWR members and other relevant stakeholders to support the effective delivery of the Competition.
  3. Provide end-to-end design, delivery and management of the 4th edition of the AGEMCC, including outreach and registration, team selection, memorial submissions and evaluation, virtual rounds, in-person semifinals and finals, and the award ceremony.
  4. Develop and implement outreach strategies that expand participation among African law students and universities, with attention to geographical representation and equitable participation in the English and French components.
  5. An inclusive outreach and participation process implemented, resulting in engagement of law faculties and students from different African countries and meaningful representation in both the English- and French-language components.
  6. Document lessons, collect feedback, assess results and prepare recommendations and a handover toolkit to inform subsequent editions of AGEMCC.

4.4 Expected outcomes

1. A well-designed and effectively delivered Competition, implemented according to an agreed workplan and timeline, with high-quality Competition materials available in English and French.

2. A suitable partner university and strategic partnerships are secured, with clearly defined roles and responsibilities for the partner institution, academic partners, judges, coaches, SOAWR members and other relevant stakeholders involved in the Competition.

3. The 4th edition of AGEMCC successfully coordinated and delivered, with all competition stages; including outreach, registration, team selection, memorial submissions and evaluation, virtual rounds, in-person semifinals and finals, and the award ceremony; implemented in accordance with the approved framework and workplan.

4. A comprehensive record of the Competition and its implementation produced, including documented lessons, stakeholder and participant feedback, an assessment of results against agreed indicators, recommendations and a handover toolkit to support the planning and delivery of subsequent editions.

5. Scope of Work

The Consultant is expected to provide end-to-end management and coordination of the 4th edition of the AGEMCC. This includes the conceptualisation, planning, and day-to-day management to ensure a well-coordinated, successful, and impactful Competition.

The Consultant will be responsible primarily for the following, however, additional tasks may be assigned as needed for the success of the Competition, and shall be agreed between the consultant and Equality Now.

5.1 Conceptualisation and Partnership Development

  1. Review documentation from previous editions (concept notes, rules, moot problems, scoring sheets, evaluation reports) and propose improvements for the 4th edition.
  2. Develop the concept note, work plan, and budget for the 4th edition in consultation with Equality Now.
  3. Lead in selecting the theme and in developing the moot problem, bench memorandum, rules and scoring criteria in English and French.
  4. Identify and shortlist potential partner universities, lead outreach and negotiations, and support the drafting of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) defining roles, venue, cost-sharing and visibility.
  5. Maintain the relationship with the partner university and its faculty throughout the Competition.
  6. Support resource mobilization where requested (for example, sponsor or in-kind support proposals).

5.2. Administrative Coordination

  1. Coordinate planning meetings, taking notes and following up on action points.
  2. Coordinate the implementation and follow-up of decisions with different actors.
  3. Provide administrative coordination for the AGEMCC, planning and executing the virtual and in-person aspects of the Competition.
  4. Coordinate logistical arrangements for participants and judges, including managing Zoom sessions for the virtual rounds, and collaborating with the finance and administrative team and the partner university to coordinate travel, visa and accommodation arrangements.
  5. Collate and analyze scores from the judges after each round, compile the score sheets, and submit them to the moot coordinating team.
  6. Prepare schedules and coordinate the timely flow of the different rounds and parallel courts, ensuring that all participants and judges log in on time.
  7. Keep accurate records of participants and judges to facilitate internet reimbursements, payment of honoraria to judges, and issuance of certificates.
  8. Recruit, coordinate and manage court bailiffs for the different rounds.
  9. Recruit and brief judges for each round, ensuring balance in language, gender and regional expertise.
  10. Prepare and track the activity budget and process payment requests in line with Equality Now's financial procedures.

5.3 Communication and Participant Support

  1. Coordinate and facilitate virtual information sessions with moot court participants.
  2. Issue the call for registration to law faculties across Africa in English and French, and manage registration and team selection.
  3. Serve as the primary point of contact for participating teams, providing essential information, updates, and resources.
  4. Act as the primary contact for all communication with participants regarding scheduling, fiscal support, record management, and rules enforcement.
  5. Oversee the management of the moot court email address, ensuring timely responses and appropriate distribution of relevant messages.
  6. Communicate announcements and relevant information to participants, judges, university representatives, and audience members, ensuring smooth logistics.
  7. Assist with external communications and publicity, drafting and editing social media posts, press releases, statements, and marketing materials.

5.4 Evaluation and Feedback

  1. Prepare summaries of Competition evaluations, including feedback from judges and participants, with recommendations for program improvement.
  2. Prepare a comprehensive report after the Competition analyzing its success, identifying strengths, weaknesses, and areas for improvement, with proposed strategies for enhancement in subsequent competitions, and a handover toolkit for future editions.

6. Deliverables

  1. Inception report with work plan, timeline, and budget.
  2. Develop and propose theme options for the 4th edition, with a short rationale for each, for the organizing committee to select from.
  3. Develop the hypothetical case, bench memorandum, rules, registration forms and scoring criteria in English and French, including peer review and translation.
  4. Shortlist and mapping of potential partner universities and a signed MoU with the selected partner university.
  5. Meeting minutes documenting discussions and action points from planning meetings.
  6. Training materials, including presentations, handouts, and case materials.
  7. Weekly update/progress reports.
  8. Registration and team selection report
  9. Judges' panel and briefing materials.
  10. Final report summarizing the outcomes of the Competition, including participant feedback, key achievements, and recommendations for future events, together with the handover toolkit.

7. Time Commitment

The consultancy period spans from December 2026- September 2027.

8.Relevant Skills and Experience

  • First degree in law, international relations, gender studies, human rights, or the humanities required; an advanced degree is an advantage.
  • At least five years of experience coordinating regional or national moot court competitions is required.
  • A minimum of two years of experience supporting human rights, gender equality, or women's empowerment is required.
  • Demonstrated experience in partnership and stakeholder management, including with universities.
  • Solid legal analysis and writing skills, as well as sound knowledge of international and regional instruments on women's rights.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and French required.
  • Demonstrable skills and experience in communicating with a wide range of actors, including high-level representatives from national governments and intergovernmental organizations, judicial and quasi-judicial institutions at the national and regional levels, academia, and civil society, as well as with students, university administrators, and members of the public.
  • Strong dispute-resolution skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex problems when they arise.
  • Strong organizational skills, including the ability to work effectively with minimal supervision, impeccable attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Strong time management skills and the ability to work across multiple time zones.
  • Excellent professionalism, including a commitment to upholding high confidentiality, competence, integrity, accountability, and credibility standards.

9. Reporting and Key Stakeholders

The consultant will report to the Associate Director, Legal Equality and work primarily with the designated Legal Advisor responsible for overseeing the AGEMCC.

10. Remuneration

  • Candidates will send a financial proposal; selection will be based on the technical and financial proposals.
  • The consultancy fees shall be subject to relevant statutory deductions under Kenyan law, and may be payable on a monthly pro-rated basis or based on the fulfilment of the deliverables.

11. Application Procedure

Interested and qualified applicants are invited to visit: and submit their applications.The application deadline is 20th November 2026. The application should include the following documents merged into one PDF:

  • A cover letter of not more than two pages indicating the candidate's skills, experience, and understanding of the terms of reference of the consultancy.
  • A curriculum vitae (not more than 3 pages) indicating educational background, professional qualifications, relevant experience, and contact information (phone and email).
  • The email addresses and phone contacts of three professional references who can attest to past work experience; at least one must be able to attest to the applicant's experience coordinating regional or national moot court competitions.
  • A short technical proposal (maximum 3 pages) outlining the proposed approach and work plan, including how the consultant would identify a partner university.
  • A financial proposal.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

jobs.description:
Senior Director, Test Administration Deliver

College Board - Operations

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type: This is a full-time position

Preferred Application Deadline: Monday, November 30th. College Board offices will be closed November 26th – November 27th and December 25th – January 1st.


About the Team

College Board’s Operations division is a best-in-class digital assessment delivery and customer engagement function that supports millions of students and thousands of test centers, annually. The Operations team is also leading exciting work to advance customer experience using innovative solutions, products, and technology to enhance the end-to-end delivery of digital assessments and all aspects of customer support. Within Operations, the Assessment Delivery Operations (ADO) team is responsible for the successful execution of digital assessments like the SAT and Advanced Placement examinations, working closely with partners across College Board, the education sector, and beyond to improve testing technologies, customer experience, and outcomes. ADO’s Deliver function supports this work by ensuring a smooth test day experience for students, resolving issues in real-time so as many students as possible can complete testing as scheduled.


About the Opportunity

As the Senior Director, Test Administration Deliver, you will lead how College Board delivers test day for millions of students taking digital assessments like the SAT and AP Exams. You will own the operating model and severity framework that determine how test-day issues are detected, escalated, and contained in real time, so students and testing staff have a consistent experience even when things go wrong. Leading a team of five, you will turn test-day data into prevention, scale the work through tooling and automation, and shape test-day operations for College Board’s next-generation Bluebook platform. This role is highly visible and dynamic, working in real-time with your team to remove obstacles to testing for students around the globe.


In this role, you will:

Set Test-Day Strategy and Operating Model (30%)

  • Own the test-day operating model for College Board’s digital assessments, including the standards for how issues are triaged, escalated, and communicated across SAT weekend, school-day, state, AP, and international administrations.
  • Own the severity framework for test-day issues: declare severity, set response expectations for each level, and direct the response that follows.
  • Facilitate high-stakes briefings with the Executive Leadership team on crisis response plans, presenting clear POV on cause, solutions, and how learnings will be integrated into continuous improvement efforts.
  • Enhance change management framework as the pace and sophistication of threats to test day evolve and change.
  • Extend the severity framework and escalation model beyond test day to support customers across the full school-year testing cycle.
  • Set handoff standards with partner teams, transitioning issues to the Resolve team once irregularities are declared after test day.
  • Lead test-day operational readiness for the next-generation Bluebook platform: define the requirements the platform must meet to support test day and ensure processes and the team are ready for the upcoming pilot.
  • Own prioritization and resourcing decisions across the test-day portfolio, balancing administration volume, risk, and team capacity.

Lead Real-Time Test-Day Response (25%)

  • Command and control in executive level settings for critical test day issues
  • Set the standards for real-time monitoring of test administrations across global time zones, so disruptions are identified and contained quickly.
  • Direct College Board’s coordinated customer response during test-day disruptions, aligning Customer Care, Technology, and program teams on a single course of action.
  • Advise Operations leadership on emerging test-day risks and their implications, escalating critical issues with a recommended course of action.
  • Set the direction for College Board’s test-day observation program so staff observations produce actionable insight into the testing experience.

Scale Through Data, Tooling, and Automation (20%)

  • Set the roadmap for data, tooling, and automation across test-day monitoring, escalation, and reporting, so the team scales with administration volume.
  • Secure Technology and Product commitment to the features that roadmap requires, representing customer needs in prioritization decisions.
  • Establish early-warning measures that predict operational, technical, or external disruptions, and use them to shift the team from reactive response to prevention.
  • Define test-day performance metrics and translate results into decisions on process, investment, and priorities.

Lead and Manage the Deliver Team (25%)

  • Lead a high performing team of five that is responsible for real-time monitoring, escalation, and communication during test administrations.
  • Set vision and priorities for the team, track and manage progress to goals, and provide coaching and support to ensure team members meet and exceed goals, remain engaged, and contribute meaningfully to our mission.
  • Cultivate an inclusive and high-achieving culture that enables all team members to live out College Board’s Operating Principles effectively.
  • Bring proven leadership experience and consistently embody College Board’s Manager Expectations in your work.
  • Design the team’s structure and coverage model so response quality holds across time zones and peak administration windows.
  • Build team capability in data, tooling, and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Develop team members for high performance and build bench strength for future talent planning and succession needs.

About You

You have

  • 10+ years of progressive operations and people leadership experience with expertise leading real-time, high-stakes operations (e.g., incident management, command-center, or other time-critical environments), including making and owning decisions under pressure
  • A bachelor's degree in business (or related field) required, master's degree preferred
  • A strategic and inclusive leadership style: you set clear priorities, build effective team structures, plan for future needs, and foster a culture of belonging.
  • A proven ability to drive performance and growth through management: you set high expectations, deliver real-time, evidence-based feedback, and coach team members to take smart risks, stretch their skills, and achieve meaningful impact.
  • Experience leading and developing an operations team, including setting team strategy, structure, and coverage.
  • A track record of setting multi-year direction for an operations function and translating it into an executable roadmap.
  • Experience setting direction for automation, tooling, or data infrastructure that measurably reduce manual effort or improve response.
  • Fluency using data and dashboards to track performance, identify trends, and drive decisions. Experience with tools such as Slack, Jira, and Tableau is a plus.
  • Experience influencing Technology and Product roadmaps and presenting strategy and risk to senior leaders.
  • The ability to travel 4-6 times a year to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business.
  • This team provides on-call support during test administrations, which can include evenings and weekends due to international support and weekend administrations (9) throughout the year.

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck- we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.


A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $104,000–$160,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

Avantor is seeking a highly experienced Principal Portfolio Project Manager to lead a portfolio of complex, global programs and capital investments within its Life Sciences business. This role is responsible for both portfolio management and project execution, ensuring strategic initiatives are appropriately prioritized, funded, governed, and delivered to achieve business objectives.

The position oversees multiple large-scale CAPEX and business transformation initiatives simultaneously, including projects related to manufacturing, engineering, operations, EHS, PSM, IT, real estate, supply chain, and commercial functions. The successful candidate will operate within a matrixed global organization, coordinating cross-functional teams, external vendors, municipalities, and suppliers to deliver projects that meet or exceed approved business case objectives.

In addition to leading individual programs and projects, this role will manage a portfolio of strategic investments, balancing priorities, resources, risks, and capital allocation to maximize business value. Projects may range up to $100M, requiring strong executive communication, strategic leadership, disciplined governance, and a proven track record of delivering measurable business outcomes.

How you will thrive and create an impact


Portfolio Management & Strategic Prioritization

o Manage a portfolio of strategic initiatives and capital investments across Engineering, Operations, EHS, PSM, Real Estate, IT, Supply Chain, and Commercial functions.

o Evaluate, prioritize, and balance project investments based on strategic alignment, business value, risk, resource availability, and organizational capacity.

o Partner with business leaders to develop and maintain multi-year portfolio roadmaps supporting Avantor's strategic objectives.

o Facilitate portfolio governance reviews, investment decisions, funding approvals, and executive prioritization discussions.

o Identify portfolio-level risks, dependencies, constraints, and opportunities to optimize value delivery.

o Develop executive portfolio dashboards and reporting to provide visibility into capital deployment, resource utilization, project performance, and business outcomes.

o Ensure portfolio investments align with approved business cases, operational priorities, and enterprise strategy.


Global Program Leadership

o Lead and manage multiple concurrent global programs and CAPEX projects across manufacturing and operational domains.

o Drive end-to-end project execution from concept through commissioning, qualification, startup, and operational handover.

o Ensure programs align with Avantor's strategic objectives, operational priorities, and Life Sciences growth initiatives.

o Lead global cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority to achieve program objectives.


CAPEX & Manufacturing Project Execution

o Manage projects involving process equipment, assembly systems, manufacturing technologies, automation, and facility infrastructure across global locations.

o Lead facility expansions, process improvements, equipment installations, operational efficiency projects, and capital investment programs.

o Support projects focused on EHS, PSM, IT, Commercial, Supply Chain, and Real Estate initiatives.

o Ensure technical solutions meet quality, compliance, safety, operational, and business requirements.

o Manage projects and programs that may exceed $50M in capital investment.


Stage-Gate Governance

o Drive projects through a structured stage-gate process, ensuring appropriate documentation, stakeholder engagement, approvals, and governance at each phase.

o Prepare and present business cases, project charters, gate reviews, and investment recommendations to senior leadership.

o Support enterprise portfolio governance processes to ensure projects are appropriately prioritized, funded, and aligned with corporate objectives.

o Lead executive reviews and provide recommendations regarding project continuation, acceleration, modification, or termination.

Financial & Schedule Management

o Maintain rigorous control of project budgets, forecasts, schedules, risks, and financial performance.

o Manage portfolio-level capital planning, forecasting, cash flow projections, and benefit realization tracking.

o Ensure projects achieve approved business case objectives and KPI targets.

o Develop and manage integrated schedules, proactively identifying and mitigating risks affecting cost and timing.

o Optimize allocation of capital and resources across competing initiatives.


Business Case Development & Benefits Realization

o Develop, validate, and maintain project business cases and investment justifications.

o Establish measurable KPIs and benefit realization targets for each initiative.

o Track actual business performance against approved commitments following implementation.

o Ensure projects deliver expected productivity, capacity, quality, compliance, cost reduction, and revenue objectives.


Stakeholder & Vendor Management

o Collaborate with stakeholders across Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Commercial, EHS, and IT organizations.

o Manage relationships with external contractors, equipment suppliers, engineering firms, consultants, regulatory agencies, and municipalities.

o Support procurement activities, vendor selection processes, contract negotiations, and supplier performance management.


Leadership & Team Management

o Provide direct and indirect leadership to project teams across multiple regions and business functions.

o Influence stakeholders and leaders within a highly matrixed organization.

o Foster collaboration, accountability, transparency, and execution excellence.

o Mentor and coach project managers and team members on project management best practices.


Executive Communication & Influence

o Communicate project, program, and portfolio performance clearly and effectively to executive leadership.

o Deliver concise, data-driven reporting on portfolio health, capital deployment, project status, risks, and business outcomes.

o Build strong relationships with senior leaders and external partners.

o Present complex technical and business issues in a manner that supports informed decision-making and organizational alignment.


Change Management & Organizational Readiness

o Drive stakeholder engagement, communication planning, organizational readiness, and adoption activities.

o Ensure business operations are prepared to successfully transition into new processes, systems, and facility capabilities.

o Support sustainable implementation and realization of expected business benefits.


Independent Judgment & Advanced Problem Solving

o Operate with a high degree of autonomy and accountability.

o Independently plan and execute work while addressing complex issues, risks, and deviations.

o Analyze ambiguous situations involving operational, financial, technical, and organizational considerations.

o Apply strategic thinking and sound judgment to develop scalable solutions.

o Make significant recommendations regarding investment priorities, resource allocation, and execution strategies.

Expertise, Thought Leadership & Development

o Serve as a subject matter expert in portfolio management, capital program execution, project governance, and PMO best practices.

o Contribute to continuous improvement of project management methodologies, stage-gate processes, governance frameworks, and portfolio management practices.

o Provide coaching, mentoring, and informal training across the PMO organization.


What we're looking for


o Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Operations, Manufacturing, Business, or related discipline.

o Minimum of 12 years of progressive project, program, and portfolio management experience, including leadership of global CAPEX projects and strategic business initiatives.

o Demonstrated success managing large-scale capital projects and cross-functional business programs.

o PMP certification from the Project Management Institute (PMI), or willingness to obtain within a defined timeframe.

Preferred

o Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration (MBA), Project Management, or related discipline.

o Experience in Life Sciences, pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, specialty chemicals, or similarly regulated industries.

Portfolio Management

o Proven experience managing portfolios of strategic initiatives and capital investments.

o Strong understanding of portfolio governance, prioritization methodologies, capital planning, and resource optimization.

o Ability to balance competing priorities and recommend investments that maximize organizational value.

o Experience providing executive portfolio reporting and facilitating investment decisions.

Strategic & Conceptual Thinking

o Strong understanding of business strategy, operations, financial planning, and organizational goals.

o Ability to translate complex business challenges into executable solutions.

o Capable of evaluating long-term implications of investment decisions.


Project & Program Mastery

o Extensive knowledge of project management principles and lifecycle methodologies.

o Proven ability to manage scope, schedule, budget, resources, and risk across global programs.

o Strong record of delivering large-scale, multi-site CAPEX initiatives.


Leadership & Influence

o Ability to lead multiple projects and programs simultaneously.

o Skilled at influencing leaders and teams without direct authority.

o Trusted advisor to senior stakeholders.


Communication & Executive Presence

o Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.

o Strong presentation and facilitation capabilities.

o Ability to communicate effectively with executives, business leaders, and technical teams.


Collaboration & External Engagement

o Strong negotiation and relationship management skills.

o Experience working with contractors, vendors, engineering firms, regulators, and municipalities.

o Ability to develop productive partnerships across diverse stakeholder groups.

Disclaimer:

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Avantor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Scope of Work

  3. Review and strengthen the legal framework supporting the project's evaluation taxonomy.
  4. Evaluate AI-generated responses for legal reasoning, treatment of uncertainty, and appropriate recognition of limitations.

  3. Strong knowledge of the Geneva Conventions, Additional Protocols, customary international humanitarian law, and relevant ROE frameworks.
  4. Experience serving in a command, combatant command legal office, or targeting cell within US or allied forces.
  5. Background in operational legal reviews, teaching, or advisory responsibilities.
  6. Excellent legal writing, analytical, and communication skills.

About the Role

As an experienced HR Advisor, you will play a key role in delivering the day-to-day people agenda across the Group. You will provide practical, commercially focused HR advice and guidance to managers and senior stakeholders, ensuring that people matters are managed consistently, fairly and in line with employment legislation and company policies.

You will take ownership of employee relations matters from initial advice through to resolution, including disciplinary, grievance and change management processes, whilst supporting managers to effectively manage performance, attendance, conduct and employee wellbeing.

The role will also have a strong operational focus, including supporting the end-to-end payroll process, maintaining HR systems and ensuring accurate employee records and data.

There will be a significant focus on end-to-end recruitment and onboarding, taking ownership of the recruitment process across the Group and partnering closely with hiring managers to attract and retain high-quality talent.

What you’ll be doing

  • Take ownership of an employee relations case load seeing cases through from initial advice through to resolution. Ensuring cases are managed fairly, consistently and in line with company policy and UK employment legislation.

  • Partner with hiring managers to understand current and future recruitment requirements and manage vacancies through the Group's ATS, Teamtailor, ensuring recruitment activity is accurately recorded and progressed. Support and manage assessment centres as required, proactively sourcing candidates through LinkedIn and other recruitment channels.

  • Support the end-to-end monthly payroll process, working closely with the embedded payroll team to ensure accurate and timely payroll processing. This will include preparing and checking payroll information, processing starters, leavers and contractual changes, managing salary and benefit amendments, checking payroll reports and resolving payroll queries.

  • Ensure payroll-related changes are accurately reflected in the HR system and communicated within the required payroll deadlines, maintaining appropriate records and confidentiality.

  • Ensure HR processes are managed consistently and confidentially, in line with UK employment legislation and company policies.

  • Manage the onboarding and exiting processes, including drafting offers of employment and employment contracts, ensuring new starters are set up correctly within the HR system, completing employment references and supporting company inductions. Manage employee exits, including exit interviews and providing insights to the business on emerging trends.

  • Support and deliver ad hoc HR projects, contributing to wider team initiatives whilst taking accountability for individually assigned projects.

  • Maintain accurate and confidential employee information within the HR system, ensuring data integrity at all times.

What we’re looking for

  • You will have a confident and collaborative approach to managing ER matters

  • Excellent understanding of UK Employment law and case load management

  • Familiar with HRIS, ATS and LinkedIn recruiter

  • You will have great attention to detail, time management and organisation skills.

  • You will enjoy working under pressure at a fast pace.

  • You have a working knowledge of HR functions and best practices.

  • Exceptional interpersonal skills.

  • Have or working towards CIPD Level 5 or proven equivalent experience.

  • Working knowledge of Team Tailor and HiBob is desirable.

What you’ll get

You’ll work with a collaborative team and where you’ll get the chance to learn and develop, and if that’s not enough, you also receive the following benefits.

  • 25 days holiday per year

  • Private Medical

  • Life Assurance

  • Cycle to work

  • Income Protection

  • Workplace Pension

Educate, Discover & Inspire

From our dedicated in-house Sales and Operations training programmes that support career development, to DNA Day where we come together to celebrate our people and culture, we’re committed to investing in our teams. jobs.excerpt: You’ve discovered something special.  A company that cares.
jobs.description:
You’ve discovered something special. A company that cares. Cares about leading the way in construction, engineering, manufacturing and renewable energy. Cares about redefining how energy is designed, applied and consumed. Cares about thoughtfully growing to meet market demands. And ─ as “one of the Healthiest 100 Workplaces in America” ─ is focused on the mind/body/soul of team members through our Culture of Care.

The Associate Product Architect works within the Product Development organization to develop and maintain standard product architectures, requirements, and reusable solutions for ETO Modular Product Platforms. This individual coordinates with Product Architects, Program Design Managers, Product Developers, Preconstruction, engineering, manufacturing, and other cross-functional stakeholders to convert conceptual ideas, customer requirements, technical challenges, manufacturing feedback, site integration lessons learned, and operational needs into defined product improvements, standardized designs, and reusable solutions.

This role supports development and maintenance of Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), Component Definition Documents (CDDs), specifications, scope documents and matrices, Illustrated Basis of Design (iBODs), client submittals, vendor and site specific permit submittals, ETO submittals, master Revit models, early Long Lead Equipment (LLE) Bills of Material (BOMs), and other design intent documentation that provides the engineering baseline for downstream Detailed Design, strategic procurement, and manufacturing readiness.

The Associate Product Architect supports ownership of assigned product areas by ensuring requirements, design intent, technical decisions, assumptions, deviations, and lessons learned are accurately documented and continuously improved.

Ideal candidate will have experience or demonstrated capabilities withETO product design and lifecycle development, Modular Product Platforms or other complex integrated systems, concept development through detailed design transition, product requirements development and management, product standardization strategies and reusable design solutions, and reading, understanding, and interpreting construction design documentation. Will be familiar with developing and maintaining PRDs, CDDs, specifications, iBODs, scope documents, as well as requirement matrices, programmatic, permit, site-specific, and vendor product submittal processes. Able to facilitate cross-functional technical coordination and have knowledge of manufacturing, procurement, fabrication, and construction integration processes. Will capture lessons learned and convert them into product improvements and understand impacts of design decisions across engineering, manufacturing, installation, and lifecycle performance as well as applicable codes, standards, and industry requirements. Will have a strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, Revit (BIM), Autodesk Forma, Navisworks, and Bluebeam and a working knowledge of AutoCAD Electrical, Inventor (CAD), Vault (PDM), Fusion Manage (PLM), Acumatica (ERP), or related tools.

Success in this role requires the ability to balance product flexibility with standardization while understanding impacts across concept development, engineering, procurement, fabrication, manufacturing, construction integration, and lifecycle performance.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

Education: Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Engineering Technology, or related technical discipline preferred.

Experience: 3+ years of experience in engineering, product development, manufacturing, modular construction, or mission critical environments.

Travel: 10-50%

Work Schedule: This position works between the hours of 7 AM and 5 PM, Monday- Friday. However, work may be performed at any time on any day of the week to meet business needs.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Leads, coaches, and mentors direct reports.
  • Perform all responsibilities of an Assistant Product Architect while independently owning assigned product features, systems, or technical areas.
  • Develops and maintains product requirements, standards, documentation, and reusable design solutions.
  • Develops and maintains master Revit models, reusable BIM content, and product configuration standards.
  • Translates ambiguous concepts into clear technical direction and requirements.
  • Reviews client and program requirements against standard product offerings.
  • Identifies product gaps, improvement opportunities, and required development activities.
  • Develops and maintains PRDs, CDDs, specifications, scope documents/matrices, iBODs, submittals, and design documentation.
  • Develops early Long Lead Equipment (LLE) Bills of Material (BOMs) supporting strategic procurement planning.
  • Coordinates with Product Developers to create models, drawings, and technical deliverables.
  • Coordinates closely with Program Design Managers and Preconstruction during concept development and requirements definition.
  • Coordinates with Program Design Managers and Preconstruction to align client and project needs with standard product capabilities.
  • Coordinates cross-functional design reviews and resolve technical challenges within assigned product scope.
  • Evaluates product compliance with applicable codes, specifications, and customer requirements.
  • Incorporates lessons learned from detailed engineering, fabrication, manufacturing, procurement, and field deployment into future product improvements.
  • Develops engineering baseline documentation supporting downstream Detailed Design.
  • Drives improvements in manufacturability, constructability, cost, quality, scalability, and lifecycle performance.
  • Performs other related duties as required and assigned.

Locations

We are investing in remote Regional Field Sales roles across the EMEA region.


Our Story

The world’s innovators, designers, engineers, builders and creators trust Autodesk to help them design and make a better world for all.


Autodesk’s Design and Make Platform empowers customers to transform how they work through cloud-connected technology, automation, AI, data and insights. From the buildings and infrastructure around us to the products we use and the entertainment that inspires us, Autodesk technology helps our customers design and make the world around us.


Our customers are navigating significant change, including sustainability pressures, labor and supply-chain challenges, rapid technological advancement and increasing digital complexity. Global Expansion Sales helps them unlock greater value from Autodesk by uncovering new opportunities, expanding adoption and connecting Autodesk solutions to their most important business priorities.


Position Overview

As an Account Executive in Global Expansion Sales, you will lead Autodesk’s growth strategy across a focused portfolio of assigned customers.


You will operate as a senior business partner to the customer, bringing a hunter mindset to existing relationships: creating new demand, uncovering substantial whitespace, opening new buying centers and expanding Autodesk into strategic workflows, business units and transformation initiatives.


You will be expected to lead complex, high-value enterprise sales cycles, including seven-figure opportunities and multi-year commercial agreements, while orchestrating the broader Autodesk ecosystem around a common customer strategy. Success will be measured through sustained expansion growth, material pipeline creation, increased share of wallet, executive sponsorship, customer outcomes and forecast accuracy.


Responsibilities

  • Own and lead the multi-year growth and expansion strategy for assigned customers.
  • Develop deep knowledge of each customer’s business model, strategic objectives, operating environment, industry dynamics and transformation agenda.
  • Establish a clear point of view on where Autodesk can create differentiated business value for the customer.
  • Identify significant whitespace across business units, geographies, workflows, technology estates, user communities and executive priorities.
  • Create demand and originate large strategic opportunities, including seven-figure deals and opportunities that may not yet exist in the customer’s formal buying process.
  • Build relationships across new buying centers while deepening trusted relationships with existing stakeholders.
  • Develop C-suite and senior executive sponsorship across business and technology functions.
  • Bring external market, industry and customer insight into executive conversations, with relevant knowledge of Autodesk’s Design and Make industries.
  • Translate customer strategy into compelling multi-year value propositions, transformation roadmaps and business cases.
  • Lead complex, high-value and potentially multi-year sales cycles involving multiple business, technical, procurement, finance and legal stakeholders.
  • Develop and execute competitive strategies to win strategically significant new workloads and displace incumbent technologies.
  • Navigate sophisticated commercial arrangements and seven-figure negotiations with strong business and financial acumen.
  • Mobilize Autodesk’s executive leadership and broader organization around a unified account strategy.
  • Orchestrate Technical Sales, Customer Success, Industry, Partners, Marketing, Professional Services and other specialists at the appropriate stages of the customer journey.
  • Develop strategic ecosystem and partner relationships that increase Autodesk’s impact and relevance.
  • Maintain executive-level governance around opportunities, risks, dependencies and account priorities.
  • Apply account-planning, relationship-mapping, customer intelligence, forecasting and AI-enabled tools responsibly to support multi-year account strategy, executive engagement and opportunity governance.
  • Maintain rigorous pipeline quality and deliver accurate, evidence-based forecasts.
  • Represent the voice of the customer within Autodesk while bringing relevant Autodesk innovation, capability and thought leadership back to the customer.

What Success Looks Like

Sustained strategic revenue growth; creation and conversion of substantial new whitespace; increased Autodesk share of wallet; expansion into strategically important workloads and business initiatives; deep C-suite sponsorship; successful execution of seven-figure opportunities; strong multi-year account strategies; competitive displacement; measurable customer outcomes; and consistently high-quality forecasting.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Demonstrated success leading complex enterprise technology, SaaS, cloud or strategic software sales.
  • Proven record of creating and closing significant opportunities within large, complex customer organizations, including experience with seven-figure deals or comparable commercial complexity.
  • Demonstrated ability to create demand and develop major opportunities rather than simply manage an existing pipeline.[KS1]
  • Strong C-suite presence with the ability to engage credibly on business, industry and transformation priorities.
  • Exceptional strategic account-planning and whitespace-development capability.
  • Strong business and financial acumen and ability to build compelling economic and strategic business cases.
  • Experience leading sophisticated multi-stakeholder and multi-year sales processes.
  • Strong competitive selling, negotiation and commercial leadership capability.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead large virtual teams and influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Exceptional communication, storytelling and executive presentation skills.
  • High standards of commercial judgment, accountability, pipeline management and forecasting.
  • Demonstrated fluency with CRM, strategic account-planning, relationship-mapping, pipeline and forecasting platforms. Experience with Salesforce, Clari, Altify or comparable platforms is valued.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep knowledge of a relevant Autodesk Solution Group industry - AEC, Manufacturing or Media & Entertainment - where appropriate to the assigned customer portfolio.
  • Experience selling enterprise platforms, cloud technology or large-scale transformation solutions.
  • Experience navigating complex multinational customer organizations.
  • Demonstrated success developing multi-year executive relationships and transformation programs.
  • Track record of strategic competitive displacement and significant share-of-wallet growth.

How we work at Autodesk

At Autodesk, we work as One Autodesk and bring our One ORBIT values to life every day: Optimistic, Relentless, Brave, Ingenious and Trusted.


In this role, you will bring those values to life by leading as One Autodesk, bringing a bold and informed point of view to our customers, making smart decisions in complex environments, creating new possibilities and earning long-term trust at the highest levels of the customer organization.

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

jobs.description:
Position: Senior Strategist – Constituent Data Integrations

Hiring Range: This position’s hiring range is anticipated to be $100,000 - $130,000 annually depending on experience, plus great benefits!


Position Summary:

The Senior Strategist – Constituent Data Integrations leads the technical design, documentation, and delivery of integration architecture across the CRM, HubSpot, and the organization's connected platform ecosystem — the work that determines how constituent data moves between the systems the organization runs on. The role provides the technical capacity required to carry the organization through CRM migration and modernization, from current-state documentation through future-state design, vendor technical evaluation, and phase-gate delivery.

The role sits on the business side within Constituent Data & Business Analytics, designing integrations around how teams across the organization use constituent data. It partners closely with the rest of the team on this work.

The role contributes technical expertise to constituent data governance, ensuring architecture decisions align with the data standards approved through the Constituent Systems Governance Committee and flagging governance implications of technical design choices before they are built. It also serves as the team's technical lead on evaluating where AI and other emerging technologies can meaningfully improve the integration ecosystem.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports and calls for both technical depth and a strong understanding of how the business uses its data: comfort in API documentation, data mapping, and integration tooling, and in leading requirements conversations with business teams.


Culture Statement and Responsibility:

We believe in treating everyone with kindness and compassion, building trust through authenticity and following through on commitments. We prioritize well-being alongside our mission, fostering strong relationships through open communication and transparent feedback. Diversity and inclusion are integral to our culture, enriching team dynamics by valuing diverse perspectives. Each team member is responsible for creating an inclusive environment where all voices are respected and contributing to a workplace that embodies our shared values and commitment to progress. By consistently aligning our actions with our Guiding Principles, we strengthen our culture and ensure that our values are lived every day.


Key Responsibilities:

Integration Architecture & Design

  • Support and implement the technical design of new and existing integrations across the ecosystem (Workday, HubSpot, ShelterLuv, FundraiseUp, Snowflake, Airtable, Digital Cheetah, Maestro, Checkfront, Cvent, ControlShift, Cloud4Wi, Outlook, and future platforms) — data mapping, sync logic, APIs, and error-handling design, considering downstream impacts.
  • Partner with business leads, IT, and outside vendors on implementation, translating business requirements into specifications and ensuring designs are built as specified and documented for long-term maintainability.
  • Maintain the organization's current-state integration inventory and future-state architecture documentation.

CRM Modernization — Technical Execution

  • Serve as a primary technical contributor to modernization-related integration work: defining integration requirements based on business needs ahead of vendor selection, documenting current-state architecture, and designing how integration patterns should change under a new platform.
  • Partner with the Associate Director and IT to design identity resolution and system-of-record rules for the future-state platform, defining how constituent records are matched and linked across systems through migration and beyond.
  • Provide technical evaluation input during CRM vendor selection — data model fit, integration/API capability, and migration technical risk — in partnership with the Associate Director.
  • Support technical review and sign-off at migration phase gates for integration-related deliverables.
  • Partner with the Senior Strategist – Constituent Data Systems, the program's business steward, on business direction for the CRM migration/modernization program; own the technical resolution once direction is set.

AI & Emerging Technology Evaluation

  • Partner with the Associate Director and business stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and scope high-impact AI use cases within the integration ecosystem, translating ambiguous needs into well-defined technical requirements and roadmaps.
  • Support delivery of AI-powered tools and workflows relevant to integration and data operations — including LLM-based applications, retrieval systems, and automation pipelines — balancing speed of iteration with security, accuracy, and responsible AI principles.
  • Contribute to frameworks for evaluating AI and automation solutions (build vs. buy, vendor selection, model evaluation, cost/benefit analysis), in partnership with the Associate Director, and help define guardrails for safe and effective use.
  • Identify and evaluate emerging technologies relevant to the integration ecosystem, deploying AI-powered solutions where they meaningfully outperform traditional automation and recognizing when a simpler, non-AI approach is the better fit.

Governance

  • Contribute technical expertise to the Constituent Systems Governance Committee ensuring architecture decisions align with organizational data standards.
  • Flag governance or data-standard implications of technical design choices before they're built.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in a technical role working with CRM or business systems (for example integration design, systems analysis, business systems administration, or data engineering), ideally within or in close partnership with a business team.
  • Proven ability to translate business needs into clear technical requirements, and to explain technical tradeoffs in plain language to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including leading requirements conversations with teams such as fundraising, marketing, and operations.
  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs, data mapping, and sync logic: enough to design integrations, read API documentation, and evaluate how IT and vendors implement them.
  • Working knowledge of at least one major CRM platform (HubSpot, Blackbaud CRM or Raiser's Edge, Salesforce, or comparable) and comfort working with SQL and data models.
  • Experience creating documentation that works for both technical and business audiences, such as data flow diagrams, integration inventories, and requirements documents.
  • Experience partnering with system owners, IT teams, and outside vendors on implementation and holding builds to agreed requirements.
  • Sound judgment about when AI or automation is the right tool, and awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with constituent data.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Experience supporting a CRM or enterprise system migration, implementation, or vendor evaluation.
  • Experience with Blackbaud CRM and the BrightVine Data Link.
  • Experience with HubSpot integrations, including bidirectional sync with a CRM of record.
  • Experience with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse, and with reporting tools such as Tableau or Sigma.
  • Experience with integration or automation platforms (for example Boomi, MuleSoft, Workato, Make, Zapier, or n8n).
  • Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs, retrieval systems, or automation pipelines.
  • Understanding of fundraising, donor, or constituent engagement processes, ideally in a nonprofit or animal welfare setting.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, ancestry, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, marital status, or domestic partner status.

Applicants for employment in the U.S. must have valid work authorization that does not now and/or will not in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the U.S. by Best Friends Animal Society.
