jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Operations Coordinator — Scheduling, Dispatch & Invoicing (ServiceM8, Xero, AI Tools)

Remote | Philippines | Full-Time | Php 40,000- Php 55,000/month | Approx. 6:30 AM – 2:30 PM PHT, Mon–Fri (Australian business hours) | Long-Term Remote Role

If you’re a high-performing operations professional who has scheduled and dispatched field teams, is confident on the phone with Australian tradies, and already uses AI to work faster, and you want to work with a fast-growing Australian plumbing inspection business that values strategic impact over simple task completion — keep reading.

This isn’t a role for an “order-taker” waiting for instructions.

This is a focused, outcome-driven position where you’ll take over a live operation in three weeks, run the full booking-to-invoice cycle on your own, and build the systems that let the business grow from hundreds to thousands of inspections a year.

Why This Is a Dream Job

You’ll be working directly with the General Manager of a growing Australian plumbing inspection business serving volume home builders, who:

  • Champions Innovation: Expects you to use AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude every day, and wants your help setting up ServiceM8 scheduling, the ServiceM8 and Xero connection, and automated reminders.
  • Values Your Growth: Enrols you in a self-paced AI training program from day one, supports further learning in ServiceM8 and Xero, and gives you a dedicated Success Manager (CSM) plus an onboarding manager for your first 90 days.
  • Respects Your Expertise: Wants someone who runs the schedule, gives clear instructions, pushes back when something is missing and proposes better ways of working without being asked.
  • Builds Stability: Is hiring for the long term, with your scope growing as the business expands into new Australian states and its inspector team grows.
  • Invests in Your Wellbeing: Provides HMO health cover from month 4.

You’ll get career transformation, direct visibility with the General Manager, and the freedom to build the operation as the business scales nationally, without being stuck as a back-office admin taking messages.

What You’ll Be Owning

This is a core operations role covering bookings, inspector scheduling and dispatch, report quality control and invoicing. You aren’t just answering emails and entering jobs; you’re running the engine of the business, making sure every builder’s request is booked fast, every report goes out complete, and every job gets billed.

You’ll take the lead on:

  • A Three-Week Handover: Shadowing the current admins, turning Scribe recordings into a signed-off SOP library, and running the whole operation alone by the end of week three.
  • Bookings & Scheduling: Confirming every builder request the same day, booking 95%+ of inspections within 48 hours, and planning inspector routes by area so inspectors spend their day inspecting, not driving.
  • Report Quality Control: Building a report quality checklist with the General Manager and using AI tools to flag anything missing while the inspector is still on site, so no report ever needs reissuing.
  • Same-Day Invoicing: Raising every invoice in Xero, including extra charges, the same day the report goes out.
  • Clear Communication on Every Front: Giving confident instructions to inspectors, builders and site supervisors, holding the line when information is missing, and answering the General Manager’s requests the same day.
  • Systems for National Growth: Onboarding new builders and site supervisors interstate, tracking multi-inspection projects, setting up proactive reminders, and building data reporting for sales and marketing.
  • Weekly Reporting: Sending the General Manager a one-page operations update every week.

Requirements

This Role Is a Great Fit If You:

  • Are a Proven Scheduler: You have scheduled and dispatched field teams before, ideally in trades, field services or construction.
  • Are Confident on the Phone: You speak and write excellent English and are comfortable giving clear direction to Australian tradies and site supervisors, and holding your ground when needed.
  • Are an AI-Adaptive Operator: You already use AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude in your daily work, not just occasionally.
  • Learn Fast: You can take over a live operation in three weeks and work from light instructions, building process as you go.
  • Sweat the Details: You check every report and invoice with care, every time.
  • Stay Composed Under Pressure: You stay calm and organised when builders give late notice and the schedule has to change.
  • Are High-Accountability: You don’t need to be chased for updates. You’re reliable, meet deadlines, and own your mistakes as much as your wins.
  • Can Commit to the Schedule: You can work Australian business hours, Monday to Friday, with a reliable setup and internet connection.

Genuine differentiators (not requirements): ServiceM8, simPRO or similar field service software; Xero; familiarity with plumbing, construction or building inspections.

What Success Looks Like

After 60–90 Days:

  • The Handover Is Done: You ran the operation alone from week four, with a complete SOP library, and kept it running smoothly through the Christmas period.
  • Bookings Hit the Standard: Every request is confirmed the same day and at least 95% of inspections are booked within 48 hours, with schedules planned by area.
  • Reports Go Out Right the First Time: You own report quality control, catch missing items while inspectors are on site, and no report has been reissued.
  • Billing Is Same-Day: Every invoice, including extras, goes out the same day as the report.
  • Trust Is Earned: The General Manager relies on your weekly update and same-day answers, and has taken real operational load off his plate to focus on growth.

Final Word

If you’ve ever thought:

“I’m great at keeping field teams organised, I’m not afraid to pick up the phone and push back, and I use AI to get more done. I just want a business that lets me own the operation and grow with it.” This is that role.

Let’s build long-term success — together.

jobs.description:
About Accelerant

Accelerant is a data-driven risk exchange connecting underwriters of specialty insurance risk with risk capital providers. Accelerant was founded in 2018 by a group of longtime insurance industry executives and technology experts who shared a vision of rebuilding the way risk is exchanged – so that it works better, for everyone. The Accelerant risk exchange does business across more than 20 different countries and 250 specialty products, and we are proud that our insurers have been awarded an AM Best A- (Excellent) rating. For more information, please visit .

Solution Architect

Accelerant

London or US|Full-time|Reports to VP, Solution Architecture

ABOUT ACCELERANT

Accelerant is a Risk Exchange that connects underwriting talent with capacity. We combine proprietary data, technology, and deep insurance expertise to help members build and scale specialist insurance businesses. We are growing quickly and investing heavily in the platforms and capabilities that underpin our exchange.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Accelerant is in an exciting period of growth and transformation. We are modernising our platforms, expanding our data capabilities, and embedding intelligent automation across the business - all at pace. Solution Architecture sits at the centre of that effort, connecting technology decisions to business outcomes across underwriting, claims, finance, and operations.

This is a hands-on role. You will be embedded in delivery squads, owning the design end-to-end from requirements through to go-live - not handing off a diagram and stepping back. The quality of your upfront design work directly determines whether delivery runs smoothly or stalls, so thoroughness and attention to detail matter as much as the ability to think at a high level. You will report directly to the VP of Solution Architecture.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own the design of integration and platform solutions from requirements through to delivery, working across a wide variety of programmes and business domains.
  • Gatekeeper requirements before design begins - ensuring functional scope is clear, agreed, and documented before a squad is formed or build starts.
  • Produce design documentation thorough enough for developers to build from and testers to derive test targets from, without needing to escalate back to you for answers.
  • Stay embedded in delivery squads through build and test, providing design authority when questions arise rather than being pulled in retrospectively to firefight.
  • Translate complex business requirements - from underwriting, claims, finance, and operations - into clear, actionable technical designs, using MuleSoft as the primary integration platform.
  • Work alongside data, platform, and product engineering teams to define connectivity patterns across event-driven, API, and file-based channels.
  • Contribute to architecture governance, ensuring integration decisions are made at the right point in delivery rather than discovered mid-sprint.
  • Support the adoption of AI-native development tooling and emerging integration capabilities as we modernise how we build.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essential

  • Proven experience as a solution architect or lead integration developer, with MuleSoft as your primary integration platform.
  • A track record of seeing designs through delivery, not just producing them - you have been the person in the room when things get difficult, and you have the scars to show for it.
  • Solid understanding of insurance or reinsurance operations - you can hold a substantive conversation with underwriters and claims managers, not just engineers.
  • Comfort working in ambiguity: you can move a design forward when requirements are still forming, and you know when to decide vs. when to ask.
  • Strong requirements discipline - you push back when scope is unclear before build starts, because you know what happens when you do not.
  • Strong business translation skills - the ability to understand what a stakeholder actually needs and express it as a workable design, not just a literal interpretation of the ask.
  • Experience producing formal architecture documentation (design specifications, integration records, data-flow maps) at a level of detail that delivery teams can genuinely use.
  • Familiarity with event-driven and API-led connectivity patterns.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake, Redpanda (or Kafka), and Dynamics 365 / Dataverse.
  • Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, Azure Service Bus, or AWS.
  • Awareness of AI-native development approaches - agent-assisted coding, LLM-driven integration tooling, or similar.
  • Background in Lloyd's market or specialty insurance.
  • Experience contributing to or chairing architecture review boards or similar governance forums.

WORKING AT ACCELERANT

We are a globally distributed team building something genuinely new in the insurance market. This role suits someone who gets satisfaction from delivery that runs well - where the design held up, the squad stayed small, and nobody had to be pulled off something else to rescue it. You will have real architectural ownership and direct visibility of the programmes that matter most to the business.

Accelerant is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

jobs.description:
Grow our AI image service.

Before you apply, spend ten minutes on our website and LinkedIn. In your Loom we will ask what we do, where you found out about us, and why you want to work at Drop Zero Digital. Answers that could be about any company will not pass.

The role

We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.

You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

  1. The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.
  2. Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.

This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.

We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

  1. You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.
  2. You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.
  3. You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.
  4. You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.
  5. You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience

We do not ask for a number of years. We check your work history against what you tell us, and a false answer ends the application.

Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video. Research us first.
  2. A short test by email: one real decision task, your internet speed, your computer, and a paragraph on your work history.
  3. A 15 minute call with the founder.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. Aptitude tests. These inform us, they do not decide.
  6. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

jobs.description:
Hello, potential future Oatly employee. It’s us, the original oatmilk company that started in Sweden back 25 or so years ago and has since expanded to the U.S., where we’ve continued growing at a rate such that we need more brilliant minds to work with us to keep the momentum going and the oatmilk flowing.

Sustainability, health, and transparency are the core values that guide everything we do. Basically, we exist to help people live healthier lives without recklessly taxing the planet’s resources in the process, and to change the food system for the better. We drive that change through the power of oats and through a significant reduction in cow’s milk consumption. If any of this resonates with you, then maybe you’d like to work for Oatly, too. Now onto the formal stuff.

We are looking for aSupply Planning Manager, North America to join our Supply Chain team. This role will lead the North American Supply Planning function and ensure the business has a robust, executable supply plan that delivers the right products at the right place and time while balancing customer service, inventory, capacity, cost, waste, and operational efficiency.

Due to business needs, the qualified candidate will reside in the Eastern timezone.

Here are the things we want to hire you to do:

  • Lead the North America Supply Planning team and build a high-performing, data-driven planning organization

  • Own the development and execution of the regional supply plan across manufacturing sites, product categories, co-manufacturers, and the distribution network

  • Translate the consensus demand plan into integrated capacity, production, inventory, deployment, and material requirements

  • Establish clear planning priorities and decision rules across service, inventory, cost, capacity, and waste

  • Connect short-, medium-, and long-term supply plans to provide a consistent view of regional supply capability

  • Drive exception-based planning so the team can focus on decisions and risks rather than manual data processing

  • Develop a forward-looking view of capacity requirements, constraints, gaps, bottlenecks, and opportunities across manufacturing sites and co-manufacturers

  • Partner with Manufacturing, Procurement, Logistics, Customer Service, Deployment, Commercial, Finance, and the broader Supply Chain organization to develop mitigation plans and align around one set of numbers

  • Evaluate production, sourcing, capacity, and inventory scenarios to optimize the North American supply network and support fact-based business decisions

  • Ensure new products, renovations, transitions, and discontinuations are reflected in supply plans with clear ramp-up and phase-out strategies

  • Own regional inventory planning principles, safety stock, inventory targets, planning parameters, and replenishment policies

  • Balance customer availability with working capital, shelf life, storage capacity, obsolescence, and waste considerations

  • Proactively identify shortages, excess inventory, service failures, inventory deviations, and supply disruptions, then coordinate root-cause analysis and corrective action

  • Lead the Supply component of the North American Integrated Tactical Planning process and escalate structural or strategic constraints into the monthly Integrated Business Planning process

  • Champion the simplification, standardization, automation, and effective use of planning systems, ERP capabilities, master data, advanced analytics, and AI

  • Lead or contribute to regional and global planning transformation initiatives and deploy best practices across the planning organization

  • Coach, mentor, and develop Supply and Deployment Planners; establish clear expectations and development plans; and strengthen succession and future planning capabilities

Here are the things we think you need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related discipline

  • 5+ years of experience in Supply Planning, IBP, S&OP, or related processes

  • 3+ years of people leadership experience

  • Proven experience leading supply planning processes; experience in FMCG, food and beverage, consumer goods, or another fast-moving industry is preferred

  • Demonstrated success driving cross-functional alignment and influencing senior stakeholders

  • Experience supporting executive-level decision-making through analytics and scenario planning

  • Experience with planning platforms such as Anaplan, SAP IBP, OMP, Kinaxis, or an equivalent platform, along with strong business intelligence and Excel capabilities

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills

  • Ability to travel approximately 4–6 times per year within the requirements of the role

And here’s another list of qualities we think make a good Oatly team member:

  • You feel connected to our mission of encouraging health, sustainability, and transparency

  • You are a self-starter who doesn’t need direct supervision to motivate you for success – we believe strongly in building a culture of individual accountability and ownership and need partners that can embrace that mentality

  • You are ready to make your mark in a smaller, growing brand, leveraging your experience to deliver amazing results and build an outstanding company

  • You have an entrepreneurial spirit in that you’re comfortable with ambiguity and are energized by the process of building something lasting from the ground up

  • You enjoy sharing your quirkiness and talents with your coworkers

Another bulleted list felt a bit too…bullet-y. So we wrote this long, awkward sentence to let you know all the ways we sweeten the deal when you work with us, like flexible vacation (take it when you need it), really great benefits (yes, pet insurance is in there), paid volunteer days off throughout the year (doing good is fun), free six packs of...(drumroll)…oatmilk, and you’ll also get genuinely great coworkers who are rooting for each other and the company to thrive. Oh, one more short but very important sentence: We are nimble and agile (not chaotic) in how we work, and we’re grounded in a long company history dating way back to the last century.

Interested in joining our smart, fun, and talented team?

Position Overview

Enterprise is where the largest restaurant brands and franchise groups in the country choose the platforms they run on. Many already run on us, and many more do not yet. Competitors are pitching both, and neither group has heard the full story of what our platform does today. This role fixes that.

Reporting to the CMO, you will own product marketing for our Enterprise segment across three goals: winning new logos, expanding existing customers across the platform, and driving retention and adoption. This is a commercial job that uses positioning, messaging, launches and enablement as its tools. Your work supports new logo and expansion pipeline and bookings, shared with Sales, and retention and adoption, shared with Customer Success. You will own competitive win rate jointly with Sales. This is a player-coach role: you will do the product marketing work yourself, and lead and coach a senior account-based marketing manager and a senior customer marketing manager.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Buyer expertise. Become our expert on Enterprise buyers and how they decide: brand owners at headquarters, franchise owners, area directors and the store teams who use the product every shift. Run a steady loop of customer interviews, advisory board input and call analysis, and feed it into roadmap, messaging and pricing.

  • Positioning and messaging. Sharpen why a 100+ location operator should run on HotSchedules by Fourth, built on "one forecast, one platform" and proof from real customers, not adjectives. Make our brand transition read as more value for existing customers, not a rename, and define with Product how we talk about AI and data-driven decisions, credibly and with measured proof.

  • New logo. Give Sales and demand generation the story, proof and plays to win brands evaluating a new platform: value propositions by buyer, business cases a COO or CFO will sign, and displacement plays. Support Sales on RFPs so every response tells our story, not just answers the questions.

  • Expansion. Package the cross-sell story for customers who use only part of the platform: module value stories (inventory, forecasting, tip payout, payroll), business reviews and value reports that open expansion conversations.

  • Retention and adoption. With Customer Success, build the value proof renewals run on and the programs that get customers using what they already own.

  • Competitive strategy. Own our competitive fights end to end: battlecards, win/loss interviews, displacement and defense plays, and objection handling that reps and account managers actually use.

  • Launches, enablement and content. Partner with Product on launches and roadmap input, and build the assets Enterprise buyers, customers and sellers actually use: messaging frameworks, product content and demo videos, sales decks and one-pagers, web pages, case studies, value reports and thought leadership for brand owners, all built on real customer proof.

  • Team. Coach and develop a senior account-based marketing manager and a senior customer marketing manager, so account-based plays and customer programs run on the same story and the same plan.

  • 8+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing, including enterprise or mid-market buyers with multi-stakeholder deals.

  • Strong writing. You can turn a feature list into a business case a COO or CFO will read, and you have shaped RFP responses that won.

  • A maker, not just a manager. You create the assets yourself: messaging, product content, sales decks and web content. For demo videos you write the script and storyboard, and our creative team or partners produce them.

  • A player-coach. You do the product marketing work yourself, and you have managed people whose craft differs from yours. You do not need to be an account-based or customer marketing expert. You set the plan and priorities and help the team do their best work.

  • Credibility with Sales and Customer Success: you have sat in on calls and rewritten a pitch because of what you heard.

Preferred Experience and/or Qualifications

  • Restaurant, hospitality, retail or other multi-location operations experience.

  • Workforce management, HCM, inventory or fintech product marketing.

  • Experience marketing AI or analytics products with real, measured outcomes.

Measures of Success

Your first 90 days

  1. Ship refreshed competitive battlecards and a one-page Enterprise value narrative.

  1. Stand up a recurring win/loss and churn-reason review with Sales and Customer Success.

  • New logo and expansion pipeline and bookings on plan with Sales, with your positioning and assets visibly used in deals.

  • Retention and adoption improving with Customer Success, backed by value proof customers recognize.

  • Competitive win rate tracked by competitor, reported with Sales and moving the right way.

Join our team as a Fraud Support Analyst, supporting fraud prevention and risk management through terminal reviews, merchant validation, transaction monitoring, fraud investigations, and data analysis.

In this role, you will primarily support the Misaligned Terminal Blocking Solution by reviewing flagged terminals, validating merchant legitimacy, and maintaining block lists.

You will also analyze transactional and operational data to identify fraud patterns, anomalies, vulnerabilities, and emerging risks, partnering with cross-functional teams to strengthen fraud controls and deliver accurate, actionable, and auditable decisions within established service level agreements (SLAs).

Responsibilities

Terminal Review & Fraud Investigation

  • Review system-flagged terminals using established fraud investigation criteria and public or third-party sources to validate merchant legitimacy and identify misaligned, suspicious, or corrupt terminals.
  • Research store websites, business listings, licensing records, Google Maps, and other available sources to support merchant validation and fraud detection decisions.
  • Add, update, or remove flagged terminals and maintain fraud block lists in accordance with standard operating procedures and SLAs.
  • Document evidence, findings, and actions to maintain auditability and compliance with applicable policies, regulations, and governance requirements.

Fraud Analysis & Reporting

  • Extract, integrate, and analyze data from multiple systems to identify fraud trends, transaction anomalies, vulnerabilities, and operational risks.
  • Monitor fraud strategies and controls to evaluate effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Generate and analyze fraud reports, block list updates, dashboards, and activity summaries.
  • Communicate fraud findings, trends, risks, and recommendations to Fraud Operations, internal leadership, cross-functional stakeholders, and clients.

Cross-Functional Support

  • Partner with Fraud Operations, Technical Support, Product/Platform, and Client Support teams to define analytical requirements, escalate issues, troubleshoot problems, and improve fraud prevention solutions.
  • Support fraud teams by researching issues, analyzing data, and assisting with technical and operational troubleshooting.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Statistics, or a related field plus at least one year of relevant experience; or equivalent professional experience in lieu of a degree.
  • If substituting professional experience for a degree, at least three years of experience in fraud analysis, fraud operations, risk analysis, business analysis, data analysis, transaction monitoring, statistical reporting, or a related analytical role.
  • Experience interpreting complex data, identifying trends and anomalies, developing practical recommendations, and communicating findings to stakeholders.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL.
  • Experience developing interactive dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence tools.
  • Strong data analysis, data mining, data management, interpretation, and visualization skills, including experience working with large datasets from multiple systems.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft tools including Copilot, Excel, Outlook, Word, Teams, and PowerPoint, with the ability to learn additional analytical technologies.

We are seeking an experienced Deputy Director of Proposals to support the leadership, operational effectiveness, and continuous improvement of a high-performing proposal organization.


The Deputy Director will serve as a key partner to the Director of Proposals, providing operational leadership across proposal planning, resource coordination, pursuit governance, and quality assurance.


This position requires a seasoned proposal professional who can operate effectively in a matrixed organization, influence cross-functional teams, navigate competing business priorities, and drive accountability.


The successful candidate will balance business judgment with operational discipline, ensuring proposal resources are aligned with organizational growth priorities and that pursuits are executed efficiently, compliantly, and competitively.


Key Responsibilities:


Proposal Operations and Execution

  • Provide operational leadership and oversight across a portfolio of concurrent proposals, qualifications packages, and strategic pursuits.
  • Coordinate proposal schedules, milestones, review cycles, and deliverables to support consistent execution.
  • Monitor proposal activities, identify execution risks, and proactively implement mitigation strategies.
  • Support proposal managers in resolving complex operational challenges and competing priorities.
  • Establish visibility into active pursuits, proposal workload, resource constraints, and upcoming submission requirements.
  • Ensure consistent application of proposal development methodologies, quality standards, and compliance practices.
  • Serve as an operational escalation point for proposal execution challenges, elevating strategic or unresolved matters to the Director of Proposals.

Resource Planning and Capacity Management

  • Develop and maintain visibility into proposal resource capacity, utilization, and forecasted demand.
  • Coordinate proposal resource planning and recommend staffing allocations based on pursuit complexity, priority, and availability.
  • Identify workload imbalances, resource conflicts, and potential delivery risks.
  • Collaborate with proposal managers and functional leadership to develop practical resource solutions.
  • Support long-range capacity planning and provide recommendations regarding resource needs, external support, and operational efficiencies.
  • Provide data-driven assessments to inform pursuit prioritization and proposal investment decisions.

Pursuit Qualification and Bid/No-Bid Governance

  • Support the Director of Proposals in implementing a disciplined and consistent bid/no-bid governance process.
  • Coordinate pursuit qualification assessments to evaluate strategic alignment, customer relationships, competitive positioning, revenue potential, probability of winning, and resource requirements.
  • Provide objective analysis of proposal development costs, resource availability, and execution feasibility.
  • Identify pursuits that may not align with organizational growth objectives or represent an appropriate return on proposal investment.
  • Partner with business development, capture, and operational leadership to ensure pursuit decisions are informed by meaningful qualification criteria.
  • Track bid/no-bid outcomes, pursuit decisions, and associated proposal resource commitments.
  • Support the Director in reinforcing a selective, strategic, and disciplined approach to opportunity pursuit.

Proposal Quality and Process Excellence

  • Promote consistent proposal development practices, tools, templates, and review methodologies.
  • Monitor adherence to established proposal standards, compliance requirements, and quality expectations.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, eliminate inefficiencies, and reduce unnecessary administrative burden.

  • Facilitate lessons-learned activities and translate findings into actionable improvements.
  • Establish repeatable processes that improve proposal predictability, scalability, and execution.

  • Influence outcomes through collaboration, credibility, sound judgment, and demonstrated proposal expertise.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, professionalism, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, communications, management, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in proposal management, capture support, business development operations, or related functions.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting complex, high-value proposals in a large, matrixed organization.
  • Extensive knowledge of proposal development processes, compliance requirements, review methodologies, and submission procedures.
  • Experience coordinating multiple concurrent pursuits with competing deadlines and resource requirements.
  • Strong understanding of bid/no-bid qualification, pursuit investment considerations, and proposal resource planning.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.

Job Title:

Vulnerability Management Engineer (AI Automation)

About Trellix 
Trellix is a global cybersecurity leader helping organizations build cyber resilience for the AI era. Combining AI-native security, operational threat intelligence, and automated detection and response, Trellix provides defense-grade protection at machine speed across on-premises, air-gapped, operational technology, hybrid, and cloud environments. Trellix helps customers anticipate threats, scale effective security operations, maintain business continuity, and adapt their security posture for the modern threat landscape. Working with a broad partner ecosystem and global intelligence collaborators, Trellix helps strengthen the collective defense against cybercriminals and state-sponsored attacks. At Trellix, we empower professionals at all career stages to expand their technical expertise, lead strategic initiatives, and make a tangible global impact. Whether you are an industry pioneer or an emerging specialist, Trellix provides the tools and opportunities to enhance and expand your skill set. Join our mission to scale AI-driven cyber defense alongside an AI-accelerated threat landscape, and help build a safer, more resilient future. More at .

Role Overview:

We are looking for strategic, hands-on Security Engineer to drive end-to-end vulnerability management, governance, and risk-based prioritization across hybrid, cloud, and containerized environments in alignment with NIST SSDF, EU CRA, and IEC standards. The role focuses on engineering autonomous AI agents to automate asset discovery, finding validation, exploitability analysis, ticket orchestration, and zero-day response. Candidates will lead cross-functional remediation with IT and DevOps teams, streamline exception workflows, and deliver executive-level risk reporting and metrics.

About Role:

  • Direct continuous asset discovery, vulnerability assessment, remediation verification, and executive reporting across hybrid cloud, container, and application ecosystems.
  • Contextualize vulnerability severity (CVSS) using real-world threat intelligence (EPSS, CISA KEV) and business criticality. Spearhead rapid response protocols for critical zero-day vulnerabilities, implementing interim compensating controls and formal risk-acceptance workflows as required.
  • Architect and deploy autonomous AI agents to automate asset discovery, CMDB reconciliation, false-positive elimination, exploitability analysis, intelligent ticket routing, SLA breach escalations, and executive reporting.
  • Establish and enforce program governance, remediation SLAs, and exception management frameworks aligned with NIST SSDF, EU CRA, and IEC standards.
  • Define, track, and present key performance indicators (scan coverage, MTTR, SLA adherence, and vulnerability aging) to senior leadership. Partner with and mentor IT Operations, DevOps, and Software Engineering teams to accelerate remediation and embed security-by-design practices.

About You:

  • 5+ years in Information Security with a strong focus on Vulnerability Management, Application Security, or Cloud Security.
  • Extensive hands-on expertise with industry-leading VM, CNAPP, and AppSec solutions—including Tenable, Wiz, Qualys, CrowdStrike, or Snyk—with proven ability to programmatically orchestrate scans, ingest telemetry, and validate remediation.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and deploying autonomous AI agents and multi-step LLM workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs to automate discovery, reconciliation, and remediation pipelines.
  • Proficiency in leveraging LLMs and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures to correlate vulnerability data with source code repositories, asset metadata, and exploit intelligence to filter false positives and determine real-world exploitability.
  • Strong proficiency in Python for developing production-grade security automation, custom integrations, and consuming or building REST and GraphQL APIs.
  • Proven experience integrating security scanners with SOAR platforms, enterprise ticketing systems (Jira, ServiceNow), CMDBs, and collaboration platforms (Slack, Microsoft Teams) for automated ticket creation, routing, reminders, and SLA escalations.
  • Deep command of CVSS, EPSS, and CISA KEV methodologies, with experience enriching vulnerability telemetry using threat feeds and business impact assessments.
  • Comprehensive understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), hybrid enterprise networks, container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Working knowledge of NIST SSDF, EU CRA, and IEC regulatory frameworks, paired with the ability to build automated executive dashboards tracking MTTR, scan coverage, and SLA compliance.

We believe that the best solutions are developed by teams who embrace each other's unique experiences, skills, and abilities. We work hard to create a dynamic workforce where we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.

  • Retirement Plans

  • Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage

  • Paid Parental Leave

Our Commitment to You:


At Trellix, we are committed to creating a safe and trustworthy experience for our customers, employees, and candidates. Please be aware that fraudulent recruiting activity can occur through fake job postings or impersonated communications.


Trellix conducts interviews through professional channels only and does not use text messages, instant messaging, or group chats for interviews. We will never request sensitive personal information—such as your date of birth, Social Security number, or national ID number—during the interview process.


Trellix also does not require candidates to pay fees, purchase products or services, or process payments of any kind as part of the recruiting or hiring process. And Trellix will never keep any original work authorization documents that we may be required to review during the hiring process.

In this role, you’ll contribute to secure infrastructure and cybersecurity capabilities in government and defense environments, working alongside engineers and technical stakeholders to deliver resilient, forward-leaning solutions.

About the role: PMAT is seeking a CyberSecurity Engineer III to support the design, deployment, security, administration, and sustainment of secure, mission-critical computing environments. In this role, you will work across on-premises infrastructure, virtualization, Linux and Windows systems, network infrastructure, automation, and compliance-driven security architectures. You will collaborate with infrastructure, cybersecurity, and engineering teams to maintain secure and reliable environments, resolve technical challenges, remediate vulnerabilities, and support systems throughout the development, authorization, and operational lifecycle.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the design and administration of secure computing infrastructure in on-premises and private cloud environments.
  • Support the design and administration of enterprise VMware ESXi and vSAN virtualization platforms.
  • Deploy, configure, administer, and maintain RHEL and Windows Server systems.
  • Implement and remediate security controls in accordance with NIST SP 800-53 Revision 4 and Revision 5 requirements and DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides.
  • Support the automation of system builds, patching, configuration, and hardening using Ansible, Jenkins, PDQ, WSUS, and related tools.
  • Support vulnerability identification, tracking, and remediation efforts using ACAS, Nessus, Splunk, and other cybersecurity tools to reduce system attack surfaces.
  • Support enterprise services and technologies, including Active Directory, databases, Veeam, Horizon, Atlassian Suite, YUM repositories, and monitoring platforms.
  • Support the design and administration of LAN/WAN and virtualized network infrastructure, including troubleshooting complex routing issues involving OSPF and BGP.
  • Collaborate across engineering, cybersecurity, and technical teams to troubleshoot issues and implement secure infrastructure solutions.
  • Support authorization efforts, including Authority to Operate (ATO) packages, compliance documentation, control validation, and security audits.

About Us:

PMAT is an innovative small business founded with a passion for developing forward-leaning solutions from exceptional people that increase the mission's capability. We focus on designing and building impactful digital solutions that utilize modern cloud, data, and software concepts. Our passion is working on complex and progressive challenges such as edge platform computing, containerizing legacy platforms, distributed data platforms, or heterogeneous data analysis.

We recruit, retain, and foster a team motivated to pursue passions, investigate new ways of doing things, and embody an innovative and entrepreneurial spirit. We believe in being curious about every element of a problem and experiment relentlessly. We foster continuous learning in an environment that encourages positive collaboration and expands our capabilities. We tap into collective intelligence, acknowledging that the most brilliant people may not be in the room. Above all else, we believe that delivering and demonstrating is more potent than a sheet of paper. We are passionate about mission-centric design and delivering effective capabilities to and for the warfighter.

Whether you’re an experienced engineer or just beginning your career, you’ll work alongside experts who are committed to solving mission-critical problems. If you’re passionate about using your skills to make a real difference, apply today and become part of a team that’s shaping the future of defense technology!

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Five or more years of experience in infrastructure engineering, systems administration, network engineering, or a closely related technical field.
  • Experience administering VMware ESXi and vSAN virtualization environments.
  • Experience deploying, configuring, administering, and maintaining RHEL and Windows Server environments.
  • Experience supporting infrastructure automation using Ansible, Terraform, or related automation and Infrastructure as Code technologies.
  • Experience implementing or remediating security controls in accordance with DISA STIGs and NIST SP 800-53 requirements.
  • Strong understanding of on-premises cloud architectures, enterprise virtualization, and secure infrastructure operations.
  • Experience identifying, tracking, and remediating vulnerability backlogs in regulated or compliance-driven environments.
  • Experience supporting government, defense, or other security-focused technical environments.
  • Ability to work effectively with infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, and software teams in security-conscious environments.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • Experience supporting LAN/WAN environments, routing, switching, OSPF, or BGP.
  • Experience with ACAS, Splunk, Nessus, Veeam, Horizon, Dell Wyse, or related enterprise infrastructure technologies.
  • Experience serving as a technical lead, mentoring junior engineers, or coordinating technical work across multiple teams.

  • Experience supporting ATO packages, security control assessments, compliance documentation, or cybersecurity audits.

POSTING DETAILS:

Make an Impact

Trillium Health Resources is a Tailored Plan and Managed Care Organization (MCO) serving 46 counties across North Carolina. We manage services for individuals with serious mental health needs, substance use disorders, traumatic brain injuries, and intellectual/development (IDD) disabilities. Our mission is to help individuals and families build strong foundations for healthy, fulfilling lives.

Why Work for Us?

Trillium believes that empowering others begins with supporting our team. We offer our employees:

  • A collaborative, mission-driven work environment
  • Competitive benefits and work-from-home options for most positions
  • Opportunities for professional growth in a diverse inclusive culture

Every day, our work changes lives – from children thriving through early intervention and school-based therapies, to adults with severe mental illness living independently and contributing to their communities.

If you are looking for a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on the lives of others, apply today!

What We’re Looking For

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for a Director, Cost Management – Affordability to join our team! The Director, Cost Management – Affordability is responsible for leading the development, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of enterprise affordability initiatives designed to improve healthcare value, manage cost trends, and support long-term financial sustainability.

This position serves as a strategic partner across Clinical Operations, Medical Economics, Finance, Network Management, Care Management, Population Health, Utilization Management, Quality, and Executive Leadership to identify actionable trends, develop trend-bending solutions, evaluate financial impacts, and ensure successful implementation of affordability strategies.

The Director is responsible for translating clinical, operational, and financial insights into measurable action plans while maintaining accountability for initiative execution, projected savings, realized outcomes, and return on investment. This role serves as a key bridge between Medical Economics trend identification and organizational execution.

On a typical day, you might:

  • Identify opportunities to improve affordability through analysis of utilization, expenditure, reimbursement, and service delivery trends.
  • Partner with operational and clinical leaders to identify root causes of cost growth and utilization variation.
  • Develop financial assessments supporting affordability opportunities and strategic initiatives.
  • Quantify projected savings, implementation costs, required resources, and expected return on investment.
  • Communicate initiative progress, financial impacts, risks, and mitigation plans to senior leadership.

Employee Benefits:

Trillium knows that work/life balance is essential. That’s why we offer:

  • Typical working hours: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm; flexible work schedules available for some positions with management approval.
  • Work-from-home options available for most positions
  • Health Insurance with no premium for employee coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 24 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) plus 12 paid holidays in your first year
  • NC Local Government Retirement Pension (defined-benefit plan)
  • 401k with 5% employer match and immediate vesting
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) qualifying employer
  • Quarterly stipend for remote work supplies

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree and three (3) years of experience working in a government‑sponsored healthcare program, managed care, healthcare operations, population health, medical economics, healthcare finance, utilization management, payment integrity, network management, affordability, or a related healthcare environment, including experience in financial project management, healthcare data or trend analysis, healthcare economics, cost management, affordability management, financial project controls, payment integrity, financial modeling, or overseeing large-scale medical and behavioral healthcare expenditure targets and affordability initiatives.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must reside within the United States.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without requiring sponsorship for employment now or in the future (ex: OPT F-1, J-1).

Preferred:

  • Supervision of two (2) or more employees.
  • Master’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Finance, Nursing, Public Health, Healthcare Informatics, Economics, or a related field.
  • Seven (7) years of experience working in a government‑sponsored healthcare program, managed care, healthcare operations, population health, medical economics, healthcare finance, utilization management, payment integrity, network management, affordability, or a related healthcare environment.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent project management certification.

Deadline for Application:Monday, November 23, 2026 at 11:59pm

How to Apply

To be considered, submit your application and resume through our ADP Career Center. Your resume must include:

  • Employer name, dates of service (month/year), average hours worked per week, and essential job duties
  • Education details (degree type, date awarded, institution, field of study)
  • Licensure/certification information, if applicable

After submission, your resume will be reviewed to ensure it meets the essential criteria for the position. You’ll be notified by HR regarding your application status as appropriate. All applicants will receive a final update once the recruitment cycle closes.

Join our Talent Community through ADP to stay informed about future opportunities. Be sure to keep your resume updated in your profile.

Trillium Health Resources is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and a drug-free workplace. All candidates must pass a drug test as a condition of employment.

We are Omnissa!

Omnissa is the first AI-driven digital work platform, built to support flexible, secure, work-from-anywhere experiences. At Omnissa, we are committed to maintaining a fair, consistent, and secure hiring process for all candidates. As part of this approach, we use standard interview and verification practices designed to ensure alignment and protect both candidates and the organization. These practices are applied thoughtfully and with respect for candidate privacy.

What is the opportunity?

We are looking for a talented, experienced public sector lawyer to join the Omnissa Legal Team as EMEA Public Sector Counsel focusing on Public Sector customers in Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA). This role will report to Omnissa’s Senior Counsel, Global Public Sector Lead, and will serve as a legal advisor to the Sales and Deal Management teams supporting government and public sector customers in EMEA and other non-U.S. jurisdictions.

You will draft, negotiate, and advise on public sector agreements, tenders, and framework arrangements, and will help ensure that Omnissa’s terms and programs meet local government requirements while protecting the company. You will work across time zones and legal systems with the global Omnissa Legal Team and global business team leaders, regional business leaders, and deliver creative and practical solutions that mitigate risk.

Responsibilities


  • Develop a deep knowledge of Omnissa’s products, services, and international public sector strategy, priorities, and challenges;
  • Draft, review, and negotiate agreements with government and public sector customers in EMEA and other non-U.S. jurisdictions, including software license, SaaS and professional services agreements, in coordination with Sales, Deal Management and other Omnissa stakeholders;
  • Advise on customer requests to modify Omnissa standard terms, and on local public sector terms, including data residency and sovereignty, security and certification, audit, liability, and termination requirements;
  • Negotiate and support ongoing compliance of Omnissa’s participation in public sector framework agreements and purchasing vehicles at national or EU-level, including mandatory terms, call-off structures, accreditation and listing requirements, reseller and distributor eligibility, and renewals;
  • Counsel business and security teams on evolving EMEA Public Sector regulatory requirements (NIS2, EUCS, EU AI Act, and national schemes), anticipating the impact of sovereignty and cybersecurity mandates on public procurement and go-to-market strategy.
  • Support responses to tenders, RFPs, and other public procurement processes, including review of terms, certifications, and declarations;
  • Advise on public sector channel and partner arrangements, including distributors, resellers, and systems integrators, and on related due diligence;
  • Advise on cross-border legal and compliance matters affecting public sector sales, including anti-corruption, export controls and sanctions, and public procurement integrity requirements;
  • Advise product, engineering, and operations teams on public sector compliance, accreditation, and contract requirements applicable to software and SaaS providers;
  • Monitor legal and regulatory trends affecting public sector sales, identify compliance risks, and work with legal specialists and outside counsel to mitigate them

What will you bring to Omnissa?


  • Proven ability to negotiate complex software licensing and SaaS transactions with government customers and to develop practical, risk-balanced solutions;
  • Sound, independent judgment and the ability to make clear recommendations on a wide variety of contract and compliance matters;
  • Cross-cultural fluency and the ability to work effectively with colleagues and customers across multiple regions, languages, and time zones;
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex legal concepts to engineering, sales, marketing, and finance audiences;
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment; and
  • A collaborative, curious, and accountable approach to working across Legal and the business.

Qualifications


  • Law degree from an accredited university; fully qualified to practice law in at least one EMEA jurisdiction;
  • Substantial international public sector experience;
  • Minimum 8 years of experience negotiating software and cloud services agreements, with experience in public sector or government customer contracting;

  • In-house experience at a U.S.-based technology company is preferred but not required;
  • Fluent in English; additional regional language skills are a plus;

Job Description:

About Computrition


Computrition, Inc. is a leading provider of enterprise foodservice, nutrition management, and retail technology, trusted by hundreds of organizations across North America, including healthcare systems, military installations, correctional facilities, and higher education institutions. For more than 44 years, we’ve built technology in partnership with our customers, helping them improve operational efficiency, strengthen financial performance, and deliver better nutritional care.


We’re investing in the future of our platform by adopting modern technologies and working closely with customers to solve complex operational challenges. Our solutions have real-world impact by driving performance enhancement and show up directly in how hospitals, military installations, and other institutions operate every day.


Computrition offers the stability of an established industry leader and the momentum of a company accelerating growth through innovation. We invest in our people and foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and professional growth where employees can make a meaningful impact. You’ll join experienced professionals who are passionate about solving meaningful problems and delivering measurable outcomes for customers.


With team members across the U.S. and Canada, and as part of a growing portfolio of technology companies owned by Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU.TO), we are well-positioned to continue advancing the future of foodservice and nutrition technology.


If you’re looking to build technology that makes a meaningful impact while growing your career with a stable, innovative company, we’d like to hear from you.


The role

VP, Marketing owns how Computrition is understood in the market and how that understanding turns into pipeline, revenue and retention. This is a player-coach role: you set direction and personally build a meaningful share of the work.


Reports to: President and CEO

Location: Fully remote, United States

Travel: Up to 25 percent: industry conferences, customer visits, company events


You will work hand in hand with Product, Sales, Customer Success, Operations, and you are expected to know our products well enough to demo them and explain their business impact to a buyer.


What you will deliver in your first 90 days

  • Baseline metrics: a marketing scorecard with current funnel performance and a first report of marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline
  • Team alignment: match each team member's strengths to our growth initiatives, so their skills are applied where they create the most impact
  • Spend review: a review of marketing vendors and tools, with savings identified
  • Agreed priorities: Marketing's priorities validated with each department leader

What you will deliver in your first 12 months

  • A marketing plan and scorecard: an annual plan and budget with an investment case per program, and a monthly scorecard tying marketing activity to pipeline, bookings and retention.
  • Attributed pipeline: agreed marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline targets with Sales, reported monthly from our marketing automation platform and Salesforce.

  • Sales-ready materials: a current, consistent library of product, ROI and competitive materials that Sales and Customer Success actually use.
  • Events with measured return: every major conference run against meeting, pipeline and cost targets, with a post-event ROI report.
  • Customer proof: at least 10 quantified customer stories and an active reference program.
  • Higher output with AI: measurably more content and campaign throughput from the same team.

What you will own

Growth engine and measurement

  • Own Marketing's operating system: annual plan, budget, vendor management, and a weekly and monthly operating rhythm
  • Build and run the marketing scorecard, with leading and lagging KPIs and targets
  • Own attribution across our marketing automation platform and Salesforce, lead scoring, lead handoff to Sales, and data quality
  • Report Marketing's performance in executive and quarterly business reviews
  • Rationalize the marketing technology stack and vendor spend, and keep every marketing account and asset under company ownership
  • Agree Marketing's priorities and service levels with each department every quarter

Revenue support: new business and existing customers

  • Run campaigns and account-based programs that create qualified pipeline for new-business sales
  • Run expansion, adoption and retention programs with Customer Success for the installed base
  • Turn Product's value model into seller-ready business-case tools, and maintain a database of customer outcomes that proves value delivered
  • Maintain a proposal and RFP content library, including support for public-sector and government responses
  • Run win/loss analysis and feed the findings to Sales, Product and messaging

Product and sales marketing

  • Partner with Product on positioning, naming, packaging input and launch readiness for new products and releases
  • Produce and maintain product sheets, presentations, demo stories, case studies and competitive battlecards
  • Govern messaging so every customer-facing asset is consistent and current
  • Run co-marketing with technology and channel partners

Events: in person and virtual

  • Build the annual event calendar with an investment case and ROI target for each event
  • Run national and regional conferences end to end: pre-booked meetings, booth, customer receptions, follow-up and ROI reporting
  • Run webinars, virtual events and our customer user conference
  • Support internal company events, including our annual employee conference

Brand and communications

  • Lead the brand refresh and protect brand standards across every channel
  • Own social media strategy, PR, thought leadership, industry awards and customer recognition programs
  • Keep our external profiles (directories, analyst and data sites) accurate
  • Support employer branding and the careers page for recruiting

Website and digital

  • Lead the website refresh and own the site's performance: traffic, conversion and lead quality
  • Own SEO and visibility in AI search tools
  • Run the customer newsletter and email programs

Internal communications

  • Own the company intranet and its content
  • Produce the company-wide leadership newsletter and internal announcements
  • Run customer surveys through one tool and one intake process, so results are coordinated and acted on

Market sensing

  • Turn Product-led competitive and market insights into battlecards, messaging and sales enablement
  • Produce intelligence reports from every major conference
  • With Product and Sales, define ideal customer profiles and segments across healthcare, military, corrections and higher education
  • Bring the voice of the customer into product and pricing decisions

AI-enabled marketing

  • Lead AI adoption across the team: AI-first workflows for research, content, campaigns, personalization and reporting
  • Build and deploy practical AI tools and agents, including automation inside our marketing automation platform and CRM
  • Set quality, brand-safety and data-privacy standards for AI-generated content
  • Measure and report the productivity and performance gains AI delivers
  • Grow our visibility in AI search and answer engines

What you bring

  • 7+ years of B2B marketing in software or technology
  • Proof of delivered results: pipeline, revenue, conversion or retention gains you can quantify and attribute to your own work, and strategic initiatives you took from plan to completion
  • Demand generation and attribution: you have personally built demand programs and pipeline attribution in a marketing automation platform and Salesforce, or comparable platforms
  • Hands-on execution: you personally write, build campaigns, run the marketing automation platform and analyze the data, rather than only directing agencies or delegating
  • Decisiveness: you bring recommendations backed by numbers and own decisions within your authority
  • Deep product fluency: you have learned complex enterprise software well enough to demo it and model the ROI it creates for customers
  • AI literacy in practice: you use generative AI tools daily in production work, have built or deployed AI workflows or agents, and can show measurable gains in speed, quality or results
  • Transformation experience: you have led a brand refresh, a repositioning, a major launch or a rebuild of a marketing function
  • Event ROI: you have run conferences as measured investments, not just logistics
  • Tools: a marketing automation platform, Salesforce (or comparable CRM), a website CMS, web and campaign analytics
  • Remote collaboration: you drive cross-functional work effectively across locations and time zones

Preferred

  • Prior experience managing a marketing team
  • Experience marketing both on-premise and cloud software

jobs.excerpt: This version has bold titles in normal text and extra space between sections.
jobs.description:
This version has bold titles in normal text and extra space between sections. Copy it straight from here, not from a code box, so the bold carries over:

The role at a glance

We’re hiring a sharp, AI-native Junior Creative Strategist to make sure every video ad we launch is the best version of itself.

  • Role: Junior Creative Strategist

  • Salary: $27,500 - $35,000 USD base, depending on experience

  • Location: Remote-first, based in Argentina

  • Hours: Full-time, flexible

  • Reports to: a Senior Creative Strategist

About Elavate

Elavate is a UK multi-collagen brand for women 40+, built to help them feel like themselves again through menopause and beyond.

We launched in 2024 and have grown into one of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the UK. We’re fully bootstrapped and have grown almost entirely through performance ads.

It started when our founder, Alex, got fed up of buying his mum overpriced, low-quality, bad-tasting collagen. So he made one that actually works, tastes great and is affordable.

Creative is the engine of the business. Our strategists, in-house video editors and agency partners put out 100+ new ad concepts a month across influencer, UGC, high-production, AI and animation formats.

The role

Our goal is simple: launch the best ads possible, as fast as possible.

Our strategists write the scripts and brief the concepts. Our video editors, in-house and agency, build the ads. You own everything in between: you take a raw script and make sure it becomes a finished, launch-ready video ad, on time and with zero mistakes.

That means reviewing every edit, giving editors notes that make the ad better, keeping the pipeline moving, and using AI to make the whole process faster every week.

The bar: when you sign off an ad, it should be ready to go straight live, with no second check needed. Our north star is a concept briefed this week and live in the ad account by the following Thursday.

What you’ll actually do

Most of your week goes on reviewing edits and working with editors. The rest goes on the pipeline, learning from live ads, AI and scripts.

Review every ad before it goes live

  • Watch every first draft from our in-house editors and agency partners, and leave timestamped notes in .

  • Catch everything: captions, typos, clipped words, audio levels, pacing, weak B-roll, hooks that don’t stitch into the body, the product showing too early.

  • Push past “correct” to “better”: stronger hook visuals, music, SFX, text styles and cuts.

  • Plan 3-6 cutdowns and extra hook variations for each ad, so we test more versions of every idea.

Make our editors better

  • Turn scripts into clear briefs, with a short Loom showing the dream edit.

  • Give specific feedback (“change X because Y”) so the same note never comes up twice.

  • Run weekly check-ins with your editors, match work to their strengths and keep output on track.

Keep the pipeline moving

  • Own the production board in Notion: assign edits, chase deadlines and reassign when someone’s off.

  • Get influencer content over the line: every hook, every file and whitelisting access, tracked and ready.

  • Hand final files to media buying, named and labelled so launches are clean.

Learn from what’s live

  • Read the comments on our live ads for objections, questions and new hook ideas.

  • Know which ads are winning and why, and bring those patterns into the next edit.

  • Keep a swipe file of the best DTC ads and new formats worth testing.

Build the AI workflow

  • Help build our AI editing pipeline, using tools like Claude Code, Higgsfield and ElevenLabs.

  • Keep teaching the system: feed it new formats, references and examples so the output improves every week.

  • Help editors adopt new tools, and check AI edits as closely as human ones.

Write and improve scripts

  • Review agency scripts and fix logic or flow issues before anything gets filmed.

  • Write bottom-of-funnel scripts, hooks and variations using our copy frameworks and AI tools.

What you’ll bring

  • Strong with AI. You use Claude every day, you’re comfortable in Claude Code, and you’ve built automated workflows that save real time.

  • A ruthless eye for detail. You spot a typo, a clipped word or a flicker on the first watch.

  • Clear, specific feedback. You can explain exactly what to change and why, in writing or on a Loom.

  • Technical confidence. You understand how video editing works (Premiere, CapCut, DaVinci or similar) and you pick up new tools fast.

  • Taste for direct response. You watch a lot of ads, you know why a hook stops the scroll, and you care whether an ad sells, not just how it looks.

  • A team player. You’ll work under our senior strategists, so you’re collaborative, responsive and active on Slack.

  • Ownership and speed. You juggle several projects, chase people without being chased, and figure things out before you ask.

  • No ego. You take blunt feedback well and act on it fast.

  • Based in Argentina, working remotely.

Nice to have

  • A background in video editing, content creation or creative strategy. Any one of these is a great fit.

  • Experience at a DTC brand or performance agency. No supplement experience needed.

  • An understanding of acquisition numbers: ad spend, cost per purchase and what makes an ad scale.

  • An interest in direct response copywriting.

  • Something you’ve built yourself: a side project, a small business or a startup.

Where this goes

This is a junior role with a path to Creative Strategist.

You’ll have access to sharp senior strategists and creative minds who’ll help you improve your own skills. The progression is simple: you get better at creative yourself, and keep developing into a stronger strategist.

Our current junior strategists already run weekly editor meetings, review agency work and are moving into scripting.

Pay, perks and how we work

  • $27,500 - $35,000 USD base, depending on experience

  • 30 days off a year

  • Private health insurance

  • A learning budget for courses, communities and coaching

  • Paid AI tools, including Claude

  • Remote-first, with flexible hours

  • Direct access to the founder

  • Free Elavate products

At Elavate we move fast, own our work and hold each other to a high standard. In return, you’ll learn faster about creative here than almost anywhere else.

How to apply

Send us:

  • Your CV/Cover Letter to

  • A short Loom video (3-5 mins max) reviewing one of our ads from our Facebook Ad Library. Tell us what you think is working in the ad and what you’d improve (visually or in the script).

jobs.description:
ICF’s Disaster Management Division seeks Disaster Recovery FEMA Public Assistance - Technical Specialist – Reservist On Call to join our team. This ON-CALL position will require travel to client offices, disaster recovery sites, and deployable for multiple week assignments. This is a U.S. based position.

About On-Call Employment with ICF: Due to the seasonal or project-specific nature of our disaster and emergency management work, ICF hires professionals as “On-Call” employees. On-Call employees are scheduled for work as it becomes available, with the freedom to accept or decline hours. They can work on concurrent projects outside of their ICF assignment, provided there's no conflict of interest.

Definition: FEMA Public Assistance (PA) is a program provided by the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) that provides financial and direct assistance to states, tribes, and territories when authorized as part of a presidential declaration under the Robert T. Stafford Disaster Relief and Emergency Assistance Act. The program provides supplemental grants to state, tribal, territorial and local governments, and certain types of private non-profits so communities can quickly respond to and recover from major disasters or emergencies. PA can fund the repair, restoration, reconstruction or replacement of eligible public or certain nonprofit facilities or infrastructure damaged or destroyed by a disaster. This is not health or social services.


As part of the Technical Specialist Reservist (On Call) Cadre, you will coordinate with other technical specialists and project team members to ensure performance of tasks. Responsibilities may include providing comprehensive disaster recovery, grant monitoring services to sub-recipients, and working with (possibly overseeing) disaster recovery staff and assisting with project management tasks.

What You Will Do

• Experience supporting disaster recovery projects at the federal, state, tribal, territorial, or local government level.
• Ability and willingness to travel by air and vehicle with limited notice to support disaster recovery operations.
• Valid U.S. driver's license and ability to successfully pass a Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check.


Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience evaluating infrastructure, construction, public works, utilities, facilities, or capital improvement projects.
• Experience supporting disaster recovery projects involving complex stakeholder, political, or programmatic considerations.

Professional Skills: (You bring these with you on Day One)

Job title: Sr. Account Executive – Germany (Public Sector)
