jobs.title: SOC Analyst (16:00–01:00 UTC)
jobs.excerpt: About the jobThe SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center.
jobs.description:
About the job

The SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center. This position reports to the SOC Lead. The role goes beyond acknowledging alerts: the focus is on understanding what each alert means, investigating suspicious activity end to end, responding to real threats, and handing over cleanly between regions so that nothing is lost across shifts. The ideal candidate has solid SOC experience, a strong investigative mindset, and thrives in a fast-paced, fully remote setting where accuracy, discipline, and security are essential. Hands-on engineering experience with core security platforms is a big plus.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor, triage, and analyze security alerts and events from the organization's security stack, including SIEM, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Service Edge (SSE), and Web Application Firewall (WAF) platforms.

  • Investigate security incidents end to end, from initial triage through analysis, containment, eradication, and post-incident documentation, coordinating with relevant teams throughout.

  • Determine the scope, severity, and impact of security events, separating true positives from false positives and escalating confirmed incidents according to defined procedures.

  • Execute response actions within the security platforms, such as isolating endpoints, blocking indicators, disabling compromised accounts, and enforcing access restrictions.

  • Ensure structured, high-quality shift handovers across regions in the follow-the-sun model, so that open investigations, ongoing incidents, and pending actions continue seamlessly around the clock.

  • Proactively threat hunt across endpoint, network, and log data to uncover suspicious activity that existing detections may have missed, mapping findings to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Provide feedback on detection quality and contribute to the tuning of SIEM correlation rules, EDR custom detections, and WAF rules to reduce noise and improve coverage.

  • Enrich investigations with threat intelligence, including indicators of compromise, attacker techniques, and emerging campaigns relevant to the organization.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and incident response playbooks.

  • Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, application, and security engineering teams to resolve incidents and support day-to-day operations.

  • Support vulnerability management and drive continuous improvement of the organization's overall security posture.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst, triaging alerts and investigating security incidents in a production environment.

  • Solid working knowledge of core security technologies such as EDR, SSE, SIEM, and WAF, and of how to use them to investigate and respond to threats.

  • Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and tuning these platforms, or writing and tuning detection content, is a big plus.

  • Experience with incident response and threat hunting, ideally with familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

  • Excellent understanding of network security, endpoint security, cloud security, and Zero Trust principles.

  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, BTL1, or vendor-specific credentials are a plus.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.

  • Ability to handle sensitive information responsibly and securely.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English, and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams and across time zones.

About You

You are a hands-on security analyst who wants to understand what is really happening behind an alert, rather than only closing tickets. You dig into the data, follow the evidence, and know when and how to escalate. If you have also stood up or tuned the tools you work with, or written your own detections, even better. You are structured, reliable, and comfortable working independently in a remote, follow-the-sun team, and you take pride in leaving a clear handover for the next shift. You are curious about new threats and technologies, and you enjoy working closely with both technical teams and end users to raise the security bar across the environment.

Job Requisition ID #

26WD102107

Locations

We are investing in remote Regional Field Sales roles across the APAC region.


Our story

The world’s innovators, designers, engineers, builders and creators trust Autodesk to help them design and make a better world for all.


Autodesk’s Design and Make Platform empowers customers to transform how they work through cloud-connected technology, automation, AI, data and insights. From the buildings and infrastructure around us to the products we use and the entertainment that inspires us, Autodesk technology helps our customers design and make the world around us.


Our customers are navigating significant change, including sustainability pressures, labor and supply-chain challenges, rapid technological advancement and increasing digital complexity. Global Expansion Sales helps them unlock greater value from Autodesk by uncovering new opportunities, expanding adoption and connecting Autodesk solutions to their most important business priorities.


Position Overview

As an Account Executive in Global Expansion Sales, you will own growth across an assigned portfolio of Autodesk customers.


This is a proactive expansion role with a strong hunter mindset. You will identify whitespace, self-generate qualified pipeline, build relationships with new buyers and expand Autodesk into additional teams, workflows, use cases and solution areas across your portfolio.


You will combine account insight, data and sales signals to prioritize where you spend your time, balancing disciplined portfolio coverage with the ability to create and progress meaningful six-figure commercial opportunities.

Success will be measured through expansion revenue, qualified pipeline creation, customer penetration, conversion of whitespace, sales execution and forecast accuracy.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute an expansion strategy across your assigned portfolio of named customers.
  • Proactively identify whitespace across users, teams, workflows, business priorities and Autodesk solution areas.
  • Self-generate qualified pipeline through consistent prospecting and opportunity creation within existing customer relationships.
  • Establish relationships with new contacts, influencers, decision-makers and buying centers.
  • Use customer data, market insight, product signals and business events to prioritize accounts and opportunities.
  • Use CRM, intent data, account intelligence and AI-enabled sales tools responsibly to prioritize customers, deepen research and improve sales preparation and execution.
  • Discover new use cases and connect Autodesk capabilities to meaningful customer business outcomes.
  • Create, progress and close six-figure opportunities through strong discovery, qualification, value selling and commercial execution.
  • Drive cross-sell, upsell and competitive displacement opportunities.
  • Manage the full sales cycle from discovery through negotiation and close, maintaining pace across multiple concurrent opportunities.
  • Create compelling value propositions and business cases appropriate to the customer opportunity.
  • Collaborate with Technical Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Partners and other Autodesk teams to accelerate growth.
  • Maintain disciplined Salesforce practices, healthy pipeline coverage and accurate forecasts.
  • Continuously learn from successful plays and apply those insights across the portfolio.

What Success Looks Like

Consistent achievement of expansion targets; healthy self-generated pipeline; increased penetration of Autodesk solutions; expansion into new buying centers, teams and workflows; successful creation and conversion of six-figure opportunities; competitive wins; strong CRM discipline; and accurate forecasting.


Minimum Qualifications

jobs.excerpt: Company Overviewhermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm and hedge fund.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm and hedge fund. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensure that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.

Job Overview

We are seeking experienced full-stack engineers to build the user interfaces and services for mission-critical financial applications: visual analytics platforms and data-driven tools used by traders, researchers, and analysts.

You will work on the TypeScript front-ends and the Go services that serve them. We are evolving our front-end applications into a modular, plugin-based platform that other engineers and teams build on—so you will build reusable UI modules, component libraries, and SDKs as much as end-user features, and also the Go services that ingest, process, and serve market and on-chain data to these applications. You will own your work from structured product requirements through to production.

This is a highly collaborative role in a fast-paced environment where clean design, high performance, and responsive UIs are critical to the business.

You don't need a background in trading or finance. We care most about engineering craft and will teach you the domain.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with traders, researchers, and product managers to translate complex workflows into elegant UI solutions.
  • Design and implement high-performance, responsive front-end applications using a current-generation TypeScript framework (Svelte, React, or Vue).
  • Design, build and operate Go back-end services with security and performance considerations baked into their design.
  • Own service boundaries and data contracts end-to-end, from Go services to typed front-end SDKs.
  • Build reusable UI modules, component libraries, and SDKs for a modular, plugin-based UI platform.
  • Build real-time UIs that ingest and render high-frequency market and on-chain data from multiple streaming sources.
  • Develop high-performance data visualizations for large, fast-updating datasets, using canvas-based charting (e.g. uPlot, TradingView Lightweight Charts) and D3.js for bespoke views.
  • Integrate the front-end with back-end services through typed SDKs and MCP-based interfaces, including real-time market and on-chain data.
  • Drive architecture and performance decisions for modular, extensible systems, with scalability and maintainability in mind.
  • Deploy and maintain applications, keeping them reliable and performant under heavy load.
  • Write and maintain automated tests and take part in code review to keep the codebase reliable and maintainable.
  • Support system maintenance and feature evolution with a high delivery cadence and short iteration cycles.
  • Mentor other engineers and promote engineering best practices across the team.

Requirements

Must Have

  • 7+ years of hands-on full-stack development, with production ownership on both back-end and front-end.
  • Strong, current TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and one or more modern front-end frameworks (Svelte, React, or Vue), with the adaptability to work primarily in the framework a team has chosen rather than staying tied to one.
  • Strong, current Go experience, able to design, build and operate production Go services independently.
  • Experience building reusable, well-structured UI components and shared abstractions.
  • Proven experience handling large datasets and real-time updates from back-end sources (WebSockets, Server-Sent Events).
  • Strong understanding of performance optimization and rendering strategies in data-heavy applications, including a solid grasp of the JavaScript runtime.
  • Solid testing discipline, with unit and integration tests as a normal part of delivery.
  • Genuine UI/UX sensibility—you can tell a polished interface from a rough one, and care about the difference.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and version control.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration in a cross-functional team.

Nice to Have

  • Background or strong interest in trading systems or financial platforms.
  • Exceptional design taste / portfolio-grade UI work.
  • Experience with relational databases, data warehouses, and caching strategies.
  • Experience with real-time or on-chain / crypto market data.
  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or other AI-native / agent integration.
  • Experience building developer platforms, SDKs, or shared component libraries used by other engineers.
  • Understanding of microservice architectures, continuous delivery, and zero-downtime deployment.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and observability tools such as Datadog, Grafana, or ELK.
  • Prior work in hedge funds, proprietary trading, or similar finance environments.

Interview Process

  1. CV Screening – We will review your application based on the qualifications and experience outlined above.
  2. Phone Screening – A screening session with a few on-the-spot technical questions to assess your fundamental knowledge and problem-solving approach.
  3. Assignment – A take-home assignment to demonstrate your approach, critical thinking, and relevant skills.
  4. Assignment Review – A discussion of your assignment, focusing on your approach, reasoning, and solutions.
  5. CTO Interview – Interview with the CTO to discuss your experience, technical expertise, problem-solving approach, and overall fit for the role.
  6. Co-Founder Interview – A concluding discussion to evaluate cultural fit, strategic alignment, and how you resonate with the firm’s values.

Company Values

Throughout the process, you'll be assessed for cultural fit through our company values:

  • Drive – We believe the best team members are deeply passionate about what they do. That passion fuels their growth, drives them to seek out the best teams, and leads them to hold high expectations of themselves in pursuit of excellence.
  • Ownership – We aim to extend ownership as broadly as possible across the firm. In return, we value people who take initiative, step up when needed, and treat the company’s goals as their own.
  • Judgment – We value those who see the big picture and focus on what truly drives impact and results. They use time wisely, adapt across domains, and always prioritize outcomes over comfort zones.
  • Openness – We foster a culture of open communication, mutual challenge, and shared growth. We believe constructive debate and proactive knowledge sharing lead us closer to the truth—and better decisions.
  • Competence – We work with people who bring exceptional intellectual strength. What sets them apart isn’t just what they know—it’s how they use what they know to navigate change, adapt quickly, and contribute meaningfully in fast-changing environments.
  • Resilience – We perform under pressure. Markets move fast, and so do we—but we stay grounded, focused, and calm. We embrace uncertainty, learn from setbacks, and adapt quickly without losing sight of long-term goals.

jobs.title: Manager - Microsoft AI Security & Governance
jobs.excerpt: About UsSince 1989, SHI International Corp.  has helped organizations change the world through technology.
jobs.description:
About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

The SHI Services Manager, AI Security & Governance leads a team of Engineers and Developers focused on helping customers secure and govern Microsoft AI, agents, data, agent identity, and cloud solutions. The Manager is responsible for a defined portfolio of AI security and governance services while providing specialized security and governance expertise in support of solutions led by other Microsoft Services practice groups.

This role provides leadership across team development, solution delivery, engineering and automation, customer advisory, and capability development. The Manager helps customers establish practical security, identity, data protection, compliance, monitoring, and governance controls needed to responsibly adopt AI and agent technologies.

The Manager serves as both a people leader and capability leader, ensuring the team delivers secure, scalable, and business outcome-focused solutions within its areas of responsibility. This role works closely with Data and AI, Digital Workplace, Enterprise Security, Azure Cloud Services, sales, solution architects, delivery leaders, Microsoft, and customer stakeholders to bring AI security and governance expertise into broader customer solutions.

Role Description


Team Leadership and Talent Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Engineers and Developers focused on AI security, data security, identity, governance, automation, and related Microsoft technologies.
  • Establish clear performance expectations, career development plans, and technical growth pathways.
  • Build a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, engineering excellence, and continuous learning.
  • Support recruiting, hiring, onboarding, and retention efforts to develop a strong AI security and governance capability.
  • Foster knowledge sharing and community building across Microsoft Services practices.

AI Security & Governance Capability Development

  • Define and evolve the roadmap for the AI security and governance services assigned to the team, including advisory, assessment, implementation, engineering, automation, and operational enablement offerings.
  • Develop repeatable capabilities for AI security architecture, agent security controls, AI identity and access, data protection, compliance integration, security monitoring, threat protection, and security-focused governance.
  • Partner with Microsoft and internal stakeholders to align the team’s services with evolving Microsoft AI, security, compliance, identity, and data capabilities.
  • Develop reusable intellectual property for the team’s portfolio, including reference architectures, implementation methodologies, security patterns, governance controls, accelerators, automation, code, templates, and best practices.
  • Identify emerging AI security and governance trends and recommend focused investments that strengthen SHI’s ability to help customers adopt AI securely.

Delivery Excellence


  • Provide delivery oversight and guidance for customer engagements owned by the AI Security & Governance team.
  • Ensure consistent delivery quality through architecture reviews, engineering standards, testing, governance controls, documentation, and operational best practices.
  • Guide the application of Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Security Copilot, Agent 365, and related technologies within the team’s areas of responsibility.
  • Support escalation management and risk mitigation for complex customer engagements involving the team’s services and expertise.
  • Ensure solutions are scalable, supportable, and aligned with enterprise architecture, privacy, compliance, and security standards.
  • Manage team capacity, utilization, workload, project health, and skills alignment to support reliable delivery and sustainable growth.

Engineering and Service Delivery Automation


  • Make automation a core component of how the AI Security & Governance team designs, develops, and delivers its services.
  • Identify repeatable activities within the team’s delivery portfolio that can be standardized, automated, and converted into reusable intellectual property.
  • Guide development of scripts, tools, integrations, accelerators, and automation that improve the speed, quality, consistency, and efficiency of the team’s delivery work.
  • Promote modern engineering practices using GitHub, CI/CD, PowerShell, Bicep, APIs, Infrastructure as Code, testing, and reusable components where appropriate to the team’s services.
  • Establish practices for source control, code review, testing, documentation, release management, support, and lifecycle management for assets developed by the team.
  • Collaborate with adjacent practice groups to align reusable engineering assets and avoid unnecessary duplication.

Cross-Practice Collaboration and Solution Support

  • Partner with Data and AI, Digital Workplace, Enterprise Security, Azure Cloud Services, and other Microsoft Services teams to incorporate appropriate security and governance capabilities into broader customer solutions.
  • Provide AI security, identity, data protection, compliance, monitoring, and governance expertise in support of services and engagements led by other practice groups.
  • Collaborate with agentic solution teams on security and governance requirements for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Agent 365, custom agents, and related technologies.
  • Work with Enterprise Security leadership to align AI-specific security capabilities with SHI’s broader Microsoft security portfolio and delivery standards.
  • Contribute to shared customer governance models, production-readiness approaches, reference architectures, and solution patterns without duplicating ownership held by adjacent teams.
  • Establish clear engagement models, responsibilities, and handoffs that allow teams to combine expertise and deliver an integrated customer experience.

Solution Advisory and Technical Leadership

  • Serve as a technical advisor for strategic customer opportunities that require the team’s AI security and governance expertise.
  • Guide solution decisions within the team’s areas of responsibility, including AI and agent identity, access, data protection, monitoring, threat detection, compliance, and security controls.
  • Collaborate with solution architects, engineering leaders, developers, and delivery teams to ensure technical consistency and alignment.
  • Promote security by design and governance by design approaches that connect business outcomes to technical implementation.
  • Contribute thought leadership on AI security, agent security, secure development, delivery automation, responsible AI, and enterprise governance practices.

Business Growth and Customer Success

  • Partner with sales, presales, and adjacent practice teams to support pipeline development, opportunity strategy, and solution positioning involving AI security and governance.
  • Participate in customer workshops, executive briefings, architecture discussions, and strategic planning sessions where the team’s expertise is required.
  • Support revenue growth, customer retention, and expansion opportunities within the team’s assigned portfolio and through cross-practice solutions.
  • Ensure customer engagements deliver measurable business outcomes and strong customer satisfaction.
  • Contribute to success stories, case studies, sales enablement, and market-facing thought leadership.

Behaviors and Competencies


  • Adaptability: Can lead others through change, help teams adapt to new directions, and create a culture open to change.
  • Business Acumen: Can develop and execute business plans to drive growth and profitability.
  • Change Management: Can manage major changes in organizational processes or policies, can facilitate change management processes among others, can mentor others in effective change management, and can adapt change management style based on the situation and the organization’s needs.
  • Collaboration: Can take ownership of team initiatives, foster a collaborative environment, and ensure that all team members feel valued and heard.
  • Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information to diverse audiences, facilitate effective communication between others, and mentor others in effective communication.
  • Continuous Improvement: Can identify major areas for improvement, implement major changes, and support others in their continuous improvement efforts.
  • Customer-Centric Mindset: Can take ownership of customer-centric initiatives, ensuring products and services align with customer needs. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to integrate customer feedback into product development.
  • Leadership: Can take ownership of complex team initiatives, collaborate with others in decision-making processes, and drive team performance.
  • Problem-Solving: Can proactively identify and take ownership of complex problem-solving initiatives, initiate preventative measures, collaborate with others to find solutions, and drive successful outcomes.
  • Strategic Thinking: Can analyze complex situations, anticipate future trends, and align and integrate strategies across departments or functions.

Skill Level Requirements


This role requires strength across the following areas. Deep expertise in every platform is not required, but broad experience across these capabilities is important for success. Candidates should not self-select out if they do not meet every preferred qualification.


  • Bachelor's degree in a technical, business, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Seven or more years of experience delivering solutions across cybersecurity, cloud engineering, software development, automation, identity, data protection, AI governance, or related technologies.
  • Three or more years of experience leading technical teams, practices, or consulting organizations.
  • Experience leading Engineers, Developers, Architects, Consultants, or similarly technical professionals.
  • Strong understanding of AI security, agent security, identity, data protection, information governance, compliance, monitoring, threat detection, and incident response.
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Security Copilot, or related Microsoft security technologies.
  • Understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Foundry, Agent 365, Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI, or related AI and data platforms.
  • Experience using automation to improve service delivery, engineering, or operational processes.
  • Understanding of GitHub, CI/CD, PowerShell, Bicep, APIs, Infrastructure as Code, source control, testing, and reusable engineering components.
  • Proven success working across multiple technical practices or delivery teams to support integrated customer solutions.
  • Experience building service offerings, accelerators, automation, methodologies, technical communities, or reusable intellectual property.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and organizational leadership skills.

Relevant certifications may include Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert, Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Microsoft Certified: Information Security Administrator Associate, Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate, Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate, or equivalent experience.

Other Requirements


  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with sales, delivery, engineering, development, and leadership stakeholders.

jobs.excerpt: About UsZepto is building the beating heart of Australia's real-time, account-to-account payments revolution.
jobs.description:
About Us

Zepto is building the beating heart of Australia's real-time, account-to-account payments revolution.

It's a good moment to be doing this work. Card surcharging rules have changed, Payday Super is live, and many businesses are taking a serious look at account-to-account payments for the first time. A lot of that shift lands on our platform, and we're looking for action-oriented engineers to help build category-defining infrastructure.

Payments is a domain where the details matter. When someone's wages or a business's cash flow moves through our platform, it has to arrive correctly, every time, in seconds. Meeting that bar in a regulated industry makes for interesting engineering problems. As a Software Engineer you'll own real pieces of how we solve them, working alongside senior engineers who'll help you grow your scope quickly.

We're a remote-first team that works closely together. Engineers here are trusted to make decisions, encouraged to share their thinking, and supported to grow. That culture is part of why we've been named FinTech Organisation of the Year at the Finnies twice.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain features on our high-volume, real-time payment APIs, shipping clean, tested, observable code into a mission-critical, regulated environment.
  • Work in a cross-functional team, contributing to technical designs and RFCs and turning them into well-scoped, shippable work.
  • Review your peers' code and pair regularly, learning from senior engineers and sharing what you know.
  • Collaborate with Platform, Security and Incident Management teams, and join our shared on-call rotation once you're up to speed.

What You'll Bring

  • Solid backend foundations: Commercial experience in a backend language and API development. We work in Ruby and Go. Ruby experience is a plus, but strong fundamentals and a willingness to learn matter more to us than your current language.
  • Good engineering practices: Experience with test-driven development, code review and continuous delivery. Exposure to public cloud (preferably AWS) or event-driven systems is a plus.
  • Ownership: You take a piece of work from inception to production and make sure it works once it's there.
  • AI adoption: AI is changing how engineering works, and you're evolving with it. You use tools like Claude Code or Cursor in your day-to-day delivery and stay curious as capabilities improve, while reviewing generated code as carefully as your own and respecting data security boundaries.
  • Clear, open communication: You share work in progress early, ask good questions, and raise risks when you see them. You ask for help early when you're stuck.
  • Front-end experience (React, TypeScript) is a bonus: Plenty of our work spans the stack, from the APIs that move money to the merchant-facing UIs built on them, so engineers who can follow their work through to the UI add real value.

Your First 6 Months

  • Week 1: You'll be paired with an onboarding buddy to get familiar with our domains, understand the business context across teams, and ship your first changes to production.
  • Month 1: You're delivering stories within your team's domain and reviewing code with growing context. You understand how merchants and internal staff use the Zepto platform, and you're building relationships across product, engineering and the wider business. You've probably spotted something we could do better, whether that's a clunky endpoint, a confusing error message or a gap in our docs, and either fixed it or raised it with the team.
  • Month 6: You're delivering features end to end with growing independence: working through requirements with product, contributing to the design, and seeing your work land in production. You've contributed to an RFC, you're part of the on-call rotation, and you're confident supporting the systems your team owns.

Why Zepto?

Headquartered in beautiful Byron Bay, Zepto has an inspiring founder story and is a customer-focused, culture-first organisation. You'll be joining a team that champions curiosity and a pioneering perspective, and thrives in a fast-moving sector.

Just some of Zepto's commitments to our people include:

  • Join a Talented Team: Work with world-class talent and leaders who support career growth
  • Flexible Work: A remote-first work culture, with the opportunity to work anywhere in Australia. You'll also get access to premium co-working spaces and a Byron, Sydney & Melbourne Hub
  • Paid Parental Leave: 12 weeks Paid Parental Leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary caregivers
  • Wellbeing Focus: Access to Zepto's Wellbeing Menu, which includes 3 x paid Wellbeing Days per year and access to an Employee Assistance Program
  • Annual Learning Budget: An individual learning budget, and 4 x paid Growth & Impact Days annually to focus on professional development
  • Remote-Work Support: A $500 Remote Work Budget to set up your home office upon commencement, and $300 annually from your 2nd Zeptoversary

About Cogstate

At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

About the Clinician Network

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

All applicants to the Clinician Network are kept in our active pipeline, and you’ll also receive our monthly Clinician Network newsletter, which shares updates and upcoming openings.

About the Role

Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.

Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. Regular supervision and ongoing recalibration of clinical skill set will be provided.

*These are contract position.

*Hired employee will work on an as needed basis based on their schedule.

- MADRS Administration Experience Required
- Dutch Fluency Required

Central Rating

  • Scoring completed scale administrations.
  • Participating in regular clinical skill recalibration activities.

Central Monitoring

  • Providing reviews of completed neuropsychological test batteries for central monitoring of data to ensure accuracy in administration and scoring and contribute to the overall success of a clinical trial.
  • Reviewing response forms and recordings of remote scale administrations and offering feedback to raters via email and telephone communications.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MD, DO, MBBS or PhD, PsyD in Psychology or RN, APRN, PA, MA/MS/MSW in Psychiatry (or equivalent)
  • Formal training in clinical interviewing and cognitive assessment

  • Direct experience with cognitive/behavioral/functional assessment of neurological/psychiatric populations
  • Ability to meet deadlines, being highly organized and methodical, with attention to detail to ensure delivery
  • Proficiency with MS Office, including Word and Excel, email, teleconference platforms such as Skype, Zoom or other similar applications, and cloud-based storage service.
  • Dutch Fluency
  • MADRS Administration Experience Required

We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

DELIVERY LEAD

Fully remote (UK-based), with optional office work at our Maidstone (Kent) and Leamington Spa offices.

About LAB

We’re a company that cares about the humans behind the tech.

At LAB, we believe in the power of digital to reshape the world for good. That belief drives the work we do every day, and we're proud to support our team as they create innovative solutions that make a real impact for our clients.

As part of the Human First Collective - alongside Reflect Digital (digital marketing) and Aspiration Digital (our non-profit digital skills conference for students) - we’ve built a culture that encourages people to love what they do and do what they love. We’re deeply committed to the growth and development of our people, and we take pride in creating an environment where everyone can thrive.

With a broad portfolio of work - from major household brands to small startups, and even internal initiatives aimed at making the world a better place - every day brings new challenges, opportunities, and inspiration.

Our Core Values

Our values shape how we work with each other and with our clients:

  • People First. Always:We lead with empathy, keep things transparent and never forget the humans behind the tech.

  • Growth Fuelled by Curiosity:We challenge assumptions, value critical thinking and put continuous improvement ahead of perfection.

  • We Win Together:We act as an extension of our clients’ teams and take shared responsibility for the outcomes we create.

About the role

Are you an experienced digital project manager ready to step up into leading a delivery team, without stepping away from the work itself?

We’re looking for a Delivery Lead to run some of our most complex client projects, lead our project management team, and own how resources are planned across the agency. You’ll spend around half your time hands-on with clients, and the rest leading the team, keeping resources and commercials on track, and shaping a delivery approach that is human-first and AI-assisted.

Our work is varied. One week you might be phasing a 12-month website re-platform, the next keeping a UX research project to time and budget, or prioritising the backlog on a continuous improvement retainer. You’ll report to our Technical Director and work closely with our engineering, product design and client services leads.

This is a fully remote, UK-based role, so you’ll need the right to work in the UK. Many of our clients are London-based, so you’ll also need to be able to travel to London and other client locations for in-person sessions as projects kick off, and to our quarterly team days, typically held in Kent or London.

What you’ll be doing

Delivering complex client projects

  • Run large, complex projects end to end, from discovery and stakeholder workshops through technical build, launch and client training.

  • Shape statements of work, timelines and project plans, so what we promise is what we deliver.

  • Keep budgets, scope, risks and change requests under control, and lead the difficult conversations about phasing when they’re needed.

  • Work with tech leads to turn requirements into well-defined Jira tickets the team can pick up and run with.

Leading and growing the delivery team

  • Line manage two Project Managers and a Digital Support Manager, helping them grow through LAB’s development framework.

  • Be the team’s go-to for advice, guidance and escalation.

  • Help the team adopt new tools, approaches and AI-assisted ways of working.

Owning resource and commercial health

  • Run the weekly resource meeting and resolve conflicts across competing deadlines and clients.

  • Forecast demand against the sales pipeline, so we have the right people, permanent or freelance, ahead of need.

  • Keep revenue recognition accurate across projects and give senior leadership a clear monthly view of delivery.

Raising the bar on how we deliver

  • Set a consistent approach to project plans, ceremonies and documentation across every project.

  • Clarify where client services and project management meet, and make the hand-offs work.

  • Find practical ways for AI and automation to cut admin and improve quality, while keeping people at the centre.

  • Collaborating with the Delivery Manager at our sister agency

What you’ll bring to the table

  • Agency experience:Extensive experience in digital project or delivery management, particularly in a digital agency, ideally a technically led one.

  • Complex delivery:A track record of delivering website, platform, or app projects across research, UX, design, and development, including full re-platforms.

  • Technical understanding:Enough to follow what’s being defined, and to work with tech leads on build-ready tickets.

  • Commercial control:Confident with budgets, burn, forecasting, change requests, and revenue recognition.

  • People leadership:Experience managing and developing other project managers.

  • Calm communication:Clear and confident with clients and senior stakeholders, including when the conversation is a difficult one.

It’s a bonus if you’ve used Productive and Jira, run continuous improvement retainers, or used AI tools to improve how projects are delivered.

What we offer you

  • Salary:£50-60k DOE

  • Work/Life Balance:Flexible working, 4-day work week, remote.

  • Annual Leave:28 days (ex., Bank Holidays) plus Birthdays, Charity day and between Christmas and New Year.

  • Healthcare:Private Healthcare from Vitality.

  • Weekly Wellbeing Sessions

  • Access to trained Mental Health First Aiders (MHFA)

  • Lunch & Learn and Brunch & Learn sessions

  • Training Opportunities

  • Career Progression

  • Agency Partnerships

How to apply

Ready to lead delivery at an agency that puts people first?

Just click “Apply”, complete the application form, and send over your CV.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Diversity and inclusion are at the heart of what we value as an organisation. LAB is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other status protected by law. Our People team is happy to support any reasonable adjustments that are needed within the recruitment process. We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment for all employees, volunteers, subcontractors, freelancers, and clients. Your information will be kept confidential according to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

Serving as a trusted partner to investigators, institutional leaders, and external collaborators, the Agreements Manager oversees a diverse portfolio of agreements that facilitate research partnerships, technology transfer activities, intellectual property management, and industry engagement. The role provides strategic guidance throughout the agreement lifecycle, balancing scientific, operational, legal, and business considerations to support both near-term research objectives and long-term institutional goals.

As part of the TDIE team, the Agreements Manager helps bridge the gap between discovery and impact by enabling collaborations that accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative technologies, therapeutics, diagnostics, and research tools. Through effective negotiation, compliance oversight, relationship management, and stewardship of intellectual property assets, this position plays a vital role in maximizing the global reach and influence of St. Jude innovations while supporting the institution's commitment to advancing pediatric health worldwide.

This position may be eligible for remote work. However, St. Jude requires all remote employees to:

  • Travel to our Memphis campus for the interview process and/or orientation, if selected
  • Travel to Memphis to work on-site for one week per quarter, or as requested based on business needs, if hired.

  • Proactively builds and maintains key relationships within and outside the organization.
  • Guides structured evaluation of priorities with stakeholders for critical decision-making with a long term focus.
  • Facilitates communication and solutioning between stakeholders to address needs and perspectives.
  • Explores, identifies, and implements best practices around project management tools and risk management frameworks.
  • Leads complex/ long-term projects with a focus on resources, contingencies, and budgets.
  • Proactively engages with internal and external project leadership/ cross functional teams to optimize project outcomes.
  • Drives development of project management capabilities within organization to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Strategizes value-based messaging and storytelling approaches through compelling narratives that influence the audience and inspire action.
  • Exhibits thought leadership in brand management practices, actively contributing to advancing the brand's long-term success and functional practices and standards.
  • Builds internal connections and external partnerships across executive/leadership levels.
  • Strategically understands stakeholder needs and manages expectations and relationships on a regular basis.
  • Can handle highly sensitive or tough situations with social and emotional grace and maturity.
  • Models resourcefulness by reaching out to people within and outside functional groups to get work done effectively.
  • Keeps large teams/ departments energized and focused on high-quality results by leveraging data/ analytics-based approaches.
  • Builds systems, processes, and capabilities that can set and deliver a high-performance culture.
  • Shows strong skills in thinking critically with a systemic view.
  • Shows expertise in taking a structured approach to analyze and resolve issues.
  • Able to distinguish between different sets of issues, set priorities, and make decisions.

Wir lernen voneinander, geben und nehmen aktiv Feedback und wachsen gemeinsam als Team. Unsere Überzeugung, dass digitale Bildung Großes bewegen kann, ist dabei ein zentraler Antrieb. Dein Verantwortungsbereich:

Wir glauben daran, dass Schulen ihren Unterricht mit unserem Produkt ganz einfach digital gestalten können. Deswegen wollen wir sofatutor im Schulbereich noch bekannter machen und neue Partnerschaften aufbauen. jobs.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a curious and technically sharp FinOps & Product Analytics Engineer to join our DevOps & Cloud Platform team. In this role, you will build the data foundation and AI-powered tooling that turns operational data into clear, actionable insight for engineering, product, and finance stakeholders across Intapp.


We are starting with FinOps — cloud cost, cost allocation, anomaly detection, and usage visibility — but this role is designed to grow. As we expand into product usage analytics and additional data domains, you will help shape how we ingest, model, and surface that data through both AI-powered chat and dashboards. Subject matter experts guide the requirements; your job is to build the “how”: reliable data models, AI-powered reporting tools, and analytics layers that teams actually rely on.


About Intapp:

Intapp, based in Silicon Valley, is a leader in Vertical AI SaaS company, collaborating with over 2,550 professional and financial services firms globally. With 20+ years of industry expertise, Intapp's "Intelligence Applied" approach is transforming how businesses operate and leverages a strategic partner with Microsoft in delivering industry cloud solutions. The company culture promotes accountability, responsibility, and growth in a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative environment. Since going public in 2021, Intapp has expanded to over 1,600 employees globally with development centers in Palo Alto, Charlotte, Belfast, Berlin, and Lisbon.


What You Will Do:

  • Design and maintain analytical data models — schemas, views, and aggregations — that correctly represent FinOps data including cloud cost, cost allocation, anomaly signals, infrastructure usage, and unit economics, with additional domains to follow.
  • Build ingestion and normalization pipelines that clean and unify data from heterogeneous sources — AWS and Azure billing, SaaS platforms, product telemetry, and internal systems — into a consistent, queryable analytical layer.
  • Develop AI-powered reporting skills in Python using MCP (Model Context Protocol) that return structured, reliable answers to stakeholder questions — covering cost anomalies, team-level spend breakdowns, usage trends, and more as new domains come online.
  • Implement prompt engineering and output validation layers that make AI-generated answers trustworthy — handling empty results, ambiguous time ranges, and conflicting data gracefully.
  • Build and maintain dashboards in Metabase covering FinOps metrics (showback, chargeback, anomaly signals, unit costs) and expanding to additional domains as the platform grows.
  • Collaborate with FinOps experts, product managers, and other domain leads to translate requirements into accurate data models and query patterns that reflect how the underlying data actually behaves.
  • Help evaluate and contribute to architecture decisions as new data domains and source systems are brought into the platform.
  • Document data models, AI skill patterns, and pipeline logic so the broader team can understand, extend, and trust what you build.
  • Continuously improve data quality, query performance, and AI output reliability as the platform scales in volume, variety, and scope.

What You Will Need:

  • Strong SQL skills — complex aggregations, window functions, joins across large datasets, and the instinct to investigate when a number looks wrong before shipping.
  • Python proficiency — clean, maintainable scripts for data transformation, normalization, and tooling (not just notebooks).
  • Experience with analytical or columnar databases — such as ClickHouse, BigQuery, Redshift, DuckDB, or similar.
  • Demonstrated experience building with an LLM API (Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar) — you understand tool use, structured outputs, and what it takes to make AI responses consistent and reliable.
  • Ability to work from well-defined requirements: translating a subject matter expert’s question into a data model and query that accurately answers it.
  • Comfort in a greenfield environment — able to make sound architectural decisions when patterns are still being established.
  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar function-calling / tool-use patterns for LLMs (preferred).

What you will gain at Intapp:

Our culture at Intapp emphasizes accountability, responsibility, and growth. We support each other in a positive, open atmosphere that fosters creativity, approachability, and teamwork. We’re committed to creating a modern work environment that’s connected yet flexible, supporting both professional success and work-life balance. In return for your passion, commitment, and collaborative approach, we offer:

- Attractive compensation – including competitive base pay and performance-based variable pay.

- Equity/Stock in Intapp.Opportunity to travel to other development centers for product training and cross-site collaboration.

- One-time home office stipend.

- Generous paid parental leave (including adoptive leave), marriage leave, bereavement leave, carer's leave, and paid sick days.

- Reimbursement for training towards continuing education.

Intapp provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and will make hiring decisions without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please note: Intapp will not hire through text message, social media, or email alone. We will never extend a job offer unless you have been contacted directly by an Intapp recruiter and have participated in the interview process which will generally consist of 3 or more virtual or in person meetings. Please note that Intapp only uses company email addresses, which contain “@intapp.com” or “@dealcloud.com” to communicate with candidates via email. New platforms, new behaviours, new audiences, new trends, new technologies, new regulations—our clients’ worlds get more complex daily. Their agency partnerships shouldn’t. It’s our job to cut through the chaos, make the complex simple and navigate a clear path to growth for them.

That’s why we make it our mission to capitalise on complexity for our clients—across consultancy, capability and execution—by crafting dynamic digital solutions that outpace tomorrow’s challenges.

Our values

We run at change and challenge convention because we love to push the boundaries of what the world thinks is possible. We champion discovery, go deep into our clients’ worlds and are always hungry to learn more about them, our specialisms and each other.

  • Connected Clarity.

We are focused in our collaboration — joining the right dots between our clients, our partners and our herd of experts to deliver agile solutions at speed and scale. We set a shared ambition from the outset, are transparent at every stage and always strive to make the complex simple.

  • Positive Encouragement.

We want to make working with us the best part of someone’s day. We lift one other up, find the fun in the day to day and are committed to ensuring everyone belongs.

  • Constant Impact.

We believe in outcomes over outputs. We’re goal orientated, results driven and data led. We show up with passion every day. And we’re always honing our craft.

Brave Bison Commerce

With over 300 ecommerce projects and £2billion worth of transactions under our belt, we’ve designed and built hundreds of bespoke digital solutions for complex B2B, B2C, D2C and B2B2C companies.

Whether we’re modernising a monolith platform or building a fully composable solution, we ensure our clients are ready to meet customers anywhere – online, mobile, in-store or on social – unlocking a brave new world of possibility.

Job Specification

We are looking for a Senior Developer with strong expertise in PHP, Laravel and Adobe Commerce (Magento) to join Brave Bison Commerce. You will spend most of your time building high-quality ecommerce solutions for our clients, taking ownership of complex features and integrations from design through to release. Working closely with our Technical Leads and Solution Architects, you will help shape the technical approach on your projects and bring practical ideas for improving the platforms we build. This role suits an experienced developer who wants to stay hands-on and solve interesting problems.

Development

  • Design, build and maintain features for Adobe Commerce / Magento 2, including custom modules, theming, checkout and admin functionality.
  • Develop Laravel applications, APIs and services that extend or integrate with our clients’ ecommerce platforms.
  • Build and maintain integrations with third-party systems such as ERP, PIM, OMS, payment gateways and search.
  • Take ownership of complex tickets and features, from understanding the requirement through to testing and release.
  • Carry out Magento platform upgrades, patching and extension updates.
  • Diagnose and fix performance, stability and security issues on live platforms.
  • Write clean, well-tested code that follows our standards, and take part in code reviews.

Solutions and collaboration

  • Contribute to technical solution design, working with Technical Leads and Solution Architects to find the right approach for each requirement.
  • Estimate development work and raise risks or dependencies early.
  • Join client calls and discovery sessions when technical input is needed, explaining options clearly.
  • Suggest practical improvements to the platforms you work on, such as performance gains, better integrations or upgrades, and share them with your Technical Lead.
  • Support less experienced developers with advice and pairing when needed.

Qualifications:

  • Solid commercial experience as a PHP developer (typically 3+ years).
  • Essential: strong hands-on experience with Adobe Commerce / Magento 2, including custom module development, theming, checkout and upgrades.
  • Good Laravel experience, including building APIs, services and standalone applications.
  • Experience integrating ecommerce platforms with third-party systems and APIs.
  • Good knowledge of MySQL, Git, Composer and modern PHP practices, including automated testing.
  • Experience working with cloud or hosting environments (for example Adobe Commerce Cloud or AWS) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently on complex tasks.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the confidence to speak with clients when needed.

Nice-to-Have:

  • BigCommerce experience, including its APIs, theming or headless builds.
  • Adobe Commerce or BigCommerce certifications.
  • Experience with Hyvä Themes, or with headless and composable frontends.
  • Agency or consultancy experience working across multiple clients.

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

  • Engage ENT customers within assigned geographical territory and deliver clinically focused message to introduce, launch, grow brand-share and revenue and to consistently deliver on product goals for atopic dermatitis and asthma indications.

  • Establish relationship with thought leaders in assigned territory. Primary objective is to drive industry leading customer value.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year college or university.
  • 3+ years of pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device sales experience or other relevant life science or clinical experience strongly preferred.

Preferred:

  • Demonstrated ability to learn and apply technical and scientific product-related information.

  • 2+ years selling experience calling on ENTs, Allergists or Dermatologists strongly preferred.
  • Alliance/matrix partnership experience strongly preferred.

jobs.description:
The SOC Lead is responsible for leading the day-to-day operations of the organization's global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center, ensuring that security events are monitored, investigated, and responded to effectively around the clock. Based in Europe, the SOC Lead manages a distributed team of SOC Analysts across multiple regions and time zones. The role goes beyond supervising a queue: the focus is on setting operational standards, owning the incident response process, driving the quality of investigations and handovers, and continuously improving detection and response capabilities. The ideal candidate combines strong hands-on SOC experience with proven leadership, and thrives in a fast-paced, fully remote setting where accuracy, discipline, and security are essential. Hands-on engineering experience with core security platforms is a big plus.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a distributed team of SOC Analysts working across multiple regions in a follow-the-sun model.

  • Own the SOC schedule and shift rotations, including weekend coverage, ensuring continuous coverage across all time zones.

  • Define and enforce the shift handover process, so that open investigations, ongoing incidents, and pending actions continue seamlessly around the clock.

  • Act as the primary escalation point for the team and as incident lead for major security incidents, coordinating triage, analysis, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident reviews with relevant teams.

  • Perform hands-on triage, investigation, and threat hunting alongside the team across the security stack, including SIEM, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Service Edge (SSE), and Web Application Firewall (WAF) platforms.

  • Review the quality of investigations and incident documentation, providing structured feedback and ensuring consistent standards across shifts and regions.

  • Define, track, and report SOC metrics and KPIs, such as alert volumes, mean time to detect, mean time to respond, and false positive rates.

  • Drive the improvement of detection content together with security engineering, prioritizing the tuning of SIEM correlation rules, EDR custom detections, and WAF rules, and mapping coverage to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, incident response playbooks, and escalation matrices.

  • Contribute to the hiring, onboarding, and training of new SOC Analysts.

  • Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, application, and security engineering teams, as well as management, to resolve incidents and support day-to-day operations.

  • Support vulnerability management and drive continuous improvement of the organization's overall security posture.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • At least 5 years of hands-on experience in Security Operations, including at least 1 year as a SOC Lead or in an equivalent team lead role.

  • Proven experience triaging alerts, investigating security incidents, and leading the response to major incidents in a production environment.

  • Solid working knowledge of core security technologies such as EDR, SSE, SIEM, and WAF, and of how to use them to investigate and respond to threats.

  • Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and tuning these platforms, or writing and tuning detection content, is a big plus.

  • Experience leading or working in a 24/7 or follow-the-sun SOC, including managing shift schedules and remote teams across time zones.

  • Strong experience with incident response and threat hunting, ideally with familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

  • Excellent understanding of network security, endpoint security, cloud security, and Zero Trust principles.

  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, GSOM, CISSP, or vendor-specific credentials are a plus.

  • Strong leadership, analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.

  • Ability to handle sensitive information responsibly and securely.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to report to management and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders during incidents.

About You

You are an experienced SOC practitioner who has moved into leadership without losing your hands-on edge. You know what good triage and investigation look like, and you know how to build a team that delivers them consistently across shifts and time zones. You stay calm during major incidents, communicate clearly with both engineers and management, and make sound decisions under pressure. If you have also stood up or tuned the tools your team relies on, or written your own detections, even better. You are structured, reliable, and comfortable leading a fully remote team, and you enjoy coaching analysts, improving processes, and raising the security bar across the environment.

The Opportunity

We're migrating from BigQuery to Snowflake, and you'll be the hands-on Snowflake expert who runs the platform and makes sure it stays secure, observable, and well managed as our data footprint grows with machine learning, AI, and structured and semi-structured data from AWS S3 and external vendor files.

This is a tactical, hands-on role supporting the data team and application teams across multiple business verticals. You'll bring data operations practices together in one place, and over time that scope will grow to include the Postgres and NoSQL databases our application teams use. We need deep Snowflake expertise combined with the breadth to look beyond it: how all of our data tools, vendors, access, and costs fit together, and opportunities to improve platform practices. You bring demonstrated experience managing complex data platforms and improving their operations.

  • Extend platform practices to operational databases. Extend consistent operational practices to the Postgres and NoSQL databases used by application teams, including backups, performance, and access.

Security & Access

  • Secure the data. Apply least-privilege permissions, design appropriate data access roles, and integrate our data tools with SSO, with encryption and auditing for sensitive data.
  • Manage data vendors and tools. Manage the external vendors and tools used by our data team, covering access, SSO integration, configuration, and licensing.

Reliability & Cost

  • Keep it observable and reliable. Build monitoring and observability across our data pipelines and platform, and define and run the incident management process, from response through root cause and follow-up.
  • Improve cost transparency. Track and attribute spend across Snowflake and data tooling, provide teams with clear cost visibility, and drive optimization.

Support Across Teams

  • Support multiple teams. Serve as the data operations point of contact for teams across business verticals, helping resolve operational challenges and establishing reusable practices and documentation.

What You Bring

Required:

  • 7+ years of professional experience in data platform engineering, DataOps, or DevOps, with a track record of operating production data platforms.
  • Deep Snowflake expertise, including administration, role-based access control, warehouse management, performance, and cost.
  • Strong security and access management skills, including least-privilege role design, SSO integration, encryption, and audit logging.
  • Experience with AWS data storage and access, including S3, IAM, and the networking that governs data access.
  • Experience building monitoring, observability, and incident management for data pipelines and platforms.
  • Experience with cloud data cost visibility and management, including reporting spend clearly to technical and non-technical teams.
  • Experience administering data vendor tools, such as ingestion, orchestration, BI, and data quality platforms.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD for data workloads (e.g., Terraform, dbt deployments).

  • Broad understanding of the data ecosystem, including how platforms, tools, and processes integrate and where improvements are needed.
  • Strong communication skills and a track record of supporting multiple teams and helping teams adopt shared practices.

Preferred (Nice to Have):

  • Experience migrating a data warehouse to Snowflake, or working knowledge of BigQuery.
  • Snowflake certifications.
  • Experience supporting data infrastructure for machine learning and AI workloads.
  • Experience with orchestration and transformation tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt).
  • Experience with data governance, catalog, or compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, or in a regulated or document-heavy industry such as legal or financial services.

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.

Know Someone Perfect for This Role? We offer a referral fee of $2,500 CAD.

NOTE: This role is perfect for 'Corporate Event Marketers', for all EventMobi fans and customers and experienced 'Conference Managers' we have another role coming up soon as the Customer Marketing Manager where you will be teaching and helping other conference planners how best to utilize and adopt EventMobi event platform to manage their annual conferences and help amplify their success stories.

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN US?

You are at the top of your ‘event’ game and excited by the idea of marketing events and event tech to the people who run them. And even more excited to grow EventMobi’s event team and our portfolio of events.

Our customers are experienced conference organizers. So is the crowd at every show we exhibit at. You'll walk the floor knowing your audience better than anyone in the building, because you are your audience. Our marketing ethos is to offer value at every interaction, and in-person events are the best way to educate and engage the events community and our customer base.

You'll own EventMobi's entire events program: the trade shows, the sponsorships, and the events we host ourselves. Strategy, budget, messaging, booth, results. Start with local workshops and exclusive dinners, build momentum, and turn it into our first user conference. Not many people get to say they launched one of those.

EventMobi is a one-of-a-kind bootstrapped gem, built on people who show up for each other. Founded in 2010, and growing sustainably. No VC money shenanigans or crazy expectations. Every dollar you put into an event has a job to do, and you'll know exactly what it earned.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You're a marketer first. Events are your channel, and pipeline is your scoreboard. Your secret weapon is superb organization and project management.
  • You know your events cost per opportunity before anyone asks. And you'd rather cut a beloved event than defend one that doesn't pay off.

WHAT YOUR WORK WILL FOCUS ON

1. Own the Tradeshow Floor

For every show, you own the whole story: the calendar, budget, messaging, the pre-show marketing push, booth design, shipping, staffing and on-site execution. You make sure potential buyers know where to find us, work with Demand Gen and Sales to fill the calendar with meetings before the doors open, and ensure every lead lands in HubSpot, attributed. On the floor, you're the event tech expert in the room. You know what competitors are up to, how EventMobi stacks up, and you design the activation to create the differentiation.

2. Make Every Sponsored Event Pay Off

When we sponsor an industry event with our event tech, your team is the single point of contact. You lock the give/get in writing early, run our on-site presence, and grow our database with every opt-in. You partner with Customer Success so their event is a hit, spot the features they should be using next, and hand advocacy wins like case studies and reviews to Customer Marketing.

3. Build EventMobi’s Owned Events, From Local Dinners to Our First User Conference
You decide what every event we host is for: new pipeline or deeper customer relationships. Then you build it: format, agenda, speakers, venue, run of show, and the marketing that fills the room. Everything runs on EventMobi, because our own events are the best demo we've got. You'll start with local workshops and meetups and grow them into our annual user conference.

4. Run It Like Your Business

You keep the single source of truth for every event, project manage each one, own vendors and contracts, and forecast the budget so there are no surprises. Every quarter, you bring the VP of Marketing a clear call on what to scale, what to maintain and what to cut, backed by spend, pipeline and revenue.

SUPPORT & COLLABORATION

You can’t do this alone. Here's who's in it with you:

  • Event Coordinator: reports to you, full-time from day one. As the program grows, so does the team.
  • VP of Marketing: your manager and biggest support. Direction, prioritization, and the person who clears blockers.
  • Demand Gen: deploys your campaigns and partners with you on target accounts and meeting bookings.
  • Sales: your crew on the floor, and the people who turn booth conversations into revenue. Most are pros at this, but there are always our noobs who will love your help and guidance to show up strong.
  • Customer Success: Supports the build and management of event tech for the sponsored industry conferences.
  • Marketing Operations: HubSpot, attribution and reporting, so your numbers hold up in any room.
  • Tools: HubSpot, Claude, Zapier, Notion, Fellow, Slack, Google Workspace, and of course, the EventMobi platform itself.

  • 8+ years in corporate event marketing at a B2B company. You've been the exhibitor in the booth, not just the agency or the organizer running the show.
  • You've managed a high volume of third-party trade shows and sponsored events portfolio
  • You have been involved in the planning and execution of a mid-size user conference and exclusive dinner series.

  • Bonus points if you already know this industry from the inside. IMEX, MPI, PCMA, CSAE, ASAE are familiar acronyms to you.
  • You've owned an event budget and can show what each event returned in pipeline and revenue. Not just badge scans.
  • You write sharp event messaging and copy yourself, and you're proud of it.
  • You treat HubSpot and attribution as part of the job, demand gen is there for support but you know where your event leads are at.
  • You're up for travelling about once a month across North America and Europe

WHAT TO EXPECT FROM EVENTMOBI?

  • Tools: Top-of-the-line hardware and the best collaboration software for remote work, so you can be as productive as possible while working from home
  • The Best Coworkers Ever: If you ask anyone who has worked at EventMobi, they will tell you that their fellow Mobiers are the best part of their experience! Don't underestimate the positive impact caring co-workers have on your everyday happiness.

REMOTE WORKSPACE REQUIREMENTS

  • You have a safe, comfortable, and ergonomic workspace and working environment - a private and quiet workspace is a vital requirement for doing your best work!
  • You have a reliable internet connection capable of participating in video calls, with at least 30 Mbps download speed.

MORE ABOUT EVENTMOBI
