jobs.excerpt: About the jobThe SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center.
jobs.description:
About the job

The SOC Analyst is responsible for the continuous monitoring, triage, and investigation of security events across the organization's environment, as part of a global follow-the-sun Security Operations Center. This position reports to the SOC Lead. The role goes beyond acknowledging alerts: the focus is on understanding what each alert means, investigating suspicious activity end to end, responding to real threats, and handing over cleanly between regions so that nothing is lost across shifts. The ideal candidate has solid SOC experience, a strong investigative mindset, and thrives in a fast-paced, fully remote setting where accuracy, discipline, and security are essential. Hands-on engineering experience with core security platforms is a big plus.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor, triage, and analyze security alerts and events from the organization's security stack, including SIEM, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Service Edge (SSE), and Web Application Firewall (WAF) platforms.

  • Investigate security incidents end to end, from initial triage through analysis, containment, eradication, and post-incident documentation, coordinating with relevant teams throughout.

  • Determine the scope, severity, and impact of security events, separating true positives from false positives and escalating confirmed incidents according to defined procedures.

  • Execute response actions within the security platforms, such as isolating endpoints, blocking indicators, disabling compromised accounts, and enforcing access restrictions.

  • Ensure structured, high-quality shift handovers across regions in the follow-the-sun model, so that open investigations, ongoing incidents, and pending actions continue seamlessly around the clock.

  • Proactively threat hunt across endpoint, network, and log data to uncover suspicious activity that existing detections may have missed, mapping findings to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Provide feedback on detection quality and contribute to the tuning of SIEM correlation rules, EDR custom detections, and WAF rules to reduce noise and improve coverage.

  • Enrich investigations with threat intelligence, including indicators of compromise, attacker techniques, and emerging campaigns relevant to the organization.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and incident response playbooks.

  • Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, application, and security engineering teams to resolve incidents and support day-to-day operations.

  • Support vulnerability management and drive continuous improvement of the organization's overall security posture.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience as a SOC Analyst, triaging alerts and investigating security incidents in a production environment.

  • Solid working knowledge of core security technologies such as EDR, SSE, SIEM, and WAF, and of how to use them to investigate and respond to threats.

  • Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and tuning these platforms, or writing and tuning detection content, is a big plus.

  • Experience with incident response and threat hunting, ideally with familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

  • Excellent understanding of network security, endpoint security, cloud security, and Zero Trust principles.

  • Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GCIA, GCIH, BTL1, or vendor-specific credentials are a plus.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.

  • Ability to handle sensitive information responsibly and securely.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English, and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams and across time zones.

About You

You are a hands-on security analyst who wants to understand what is really happening behind an alert, rather than only closing tickets. You dig into the data, follow the evidence, and know when and how to escalate. If you have also stood up or tuned the tools you work with, or written your own detections, even better. You are structured, reliable, and comfortable working independently in a remote, follow-the-sun team, and you take pride in leaving a clear handover for the next shift. You are curious about new threats and technologies, and you enjoy working closely with both technical teams and end users to raise the security bar across the environment.

A posição terá como foco a análise de vulnerabilidades identificadas por ferramentas de SAST (Static Application Security Testing) e SCA (Software Composition Analysis), avaliação de propostas de mitigação, identificação de falsos positivos e orientação técnica às equipes de desenvolvimento para a correção de vulnerabilidades.

  • Conhecimento sólido em Segurança de Aplicações (Application Security), incluindo arquitetura de software, funcionamento de aplicações e fluxos de dados.
  • Domínio dos conceitos do OWASP Top 10, com capacidade de identificar vulnerabilidades comuns e relacioná-las às respectivas estratégias de correção no código.

  • Autonomia para gerenciar demandas, estabelecer prioridades, acompanhar chamados e conduzir atividades até sua conclusão.
  • Inglês avançado, com boa comunicação verbal e escrita para explicar riscos técnicos, apresentar recomendações de correção e interagir com equipes internacionais e stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de adaptação a mudanças, atuação em cenários com informações incompletas e colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares.

Requisitos desejáveis (diferenciais)

Overview

The Opportunity:

Amyx, a Tetra Tech company, is adding a Senior Project Analyst and Testing Engineer to our Defense Logistics Agency team based in Philadelphia, PA.

Why Amyx, a Tetra Tech company:

Amyx has been a leader in the Federal Defense, National Security, and Intelligence industry for over 25+ years. In 2023 we joined Tetra Tech, enabling us to combine our expertise with the reach and resources of a prestigious global organization.

At Amyx and Tetra Tech, we are Leading with Science to solve the world’s most complex challenges. Our industry-leading experts are committed to driving positive change in communities around the world. For over 50 years, we have been at the forefront of innovation and sustainability. Today we stand as a market leader, offering cutting-edge solutions in IT/OT, Cyber, Mission Support Service, Water, Environment, Energy, and International Development. Our work has improved more than 625 million lives around the world.

Your Impact:

Join Amyx, a Tetra Tech company, to make a real difference. Our work leverages cutting-edge technologies, advanced analytics, and the expertise of world-class scientists and engineers to create meaningful change around the world. Discover your full potential – join us to advance your career while leaving a lasting legacy.

Responsibilities

Your Role:

Join a mission-focused team at the Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) dedicated to maintaining and modernizing critical medical logistics applications that directly support military customers. As a Senior Project Analyst and Quality Engineer, you will manage complex, state-of-the-art test programs while serving as a key bridge between stakeholders, users, and software developers. The role requires translation of complex program requirements into testable objectives, developing comprehensive test plans and procedures, and guiding the software development lifecycle (SDLC) from requirement decomposition to release verification. You will work closely with cross-functional technical teams, apply use cases and user stories to create test cases, and independently assess system performance against stated requirements to ensure high-quality software delivery. Additional sustainment tasks, such as monitoring production environments and performing analysis on databases, may be required.

  • Designs and executes test cases and test procedures to support software release targets and meeting requirement needs.
  • Translates complex program requirements into clear, testable objectives and assists with decomposition of user stories/requirements to a level of sufficiency that software developers can implement, including insertion of best practices for ensuring user stories/requirements are testable.
  • Develops and implements the overall test strategy, including defining clear test objectives, methodologies, analysis, schedules.
  • Leads and mentors QA Testers in designing detailed, executable test plans and compensating for test limitations and restrictions.
  • Incorporates automation to test cases where appropriate to expedite test execution.
  • Fosters excellent relationships with business analysts and/or stakeholders/users to understand user story and requirement needs.
  • Collaborates with cross-team technical or business resources to coordinate the resolution of data, requirements, or testing process issues that impact application quality.
  • Provides feedback on business direction, interpretation of requirements, and updates to test cases; executes test cases and signs off for release completion when necessary.
  • Captures, tracks, and manages test plans, test cases, and test steps in the enterprise repository and program-provided tools (e.g., Azure DevOps/TFS), and manages test case signoff and overall test plan posture, providing updates to project lead on testing posture.
  • Participates in software releases and deployments with Infrastructure and Application developers, supporting project leads where appropriate to review application functionality when going live and assist with documentation needs.
  • Develops a deep functional understanding of application business capabilities and continuously learns new business and technical domains.
  • Utilizes data analysis and SQL skills to investigate issues, validate database state, and provide reports as needed by stakeholders, users, or other clients in a timely fashion.
  • Leads analysis efforts to dissect test output data, interfaces with the client, provides clear results, and recommends corrective actions. Uses these skills in development and production environments as demands require.
  • Acts as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the project, assisting project lead to support the overall stakeholder need and mission objectives.
  • Conduct activities in line with internal procedures, legislation, and industry standards.
  • Pursue continuous professional development and maintain a high degree of discipline knowledge and awareness.
  • Work in a safe manner at all times and report all health and safety incidents and concerns.
  • Additional duties as required.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Must be a U.S. citizen.
  • Must be able to achieve a NACLC security background check.
  • Minimum of 5 years related experience.
  • Experience in testing software applications, including system, regression, acceptance, end-to-end, performance, and automation testing.
  • Experience in an Agile environment, with demonstrated knowledge of System Operations, Engineering, and DevOps integration.
  • Experience developing and maintaining test cases and requirements using designated automated test tools and repositories like Azure DevOps/TFS.
  • Must have detailed familiarity with commercial test environments and operating procedures.
  • Experience translating complex program requirements into testable objectives, and decomposing requirements for development.
  • Experience analyzing and recommending test cycles, test plans, and detailed test objectives.
  • Demonstrated leadership, experience working effectively with diverse organizations and personalities, and is a “team player”.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Relevant certification from a nationally recognized technical authority (e.g., ISTQB, CSM, PMP, or equivalent).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline is a plus.
  • Military Medical Supply Chain experience is a big plus.
  • Possess significant experience performing complex analysis using SQL to validate application behavior or generate business reports.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating or leading the development/testing of Web-based applications (e.g., .Net MVC, Angular).

Life at Amyx, a Tetra Tech company:

The perks of working at Tetra Tech include:

  • Comprehensive and market-competitive benefits.
  • Merit-based financial rewards.
  • Flexibility and company-wide commitment to work/life balance.
  • Collaborative team atmosphere that values the contributions of all employees.
  • Learning and development opportunities for ongoing professional growth.

About Amyx and Tetra Tech:

Amyx, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Tetra Tech, and our mission is to exceed our customer's expectations on every contract, to provide an environment that encourages, recognizes and rewards the extraordinary contributions of our employees, and to advance and support the communities in which we work and live.Amyx is a management and technical solutions provider and a "trusted partner"​ to our Federal Government clients on programs of national importance. We understand that successful programs require superior performance and a level of trust achieved through genuine rapport with the customer. Award-winning results have propelled Amyx to become one of the fastest growing businesses in the Washington Region. Amyx's service offerings include: - Program Management and Acquisition Support - Systems Engineering and Implementation - Enterprise Architecture - Business Process Transformation

Tetra Tech is the leader in water, environment, and sustainable infrastructure, providing high-end consulting and engineering services for projects worldwide. With 30,000 employees working together, Tetra Tech provides clear solutions to complex problems by Leading with Science® to address the entire water cycle, protect and restore the environment, design sustainable and resilient infrastructure, and support the clean energy transition.

We invite applications from all interested parties.

Please contact with any questions!

Amyx is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to help architect, build, and extend IronSled, a Platform as a Service designed to host applications in secure federal environments. You will be a senior technical contributor on a small, cross-functional product team responsible for evolving the platform and establishing the engineering practices, architecture, and technical foundation needed for its long-term success.

This is not a role focused on maintaining a backlog or implementing narrowly defined tickets. You will own complex capabilities from concept through production, make consequential technical decisions, identify and resolve architectural risks, and help guide less-experienced engineers. The successful candidate will be comfortable operating with significant autonomy in an environment where the roadmap and technical approach are still being formed.

This position requires an active TS/SCI security clearance.

About the Team

IronSled sits within LMI’s Chief Technology Office. We are a small, high-visibility team building a secure application-hosting platform for federal agencies. Our culture operates more like a product-focused startup than a traditional government contracting program. We move quickly, use focused design spikes to resolve uncertainty, and prioritize working outcomes over unnecessary process.

At the same time, we are building for users who require reliability, security, auditability, and trust. Strong engineering judgment, disciplined execution, and attention to detail are essential.

You will work closely with the Product Manager, Engineering Lead, platform engineers, and product stakeholders. Because the IronSled roadmap and architecture are continuing to evolve, you will have meaningful influence over the platform’s technical direction, engineering standards, and user experience.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact through innovation and speed. By investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI delivers commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready artificial intelligence capabilities to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI supports the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors, helping agencies navigate complexity, modernize critical capabilities, and strengthen mission outcomes.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

  • Own complex full stack features from architecture and data design through deployment and production support.
  • Build across Angular, TypeScript/Express, PostgreSQL, and external platform integrations.
  • Make technical decisions involving APIs, identity, permissions, security, reliability, and data architecture.
  • Partner directly with product leadership to turn ambiguous needs into practical solutions.
  • Establish engineering standards, review designs and code, and mentor other engineers.
  • Identify technical risks, improve platform architecture, and balance delivery speed with long-term maintainability.

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production full stack applications.
  • Strong experience with TypeScript, Angular, Node.js or Python, PostgreSQL, and RESTful API design.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex features and make sound architectural decisions.
  • Experience with authentication, authorization, secure application design, testing, and production troubleshooting.
  • Ability to operate effectively with incomplete requirements and limited day-to-day direction.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and improving team development practices.
  • Active use of AI-assisted development tools in a disciplined engineering workflow.
  • U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain a security clearance.

What Will Set You Apart

  • Experience working on a PaaS, internal developer platform, developer portal, or cloud-native product.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines, containers, and event-driven integrations.
  • Experience integrating with GitLab, Okta, Entra ID, OIDC, SAML, Trivy, Fleet, or similar technologies.
  • Experience developing software under federal security and compliance requirements.
  • Experience across cloud and on-premises environments.
  • A strong portfolio, open-source contributions, or other evidence of building products outside assigned work.

Target salary range: $111,000 - $211,000

The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

Applicants must meet eligibility requirements for a U.S. Government security clearance. Only US Citizens are eligible for a security clearance. For this position, LMI will only consider applicants with security clearances or applicants who are eligible for security clearances, due to the nature of the work.

jobs.description:
Position Description

Valiant Solutions is hiring an Associate Software Engineer to build the internal apps, automations, and AI tools that help our staff work faster.

The Associate Software Engineer will work directly with people across the company to find slow or error-prone work, then design, build, and measure the fix. Much of this work runs through VITALs (Valiant Innovation Team and Lab), our program that turns staff ideas into custom apps and automations. Inside IT and Engineering, you work alongside the Engineering lead and the IT Systems Administrator. The Engineering lead sets technical direction and priorities. The IT Systems Administrator runs daily IT operations, user support, and software licenses. You build the apps, automations, and AI tools that make the team, and the rest of Valiant, more efficient. All three roles share one backlog and review work together, so ideas move quickly from a support ticket or staff interview to a working tool.

Named one of the Best Places to Work in the Washington DC area for 12 consecutive years, Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

Location: This position allows for 100% remote work. Remote work requires a high level of trust in our employees, and we strictly adhere to the details outlined in our Remote Work Policy below.

Eligibility: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field or equivalent experience. 0 to 2 years of experience. Internships and substantial projects count.
  • Working skill in TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python.
  • An app, tool, or automation you built that other people used.
  • Working knowledge of RESTAPIs, OAuth 2.0, Git, and the Linux command line. Clear communication with technical and non-technical people, in writing and in conversation.
  • Ability to learn how a team works, find where it slows down, and plan the fix. Self-direction in a fully remote team.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Google Cloud or another major cloud, plus Docker.
  • Next.js or React.
  • Workflow automation tools, such as n8n, Make.com, or Google Apps Script. LLM APIs, agents, MCP servers, orAI coding tools such as Claude Code. Google Workspace administration or GAM.
  • IT support experience.
  • Experience training users or running user acceptance testing.

Responsibilities:

Your core work is building software, automation, and AI tools that give Valiant staff time back. When IT gets busy, you also help the team with escalations.

Build and ship

  • Develop projects from the VITALs backlog, from project charter and definition of done through sprints, launch, and measurement.
  • Build and maintain apps on our internal Micro-App Platform for finance, contracts, HR, and other internal teams.
  • Move workflows out of low-code apps and into custom apps when they outgrow them.
  • Work with the IT Systems Administrator to further automate IT tasks and management, from account provisioning and offboarding to Google Workspace administration and reporting.
  • Build and maintain integrations between our business systems.
  • Run user acceptance testing with each app's users, and confirm every app works on real tasks before launch.
  • Ship through GitHub with code review, CI, tests, and a runbook for each release.

AI development and enablement

  • Help set Valiant's AI development strategy: where AI fits, how we evaluate it, and how we deploy it securely.
  • Build AI features, agents, and automations with LLM APIs and MCP servers, then measure the results against the manual baseline.
  • Test new AI models and tools as they release, and recommend what Valiant adopts. Advise Valiant on modern AI tools and research, such as Claude Code and ChatGPT, and keep the company current as the field changes. Your recommendations inform adoption and risk decisions by the CTO and Engineering lead.
  • Train staff to use AI tools well through sessions, written guides, and one-on-one help.

Discover and plan

  • Meet with staff and department leads to learn how their work gets done. Find the slow, manual, or error-prone steps in their workflows, and turn them into scoped plans with a measured baseline.
  • Keep exploring new ways technology can improve how Valiant works, and bring forward the ideas worth testing.
  • Contribute to the project that defines Valiant's future app architecture, including how apps share data, sign users in, and connect to business systems.

Tools you may work with. These are examples, not requirements. Our tools change as Valiant grows, and you learn most of them on the job.

  • App development: TypeScript, Next.js, React, Node.js, Python
  • Cloud and hosting: Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Firestore), Docker, Linux
  • Automation: n8n, Make.com, Google Apps Script, Bash, GAM
  • Business systems: Google Workspace, Unanet, Salesforce, GoDaddy, iCIMS, Knack, Notion, Discord, Supernormal
  • Source control and CI: GitHub, GitHub Actions

Growth and milestones

This role is built to grow. The apps you build become yours to own: you set their roadmap, work directly with the people who use them, and decide how they improve. As your track record grows, so does your scope, from single features to whole platforms, and from building tools to shaping how Valiant builds them.

Day 30: Learn the platform, ship a fix to a live app, and join a VITALs discovery session.

Day 60: Own one automation from end to end, with tests and a runbook.

Day 90: Take one VITALs project from intake to production, including user acceptance testing.

Month 6: Own one or more apps end to end. Hold regular check-ins with their department leads, and take part in architecture discussions.

Month 12: Act as a trusted technical partner to the department leads you support. Help design Valiant's future app architecture, lead discovery for new VITALs projects, and help set the direction of AI development.

About Valiant Solutions

Valiant Solutions delivers cybersecurity and IT services to federal civilian, defense, and national security customers nationwide. We support the full cyber lifecycle, from secure system design and accreditation through AI-enabled operations, threat emulation, and continuous improvement, across classified and unclassified environments. Our work is independently certified for quality and security, including CMMI, CMMC, and ISO certifications.

Valiant is a multi-year Washington Business Journal Best Places to Work winner, and our growth and cyber leadership have been recognized by Washington Technology, Northern Virginia Technology Council, and the Triangle Business Journal. We offer strong benefits, rewards for earning industry certifications, and room to grow your career as we grow. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, our distributed workforce supports customers from coast to coast. We go where the stakes are highest, and the margin for error is zero. If you want meaningful work alongside talented professionals, apply today.

Benefits Snapshot

Valiant takes care of the people who support our customers, with real choices in coverage and real investment in your career. Eligible full-time employees receive:

  • A choice of medical plans, from an affordable HSA option to a full-featured PPO, with generous company contributions
  • Dental and vision coverage for you and your family
  • Company-paid life, short-term disability, and long-term disability insurance
  • Optional supplemental life, accident, and critical illness coverage to round out your protection
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Paid time off that grows with your years of service, plus paid federal holidays
  • Paid certifications, professional development, and the Valiant University training portal
  • Flexible spending accounts and a wellness and fitness program
  • Referral bonuses when you help us bring great people to Valiant

Benefit eligibility and plan details are subject to the terms of each plan and may change from time to time.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $75,000 to $90,000. This range reflects Valiant Solutions' good-faith estimate of the base salary reasonably expected for this position upon hire, at the time of posting. The range has been established based on the scope of the role, market rates, and internal equity. Where a candidate falls within the posted range will depend on job-related factors, including relevant skills, experience, qualifications, achievements, education, geographic location, applicable security clearance requirements, additional corporate responsibilities, and other legitimate, non-discriminatory business considerations. The posted range does not guarantee an offer at any particular salary. In addition to base salary, this position includes the benefits described above.

Remote Work Policy (Remote and Hybrid Positions Only)

Remote work necessitates a high level of trust in our employees. To ensure that employee performance does not suffer in a remote work environment, all employees who telecommute are expected to have a quiet and distraction-free workspace with adequate internet, dedicate their full attention and availability to their job duties during working hours, and maintain a schedule during core business hours that aligns with those of their coworkers and Valiant's clients. During onboarding and throughout employment, employees must disclose any current activities or intent to engage in outside employment or other professional activities and obtain written approval. Valiant Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

Position Title: Data Engineer

Position Type: Grant-funded, limited-term opportunity

Overview

The Data Engineer will play a key role in advancing the CDC Foundation's mission by designing, building, and maintaining data infrastructure for a public health organization. This position supports the Workforce Acceleration Initiative (WAI), a federally funded CDC Foundation program dedicated to helping public health agencies accelerate information system improvements through technology and data expertise.

Working within the Chickasaw Nation Department of Health (CNDH), Division of Public Health, the Data Engineer will collaborate in planning and developing solutions for interoperable data generation, storage, processing, and analysis across systems supporting tribal public health operations. The role will partner closely with data content experts, analysts, data scientists, data modelers, data warehouse architects, IT professionals, and other organizational staff to design and implement scalable, sustainable solutions that meet agency needs.

In addition to technical responsibilities, the Data Engineer will provide training and mentorship to Division of Public Health staff to support capacity building and promote long-term system sustainability.

The Data Engineer will be employed by the CDC Foundation and assigned to the CNDH Division of Public Health. This position is eligible for a fully remote work arrangement for candidates based in the United States.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain data systems and pipelines that support the efficient and reliable ingestion, processing, transformation, and storage of data.

  • Collect data from multiple sources; cleanse, transform, and validate data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity before loading into data storage platforms and data warehouses.

  • Optimize data pipelines, infrastructure, and workflows to improve performance, efficiency, reliability, and scalability.

  • Monitor data pipelines and platforms for performance issues, errors, and anomalies, implementing corrective actions as needed.

  • Implement and maintain appropriate security controls and data governance practices to protect sensitive and confidential information.

  • Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business partners to understand data requirements and ensure data infrastructure supports organizational goals and objectives.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and design scalable, sustainable data solutions that meet business and public health needs.

  • Develop, implement, and maintain ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of organizational data.

  • Design and manage data storage solutions, including relational databases, NoSQL databases, and enterprise data warehouses.

jobs.description:
Dies ist ein Remote Job.

Google Ads Search Specialist (m/w/d) | Automatisierte Search-Kampagnen mit KI-basierter Eventintegration

Freelance · ca. 1,5 bis 2 Tage/Woche · Start: Anfang 2027 · Laufzeit: langfristig

Über den Kunden

Ein etablierter Ticketing-Dienstleister aus Deutschland mit mehreren Standorten und einem eigenen Performance-Marketing-Team. Über Google Search werden Veranstaltungen im großen Stil beworben, das Konto läuft hoch profitabel. Jetzt wird das Setup dahinter neu gedacht. Den konkreten Kundennamen nennen wir Dir im Briefing Call.

Auf einen Blick

Start: Anfang 2027, frühes Reinfuchsen ausdrücklich erwünscht. Genaues Timing hängt an einer neuen Schnittstelle und wird noch abgestimmt.
Dauer: langfristig angelegt · laufende Betreuung statt Einmal-Projekt
Auslastung: ca. 1,5 bis 2 Tage/Woche, Abrechnung nach Aufwand

Setup: 100 % remote

Sprache: Deutsch

Tagessatz: Faire Range nach Profil und Senioritätslevel. Wir besprechen das offen im Briefing Call, kein Rätselraten.

Über das Projekt

Seit Jahren legt ein automatisiertes System aus Event-IDs Search-Kampagnen im Lower Funnel an. Veranstaltungsname, Pfad, Keywords und Anzeigentexte werden bisher noch von Hand ergänzt, obwohl alle Infos bereits in den Eventtexten stehen. Parallel baut die interne Softwareentwicklung einen sauberen Produktdatenfeed, an den das neue Setup andocken soll.

Warum jetzt: Das Unternehmen bündelt sein Marketing auf eine Marke und will die Google-Ads-Betreuung neu aufstellen, mit mehr Eigeninitiative bei Automatisierung und KI.

Du übernimmst Konto und Automatisierung als Dein Baby und sorgst dafür, dass Events schneller, vollständiger und ohne manuelle Fleißarbeit in Google landen, ohne dass die starke Rentabilität leidet.

Was Du konkret tun wirst

Search-Konto steuern und optimieren
Du betreust das Google-Ads-Konto (Search, Lower Funnel) laufend: Gebote, Keywords, Anzeigen, Budgets. Ziel ist, die hohe Profitabilität zu halten und weiter auszubauen.

Kampagnen-Automatisierung neu aufsetzen
Du baust das System neu auf, das aus Event-IDs automatisch Search-Kampagnen erzeugt, sauber dokumentiert und wartbar.

KI-basierte Eventintegration umsetzen
Du lässt Veranstaltungsname, Pfad, Keywords und Beschreibung automatisiert aus den Eventtexten im Content-System generieren, statt sie manuell einzupflegen.

Neuen Produktdatenfeed anbinden
Gemeinsam mit der internen Softwareentwicklung zapfst Du die neue Schnittstelle an und bringst die Eventdaten zuverlässig in Google Ads.

Gebotssteuerung und Ausschlüsse automatisieren
Du setzt eine automatisierte Bidding-Logik jenseits der Google-Standardstrategien auf und sorgst dafür, dass exklusiv verkaufte Events automatisch ausgeschlossen werden.

Zahlen wöchentlich gemeinsam reviewen
Einmal pro Woche schaust Du mit dem Performance-Marketing-Team ca. eine Stunde auf Zahlen, Learnings und nächste Schritte.

Was Dich erwartet, ehrlich gesagt

Die neue Schnittstelle ist noch in Entwicklung, und die Umstellung auf eine Marke läuft parallel. Heißt: Am Anfang brauchst Du etwas Geduld und Lust, Dinge mitzugestalten, die noch nicht final sind. Leichter macht es, dass ein fester Ansprechpartner aus der Softwareentwicklung von Beginn an mit am Tisch sitzt.


Voraussetzungen

Was Du mitbringst

Must-haves

  • Mindestens 6 Jahre Google Ads mit klarem Fokus auf Search, inklusive großer Konten mit vielen Kampagnen und relevantem Budget
  • Echte Tech-Affinität: Du schreibst und pflegst Google Ads Scripts, arbeitest mit Feeds, APIs oder Automatisierungstools und hast keine Angst vor Schnittstellen
  • Erfahrung damit, KI produktiv in Marketing-Workflows einzusetzen, etwa zur automatisierten Erstellung von Anzeigentexten und Keywords
  • Du denkst in ROAS und Deckungsbeitrag, nicht in Klicks, und behandelst das Konto wie Dein eigenes
  • Du kommunizierst auf Augenhöhe in beide Richtungen: mit Marketing und mit Softwareentwicklung

Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung mit vielen kurzlebigen Produkten, z. B. Ticketing, Events, Travel oder großen Sortimenten
  • Erfahrung mit eigenen Bidding-Lösungen oder Python
  • Microsoft Ads Know-how

Dein Setup beim Kunden

Performance Marketing: zehnköpfiges Inhouse-Team, Deine direkte Ansprechpartnerin sitzt hier
Softwareentwicklung: fester Ansprechpartner für Schnittstelle und Produktdatenfeed
Tracking: eigenes Team, kein Teil Deiner Rolle
Kommunikations-Rhythmus: wöchentlicher Call, ca. eine Stunde

Du findest Dich wieder? Nice.

Dann bewirb Dich direkt hier im Portal, wir melden uns für den Briefing Call. 15 Min reden ist meistens besser, als ins Blaue abzusagen oder lange zu überlegen.

Lieber erst Fragen?

Freelancer Relations · ✉️ · ☎️ +49 (0) 89 244 12 536

#CONNECTINGAWESOMENESS


Vorteile

So läuft's bei uns ab

  1. Du bewirbst Dich hier im Portal. Ein Klick, kurzes Profil, der Rest läuft im Gespräch.
  2. Briefing Call mit uns. Lockerer 15-Min-Austausch: Profil checken, Fragen klären, Background zum Auftraggeber, zwischen den Zeilen der Jobbeschreibung lesen, Tagessatz-Range abstimmen.
  3. Vorstellung beim Auftraggeber. Mit Deinem DYGITIZED®-Profil: Check auf fachlichen Fit, Track-Record-Match und Cultural Fit.
  4. Feedback vom Auftraggeber. Go oder No Go für ein Kennenlerngespräch.
  5. Kennenlerngespräch mit dem Auftraggeber. Ca. 30 Min über Projekt, Stakeholder-Setup, mögliche Outcomes, Erwartungsmanagement und finaler Chemistry Check.
  6. Entscheidung. Bestenfalls innerhalb von 48 bis 72 Stunden.
  7. Vertrag über DYGITIZED®. Alles digital.
  8. Onboarding zu Deinem Freelance-Einsatz. Und wir sind an Deiner Seite.

Wer wir sind

DYGITIZED® ist ein Boutique Expert Network für digitale Transformation. Bei uns findest Du freiberufliche Expert:innen für die gesamte Klaviatur digitaler Geschäftsmodelle: von AI, Marketing, Produkt, Tech & Data bis zu Go-To-Market, Strategie & Transformation.

Wir verbinden 800+ Senior Digital Expert:innen mit Mittelstand, Hidden Champions und Growth-Companies, nach unserem SMTC-Framework.

Wir vermitteln nicht, wir matchen
Jeder Einsatz und jeder Mensch wird inhaltlich geprüft, nicht nach Keyword-Treffer. Bei jedem Matching achten wir explizit auch auf den Cultural Fit.

Fachlichkeit, die wir einschätzen können
Jede:r Freelancer:in in unserem Netzwerk wird nach unserem SMTC-Framework geprüft (Skillset, Mindset, Toolset, Cultural Fit). In das Gesamtbild fließen auch die Projektperformance und das Feedback unserer Kund:innen ein.

Direkt mit Menschen, die das Projekt verstehen

Beidseitige Selektion
Wir sagen auch mal Nein, wenn ein Match nicht passt oder ein Einsatz nicht zu dem passt, was wir können. Auf beiden Seiten.

Wir verstehen den Job, weil wir ihn selbst gemacht haben

Wir kommen selbst aus der Freelance-Welt und wissen, was nervt: schwammige Scopes, späte Zahlungen, Funkstille im Prozess. Genau das machen wir anders: pünktliche Rechnungen, ehrliches Feedback, ein:e feste:r Ansprechpartner:in.

Mittelstand-DNA
Wir kennen die Realität von Hidden Champions und Familienunternehmen, inklusive der Eigenheiten, die in Slack-only-Kulturen unsichtbar bleiben.

Mehr zu uns und unserem Ansatz: We are DYGITIZED

Was DYGITIZED® nicht ist

Keine stumpfe „Vermittlung“. Du gehst als Expert:in mit eigener Handschrift in den Einsatz, nicht als austauschbares Profil im CV-Stapel.
Kein Recruiter-Sprech. Keine generischen Briefings, keine anonymen Profil-Weiterleitungen, keine „Hast Du gerade Kapazität?“-Mails.
Keine Plattform-Anonymität. Du sprichst direkt mit Menschen, die das Projekt fachlich verstehen, persönlich erreichbar, mit Namen und Gesicht.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

At Fuze Health, we put patients first and tirelessly address the most pressing needs in healthcare. We empower millions to digitally connect with care providers, essential health resources and needed treatments – and enable care providers, employers, health plans and life sciences companies to meaningfully enhance quality, outcomes and value. We are dedicated to helping our partners evolve and modernize to meet emerging patient and marketplace needs.

Fuze Health’s foundation is built upon the strategic combination of several proven, technology-powered innovators in the digital health, diagnostics, and pharmacy sectors. Our growing portfolio brings together the capabilities of industry leaders including LetsGetChecked, Truepill, and Alto Pharmacy, to create a distinctive, unified force in healthcare. Together, we have the shared vision, advanced capabilities and talented teams to deliver next-generation solutions that patients and healthcare partners need today and into the future.



Job Description

The Staff Product Analyst, Care at Fuze Health plays a critical role in driving operational and strategic decision-making across the business through data analysis, reporting, and cross-functional collaboration. This role is responsible for analyzing prescription processing and patient care operations, designing scalable data models, and developing dashboards that provide actionable insights to stakeholders across Finance, Product, Engineering, Growth, and Operations. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with business acumen to influence strategy, improve operational efficiency, and contribute to building a strong data-driven culture within the FuzeRx organization.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Operational Analysis: Perform in-depth analysis of prescription processing and patient care operations to support key business and operational decisions.
  • Data Modeling & Analytics: Design and build scalable data models that improve access to insights, enable data democratization, and support faster decision-making.
  • Dashboard Development: Design, implement, and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions using SQL, Looker, Tableau, or similar BI tools to measure product and operational performance.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Finance, Product, Engineering, Growth, and Operations teams to provide analytical visibility, identify opportunities, and recommend data-driven solutions.
  • Strategic Insights: Translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable business recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Data Infrastructure Support: Utilize SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis across large datasets to support reporting, operational monitoring, and strategic initiatives.
  • Business Impact & Decision Support: Influence business strategy by delivering high-quality analyses that drive measurable operational and financial impact.
  • Team & Culture Development: Contribute to the growth of the Data Science & Analytics function through peer collaboration, mentorship, process improvement, and fostering a strong data culture.
  • Continuous Improvement: Stay current with emerging analytics tools, technologies, and industry best practices to continuously improve analytical capabilities and business outcomes.





Additional Information

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or another quantitative field.
  • 8+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or a related technical role.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL for data analysis, ETL design, scripting, and large-scale data extraction.
  • Strong experience building dashboards and visualizations using Looker, Tableau, or similar BI platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence business strategy and deliver measurable impact through data-driven insights.
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills with a strong focus on actionable outcomes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex insights to non-technical audiences.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally in fast-paced, data-driven environments.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently while driving projects forward.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience within the healthcare or pharmaceutical industry.
  • Experience supporting supply chain optimization, logistics, or marketplace operations.
  • Programming experience with Python or similar languages.
  • Experience working with large-scale operational or healthcare datasets.

Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. At this time, Fuze Health is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa.


Physical requirements: For this role include the ability to work at a computer terminal with monitor, keyboard and mouse for extended periods of time, stoop, bend, and reach for equipment and supplies, make frequent repetitive motions required to operate a computer that include the wrists, hands and fingers, and lift, carry, push, pull, and move light objects up to 20 pounds. The role also requires the ability to effectively communicate through verbal interactions, discern auditory information, and visually perceive details to perform essential job functions.

Employees are also provided flexible vacation time, accrued paid sick time, 10 paid holidays, (2 floating holidays for full time non-exempt employees) , and eight weeks of paid parental leave for eligible employees, additional paid weeks for the birthing parent, 4 weeks paid caregiver leave, and a Lifestyle Spending Account allowance each month.

UPSTARS – продуктова IT-компанія, з якою злітають і люди, і бренди. Наш основний фокус – технологічні рішення та B2B-послуги для міжнародних клієнтів. Запускаємо зіркові проєкти у сфері iGaming, які отримують визнання та найвищі оцінки профільних рейтингів ✨

І так, підтримувати легальний та прозорий ринок України – це маст хев, тому третіми в країні отримали B2B-ліцензію на надання послуг у сфері азартних ігор.

У 2026 ми активно масштабуємо і проєкти, і дрім тім. Тому для підсилення Data&Analyticsдепартаменту шукаємо Middle AI Analytics Engineer.

✅ Твої майбутні задачі:

  • підвищення якості селф-сервіс аналітики через Metabase через обв'язку скілами і контекстом;

  • автоматизація рутини аналітичної команди (АІ код рев'ювер, скіли і тд);

  • реалізація фреймворка оцінки якості АІ-рішень аналітичної команди.

💪 Твої скіли:

  • SQL;

  • Python;

  • Claude, Claude Code та MCP;

  • Claude skills і context engineering - проєктування Claude skills: призначення, інструкції, приклади; контекст у промптах і skills; зменшення галюцинацій;

  • RAG - проєктування та покращення RAG: індексація джерел, чанкінг, пошук і реранкінг; оцінка якості пошуку й відповідей;

  • оцінка якості AI-рішень - golden answers, evals, LLM-as-judge, регресійне тестування, моніторинг дрейфу, root cause analysis.

🤞 Бажано, але не критично:

  • розробка агентів через LLM API / SDK - створення власних агентів на базі LLM API: tool use, контекст, вартість;

  • BI-інструменти - розуміння BI як шару доступу AI до даних: моделі, метрики, запити; досвід саме з Metabase чи Tableau буде плюсом;

  • досвід роботи з dbt.

🌟 Наші цінності та переваги:

  • командність – гуртом не лише працюємо, а ще й відпочиваємо, двіжуємо і робимо добрі справи;

  • позитив – з легкістю йдемо по життю і отримуємо драйв від круто зробленої роботи, цікавих задач і фідбеку тіммейтів;

  • можливості – пропонуємо чіткий кар’єрний план з Performance Review, тренінги, менторинг-програми та інші інструменти для реалізації як у карʼєрі, так і у житті;

  • сміливість – беремося за задачі із зірочкою, не боїмося викликів і амбітних планів;

  • відкритість – говоримо прямо і просто навіть про складне, чуємо ідеї та фідбеки і цінуємо проактивність;

  • маємо власні потужності для створення технологічних рішень з нуля;

  • автоматизуємо рутину, щоб використовувати час для розвитку та професійного зростання всередині компанії;

  • не любимо бюрократію та застарілі підходи – ми за свободу дій.

🍪Маст-хев:

  • працюй там, де комфортно та безпечно – в хабах у Києві та Варшаві або віддалено;

  • 20 робочих днів оплачуваних дей офів, державні вихідні і лікарняні – ми за ворк-лайф беленс;

  • медичне страхування у топових клініках і покриття витрат на психолога на платформі Pleso;

  • Benefit cafe – щомісячно витрачай кошти на уподобання, хобі, спорт тощо;

  • івенти – бери участь у майстер-класах, відвідуй тімбілдинги та корпоративи;

  • навчання під будь-який запит – індивідуальний бюджет на курси, корпоративна англійська, воркшопи та онлайн-бібліотека.

І ще про важливе:

❗️Не маємо клієнтів, які б використовували наші розробки та послуги на українському ринку.
